1694.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 31.0°W is in the Greenland Sea/east of Greenland. Greenland's east coast around 71°N: Scoresby Sund is at about 70°N, 22–28°W. Jameson Land is around 71°N, 22°W. Further west, at 31°W and 71°N, this is inland in Greenland, near Stauning Alps (about 72°N, 25°W). The coast near Kangerlussuaq is at 68°N, 32°W. At 71°N the coast is Liverpool Land at 22°W, and the Scoresby Sund fjord system extends inland to about 30°W (Kong Oscar Fjord and Fønfjord up to 28°W at 71.5°N). The point 71°N, 31°W is west of the fjord heads, so it is on the ice sheet or in mountains. It is land.

Land

1695.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 29.0°W is in East Greenland, near Scoresby Sund. Scoresby Sund lies at about 70.5°N, 22–27°W, and Liverpool Land is at about 70.5°N, 22°W. At 29°W and 71°N, this would be within the Scoresby Sund fjord system or just west of it. The fjord system includes Hall Bredning at around 70.5°N, 26°W, and Gåsefjord and Rypefjord to the south and west. Fønfjord lies at about 71.5°N, 26°W. Nordvestfjord extends to about 71.5°N, 27–28°W, and its head is near 28.5°W. The land to the west of that is the Stauning Alps region, which is mountainous. At 71.0°N, 29°W, I think this is probably land, since the Nordvestfjord runs northwest from about 70.3°N, 26°W to 72°N, 26°W, and 29°W is farther west than that.

Land

1696.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 27.0°W is off the east coast of Greenland. Greenland's east coast around 71°N is near Scoresby Sund, where Jameson Land lies at about 71°N, 23°W. The coast near Scoresby Sund's mouth is at about 22°W, and Liverpool Land is around 21–23°W. At 27°W, 71°N, the position is inside the Scoresby Sund fjord system. The fjord mouth is at about 70.5°N, 22°W, and the fjord extends west to about 27°W at around 70.5–71°N. Kong Oscar Fjord is further north, at about 72°N, 24–27°W. The main Scoresby Sund body runs from 22°W to about 26°W at 70.3°N, with Hall Bredning near 70.5°N, 25°W. At 71°N, 27°W, this is probably land, on the Renland and Stauning Alps side. Renland lies around 71.3°N, 26.5°W, so the point is likely on Renland or nearby land. Water is possible in Rypefjord, but land is more likely.

Land

1697.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 25.0°W is in East Greenland. Scoresby Sund is around 70°N, 22°W, and Jameson Land is around 71°N, 23°W. Liverpool Land is at about 70.5°N, 22°W. At 25°W, 71°N, this is near the mouth of Scoresby Sund's fjords, possibly Hurry Inlet or Scoresby Sund proper. The fjord system runs west to about 28°W. Scoresby Sund main fjord extends from 70.5°N, 22°W northwest to around 71.5°N, 25°W. Milne Land lies at about 70.8°N, 25.5°W, with its extent from roughly 70.3° to 71.0°N and 24° to 29°W. Milne Land's northern tip is about 70.95°N, and Hall Bredning lies north of it, around 70.5°N, 26°W to the south. So at 71.0°N, 25°W we are probably north of Milne Land, in Scoresby Sund's Hall Bredning or near Rødefjord, which is water.

Hall Bredning is at about 70.4°N, 26°W, and Scoresby Sund proper is around 70.5°N, 24°W. North of Milne Land, between it and Jameson Land at 71°N, there is Føhn Fjord and Rypefjord. Jameson Land is east at 71°N, 22°W. At 25°W, 71°N there is likely water.

Water

1698.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 23.0°W is in East Greenland. Scoresby Sund is around 70°N, 22°W, and Liverpool Land sits near 70.5°N, 22°W. At 71°N, 23°W, this is likely the Jameson Land and Scoresby Sund area, or the mouth of the Kong Oscar Fjord to the north.

Scoresby Sund's mouth is at about 70.5°N, 22°W, and the fjord system runs west to about 71°N, 25–28°W. Liverpool Land spans 70.3–71.0°N and 21–23°W. Milne Land is at 70.8°N, 25–28°W. So the point 71.0°N, 23°W lies at the northern edge of Liverpool Land or in the fjord just north of it. Hurry Inlet is at about 70.5°N, 22.5°W, and the Scoresby Sund main channel runs between Liverpool Land and Milne Land at about 70.7°N, 23–25°W. At 71°N, 23°W, this is probably the northern part of the fjord, near Storstrømmen or Fønfjord. Fønfjord is at about 71.0°N, 24°W and is a northern arm of Scoresby Sund. Since 23°W is east of it, it is probably land at the north end of Liverpool Land, or the mountains near Hurry Inlet.

Land

1699.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 21.0°W is in the Greenland Sea, off the east coast of Greenland. Scoresby Sund lies at around 70.5°N, 22°W. Jan Mayen is at 71°N, 8.5°W. The Greenland coast near 71°N sits around 22°W: Liverpool Land is at about 70.5°N, 22°W, and the mouth of Scoresby Sund is at about 70.5°N, 22°W to 25°W. Land near 71°N, 21°W would be east of Liverpool Land's eastern tip, which is about 21.5°W at 70.8°N. The coast of Liverpool Land runs from about 70.0°N, 22.5°W up to 71.0°N, 22°W. At 71°N the eastern edge is about 21.5°W, so 21°W is just offshore.

Water

1700.text:
Latitude 71°N, longitude 19°W is in the Greenland Sea, east of Greenland's coast, which sits around 22°W at that latitude. Jan Mayen is at 71°N, 8.5°W, so it is not nearby. Greenland's coast near 71°N is at Scoresby Sund, with the mouth around 22°W, and the land at Liverpool Land reaches about 21–22°W. At 19°W, that is east of those, so it is water.

Water

1701.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 17.0°W lies in the Greenland Sea, northeast of Iceland and just north of Jan Mayen. Jan Mayen sits at about 71°N, 8°W, so this point is well west of it. Greenland's east coast at that latitude (Scoresby Sund area) is around 22°W to 28°W, so -17 is east of the coast and therefore in the sea.

Water

1702.text:
Latitude 71.0, longitude -15.0 is near Jan Mayen island, which lies at about 71°N, 8°W. At -15° longitude and 71°N, that is northwest of Jan Mayen, in the Greenland Sea. Greenland's east coast at 71°N is around -22°W, and Jan Mayen spans roughly -9.1° to -8.0°. So -15° falls between them, in open water.

Water

1703.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 13.0°W lies in the Greenland Sea, just northwest of Jan Mayen. Jan Mayen sits at about 71.0°N, 8.5°W, so this point is about 4.5° of longitude west of the island. At that latitude a degree of longitude is about 36 km, so the point is roughly 160 km away and clearly not on the island.

Greenland's east coast at 71°N is around 22°W, so the point is not on Greenland either.

Water

1704.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 11.0°W lies in the Greenland Sea. Jan Mayen is at about 71°N, 8.5°W, so this point is west of it by about 2.5° of longitude. Jan Mayen spans roughly 8°W to 9.1°W, so 11°W is beyond its western edge. The nearest part of Greenland is at about 22°W, which is much farther away. So the point is in the water.

Water

1705.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 9.0°W is in the Greenland Sea, northwest of Jan Mayen. Jan Mayen is at about 71.0°N, 8.5°W. Its island spans roughly 70.8–71.15°N and 9.1–8.0°W. Beerenberg volcano is at 71.08°N, 8.17°W. The island's southwestern part extends to around 8.9°W at 70.9°N. At 71.0°N, the western coast is around 8.5°W, since the island is narrow in the north-central region. The island is roughly 54 km long, running northeast-southwest. The southwest tip is at about 70.82°N, 9.05°W, and the northeast end is at about 71.15°N, 7.9°W. Along that line, at 71.0°N the center would be around 8.5°W, and the island is about 15 km wide at the widest, with the northern part being wider. At 9.0°W, the point is 0.5° west, which is about 18 km at that latitude, so likely beyond the coast. The west coast near 71.0°N is roughly 8.8°W. So the point is probably water.

Water

1706.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 7.0°W lies in the Greenland Sea, north of Iceland. Jan Mayen is at about 71.0°N, 8.5°W. The island runs from about 70.8°N to 71.2°N, and its longitude spans roughly 9.1°W to 7.9°W. At 7.0°W, the point is east of the island's easternmost extent of about 7.9°W, so it is water.

Water

1707.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 5.0°W is in the Greenland Sea/Norwegian Sea, north of Iceland and west of Norway. Jan Mayen sits at about 71°N, 8.5°W, so 5°W is east of it, which puts the point in open water.

Water

1708.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 3.0°W lies in the Greenland Sea/Norwegian Sea, north of Iceland and west of Norway. Jan Mayen sits at about 71°N, 8.5°W, which is well to the west of this point, so it does not cover this location.

Water

1709.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 1°W is in the Norwegian Sea/Greenland Sea area. Jan Mayen is at about 71°N, 8°W. At 1°W, 71°N, it's north of Norway's mainland (which is at 71°N, 25°E) and east of Jan Mayen, so this is open ocean.

Water

1710.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 1.0°E is in the Norwegian Sea/Barents region. Norway's North Cape is at about 71.17°N, 25.8°E, and Jan Mayen is at about 71°N, 8°W. At 1°E, 71°N is open ocean.

Water

1711.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 3.0°E lies in the Norwegian Sea/Barents region, north of Norway. Norway's northern coast at 71°N (Nordkinn is 71.1°N, 28°E) is far to the east. At 3°E, 71°N is open ocean, so it's water.

Water

1712.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 5.0°E lies in the Norwegian Sea, northwest of the Norwegian mainland. The northern tip of Norway is at about 71°N but around 25°E. At 5°E and 71°N, the nearest land is Jan Mayen, which is at 8°W, so not that. This point is open ocean.

Water

1713.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 7.0°E lies in the Norwegian Sea, northwest of mainland Norway. The North Cape is at about 71.17°N, 25.8°E, so this point is far west of it. Jan Mayen is at about 71°N, 8.5°W, which is also not near. So this point is water.

Water

1714.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 9.0°E is in the Norwegian Sea/Arctic Ocean, north of Norway's mainland (the northern coast is at about 71°N near Nordkapp at 25°E). At 9°E, the coast of Norway is around 63°N. Jan Mayen lies at 71°N, 8.5°W, which is a different longitude, west rather than east. So 71°N 9°E is open sea.

Water

1715.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 11.0°E is in northern Norway, near Nordkinn/Magerøya? Magerøya (North Cape) is at 71.17°N, 25.8°E. At 11°E, 71°N is in the Norwegian Sea, well north of the coast, which is around 70°N at 20°E but about 67-68°N at 11-14°E. Jan Mayen is at 71°N, 8°W. Bear Island is at 74.5°N, 19°E. So 71°N, 11°E is open sea.

Water

1716.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 13.0°E is in northern Norway, near the coast. Nordkinn and Nordkapp sit around 71.1°N and 25.8°E, so that is far to the east. At 13°E, 71°N is in the Norwegian Sea, north-west of the Lofoten and Vesterålen islands, which lie around 68°N. The Norwegian mainland at that longitude reaches only about 68–69°N. Jan Mayen is at 71°N but 8°W, so it doesn't apply. 71°N 13°E is open water.

Water

1717.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 15.0°E is in northern Norway, near the North Cape area. Mageroya island is at about 71.0°N, 25.7°E, which is further east. At 15°E, the coast near Lofoten and Vesterålen lies at about 68–69°N. At 71°N, 15°E the location is in the Norwegian Sea, well north of the coast, so it is water.

Water

1718.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 17.0°E is in northern Norway, in Finnmark/Troms. The North Cape (Nordkapp) is at about 71.17°N, 25.78°E. At 17°E and 71°N, the Norwegian coast is farther south: Troms islands such as Senja are around 69.3°N, 17.5°E, and Kvaløya near Tromsø is at 69.7°N, 19°E. At 71°N, 17°E, the point is in the Norwegian Sea/Arctic Ocean, well north of the mainland. Bear Island is at 74.4°N, 19°E, and Sørøya is at 70.6°N, 22.5°E, so nothing lies near 17°E.

Water

1719.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 19.0°E is in northern Norway, in Troms og Finnmark county. Nearby is Nordkinn... no, Nordkinn is at 27.7°E. At 19°E, 71°N lies north of the Norwegian coast, near the island of Sørøya (about 70.6°N, 22.5°E) and Ringvassøya (69.9°N, 19.2°E). At 71°N, 19°E, the point is in the Barents/Norwegian Sea, well north of the mainland, which is at about 70°N near that longitude. Bjørnøya is farther north at 74.4°N.

Water

1720.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, Longitude 21.0°E is in northern Norway, near Finnmark. Nordkinn peninsula is around 71.1°N, 27.7°E. North Cape (Nordkapp) is at 71.17°N, 25.78°E. At 21°E, the coast of Finnmark is near Sørøya (70.6°N, 22.5°E) and Seiland. Hasvik is on Sørøya at 70.5°N, 22.1°E. Loppa island is at 70.35°N, 22.35°E. At longitude 21°E, the land at around 70.0–70.3°N (Sørøya's western tip near 70.6°N, 21.9°E). 71.0°N at 21°E is further north, so it's in the Barents/Norwegian Sea.

Water

1721.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 23.0°E is in northern Norway, in Finnmark. North Cape (Nordkapp) sits at about 71.17°N, 25.8°E, and Magerøya lies near 71°N, 25–26°E. At 23°E and 71°N, the nearby land is Sørøya, which spans about 70.6–71.1°N and 22–23.5°E. Hammerfest is at 70.66°N, 23.68°E. Sørøya's northern parts reach about 70.95°N, so 71.0 may fall just north of it, in the sea. Sørøya's northernmost point is around 71.05°N near Sørøya's north cape, at roughly 22.5°E. Its east side, around 23°E, is near Sørøysundet and Kvalsund, and the north coast at 23°E is probably about 70.9°N. That puts 71.0°N, 23.0°E in the water.

Water

1722.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 25.0°E is in northern Norway, in Finnmark. Nordkinn peninsula is around 71.1°N, 27.7°E, and North Cape (Nordkapp) is around 71.17°N, 25.78°E. At 25.0°E, the coast near Magerøya's western side is at about 25.5°E, and the mainland near Sørøya reaches about 71.0°N at 22–23°E. Hammerfest is at 70.66°N, 23.7°E. The Porsanger peninsula's northwest coast near Sværholt is at about 70.6°N, 26.7°E. At 25°E, the northern coast of the mainland sits around 70.9°N, near Gjesvær, which is on the western part of Magerøya (25.37°E, 71.1°N). The area around 71.0°N, 25.0°E lies west of Magerøya in the Barents Sea, since Magerøya's westernmost point is about 25.3°E at 71.05°N.

Water

1723.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 27.0°E is in northern Norway, in Finnmark. Nordkapp (North Cape) lies at about 71.17°N, 25.8°E, and Magerøya is at about 71.0°N, 25.5°E. Further east, at 27°E, the coast is near Porsanger. The Porsangerfjord mouth is at about 70.9°N, 25–26°E. The Nordkinn peninsula reaches about 71.1°N, 27.7°E. At 27.0°E the coast of the Nordkinn peninsula lies at about 71.0°N, so the point could be land or sea.

The Nordkinn peninsula spans roughly 27.0–28.0°E. Kinnarodden is at 71.13°N, 27.65°E. The west coast of the peninsula, along Tanafjord's western side and Lakselv's east side, is Laksefjord, whose mouth is at about 27°E. Laksefjord is at about 70.9°N, 26.9°E, and the peninsula between Laksefjord and Tanafjord is Nordkinn. Mageroya's east is open sea at 71°N, and Nordkinn's west coast at 71°N lies around 27.0°E. The Nordkinn peninsula's west coast runs from Gamvik (71.05°N, 28.2°E) toward Lebesby (70.5°N, 27°E). Lebesby is at 70.52°N, 27.0°E. North of Lebesby, the western coast at 71.0°N is at about 27.2°E, with Slettnes lighthouse at 71.08°N, 28.2°E. The coast near 27°E, 71°N is probably near Kjølnes and Sandfjord, so 27.0°E at 71.0°N is likely water or a narrow edge of land.

**Water**

1724.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 29.0°E is in northern Norway, in Finnmark. The North Cape (Nordkapp) is at about 71.17°N, 25.8°E. At 29°E, the Nordkinn peninsula (Kinnarodden) reaches about 71.13°N, 27.7°E. Further east, Vardø is at 70.37°N, 31.1°E, and the Varanger peninsula's northern coast near Vadsø is at about 70.07°N, 29.7°E. The coast at 29°E lies around 70.4°N (near Gamvik/Berlevåg area, with Berlevåg at 70.86°N, 29.09°E). Berlevåg at 70.86°N is on the coast, so 71.0°N lies just north of it, in the Barents Sea.

Water

1725.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 31.0°E is in northern Norway, in Finnmark. Nordkinn peninsula's northern tip (Kinnarodden) is around 71.13°N, 27.65°E, and Nordkapp is at 71.17°N, 25.8°E. At 31°E, the coast near Vardø sits at about 70.37°N, 31.1°E, so 71.0°N is about 40 nautical miles north of Vardø, in the Barents Sea.

Water

1726.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 33.0°E is in northern Norway/Russia. The Varanger Peninsula sits at about 70°N, 30°E, and Kola's northern coast is around 69.5°N at 33°E. At 71°N the position is in the Barents Sea, north of the coast, so this is water.

**Water**

1727.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 35.0°E lies in the Barents Sea, north of the Kola Peninsula and Norway's Varanger area. The northern coast of Norway is near 71°N at around 25–28°E (Nordkinn is at 71.1°N, 27.7°E), and the Kola coast at 35°E is around 69°N. So at 71°N, 35°E, it is open sea.

Water

1728.text:
The point 71.0°N, 37.0°E lies in the Barents Sea, north of the Kola Peninsula and the Rybachy Peninsula. The northern coast of Russia and Norway's Finnmark is at about 69-70°N here. At 37°E, the Kola coast is around 69.3°N, so 71°N is well north of it, in open water.

Water

1729.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 39.0°E is in the Barents Sea, north of Norway's Varanger and the Kola Peninsula. The northern coast of the Kola Peninsula is at about 69°N, and Rybachy Peninsula is at about 69.7°N, 32°E. The Norwegian North Cape is at 71.17°N, 25.8°E. At 39°E the coast is at about 67–68°N, so 71°N is well out at sea.

Water

1730.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 41.0°E is in the Barents Sea, north of the Kola Peninsula (which sits at about 67-69°N). The northern coast of Norway and Russia near 41°E is around 67-69°N. At 71°N it is open sea.

Water

1731.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, Longitude 43.0°E is in the Barents Sea, north of the Kola Peninsula (which sits around 67-69°N) and northeast of Norway's North Cape (71.1°N, 25.8°E). At 43°E, the Russian coast near Kanin Peninsula lies around 68°N, and Novaya Zemlya begins around 52°E and farther east. So 71°N, 43°E is open sea.

Water

1732.text:
Latitude 71°N, longitude 45°E is in the Barents Sea, north of the Kola Peninsula (which sits at about 67-69°N). Novaya Zemlya is further east, at about 52-69°E. The Russian mainland coast near 45°E is around 66-68°N, and Kanin Peninsula's tip is near 68.5°N, 43°E. So 71°N, 45°E is open sea.

Water

1733.text:
Latitude 71°N, longitude 47°E is in the Barents Sea, north of Kola Peninsula (which is around 67-69°N). Novaya Zemlya starts around 51-52°E at its southern end (Kara Strait at ~70°N, 58°E; the southwestern tip near Matochkin... actually the southern island's western coast is about 51-53°E at 71°N). At 47°E and 71°N, that's water.

Water

1734.text:
Latitude 71°N, longitude 49°E is in the Barents Sea region. Novaya Zemlya sits at about 51°E to 69°E, with its western coast near 52°E at latitude 71°N. Kolguev Island is at about 69°N, 49°E, with its extent from roughly 68.5° to 69.5°N. So 71°N, 49°E lies north of Kolguev, in the Barents Sea (the Pechora Sea region). Novaya Zemlya's southern part at 71°N has a west coast around 52-53°E, so 49°E is water.

Water

1735.text:
Latitude 71°N, longitude 51°E. That is in the Barents Sea, east of the North Cape, north of Kola Peninsula (which lies around 67-69°N). Novaya Zemlya's southern island begins around 70.5°N, 52-55°E. At 51°E, 71°N, the Pechora Sea/Barents Sea... Novaya Zemlya's southwestern tip is near Cape Kussov Nos, around 70.6°N, 53°E. So 51°E is west of that, which is water.

**Water**

1736.text:
Latitude 71.0°N, longitude 53.0°E. That's in the Barents Sea/Pechora Sea area. Novaya Zemlya's southern island spans roughly 70.5–73°N, with longitude about 52–57°E. At 71°N, the west coast of Novaya Zemlya lies around 52–53°E. The southern island's southwestern coast: Cape Kharitona near 70.6°N, 52.5°E? Actually Matochkin Shar is at 73°N, 56°E. The southwest of Yuzhny Island: Belushya Guba is at 71.5°N, 52.3°E. So the coast at 71°N is around 52.5–53°E; Kostin Shar is at about 71.0°N, 53.5°E?? Kostin Shar strait is at ~71.3°N, 54°E. Belushya Guba at 71.54°N, 52.32°E is on the coast, so at 71.0°N the coast is probably slightly east of 52°E, roughly 53°E... Cape Kharitona (Mys Kharitona) is around 70.9°N, 53.5°E? Coast runs southeast toward Cape Kanin Nos... Southwest coast of Novaya Zemlya heads toward Kara Gate (70.5°N, 58°E), so at 71°N the coast is around 53–54°E. Thus 53.0 is probably just offshore water.

**Water**

1737.text:
Latitude 71°N, longitude 55°E is in the Arctic. Novaya Zemlya spans roughly 70.5°N–77°N and 51°E–69°E. The southern island's western coast near 71°N lies around 52–55°E. Matochkin Shar strait is at about 73.3°N. At 71°N, Novaya Zemlya's southern island has its west coast near Belushya Guba (71.5°N, 52.3°E). The island is fairly narrow and runs northeast, so at 71°N the land might extend from about 53°E to 56°E or so. Kara Strait lies at about 70.5°N, 58°E. Yuzhny Island's southern tip is near Cape Kharlov... the Kara Gate strait is at 70.5°N, with land to the north at 71°N around 55°E. The point is likely land.

Land

1738.text:
Latitude 71°N, longitude 57°E. That is in the Barents Sea region, east of Novaya Zemlya's southern tip? Novaya Zemlya's southern island spans roughly 70.5–73°N and 51.5–57°E. At 71°N, the west coast is around 52–53°E and the island extends east to the Kara Strait at about 70.5°N, 58°E. Matochkin Shar strait is at 73.3°N. So at 71°N, 57°E, the point is likely on the southern island. The island's east coast at 71°N is around 56–57°E (Kara Sea coast, e.g., Belushya Guba at 71.5°N, 52.3°E on the west coast). The east coast near 71°N is about 55–57°E (Russkaya Gavan is further north). Roughly, the southern island narrows toward the south, with Cape Kharaulakh... Kara Strait at ~70.0°N. Near 71°N, the island spans about 52°E to 57.5°E, so the point is likely land.

Land

1739.text:
Latitude 71°N, longitude 59°E. This is in the Kara Sea region, east of Novaya Zemlya. Novaya Zemlya spans roughly 51°E to 69°E longitude, with the southern island at around 70.5-71.5°N at about 55-58°E on its west coast... Let me think: Novaya Zemlya's southern island (Yuzhny) includes Belushya Guba at 71.5°N, 52°E. The Kara Gates strait is at about 70.5°N, 55-58°E. Matochkin Shar strait is at about 73.3°N. So at 71°N, the southern island's west coast is around 52-53°E, and the east coast is around 57-58°E at that latitude (Kara Sea coast near 70.7°N, 58°E?). The southern island's northeast extends: Cape Zhelaniya is at 77°N, 69°E, so the island trends northeast. At 71°N, the east coast is approximately 55-56°E... Checking: Greenland's east coast runs from Cape Dalton (69.4°N, 24.9°W) to Kangerlussuaq (68°N, 32°W). Coast at 68°N is around 31-32°W, and at 69.4°N it's around 25°W. Therefore 29°W lies inland, over land (the ice-covered coastal mountains).

So at 69°N the coast stretches roughly between 32°W (Kangerlussuaq) and 22°W (Scoresby Sund mouth, around 70.5°N). The point at 27°W, 69°N is in the sea, east of the coast, which runs northeast from Kangerlussuaq (68.6°N, 32°W) to Kap Brewster (70.1°N, 22°W). At 27°W the coast latitude would be roughly 69.3°N. So 69.0 is slightly south of the coast, hence water. Though the Blosseville Coast: Kap Dalton at 69.4°N, 24.0°W; Kap Tobin at 70.4°N, 21.9°W. Coast at 27°W approx 68.5–69°N... The Blosseville coast near 68.3°N, 28°W? Watkins Bjerge are at 68°N, 30°W near the coast; Nansen Fjord 68°N, 32°W. Coast at 27°W is probably around 68.8°N. Hmm, borderline, but I'll say Water.

Latitude 67.0°N, longitude 43.0°E lies on Russia's Kola Peninsula. The White Sea is to the south, and its Kandalaksha Gulf lies to the southwest. The White Sea's Gorlo (the strait) lies near 66–67°N, 41–43°E.

The Gorlo runs between the Tersky Coast (Kola, about 66.2–66.5°N) and the Kanin Peninsula (Zimny Coast, about 66.5–67°N, 41–44°E). The Zimny Coast of the White Sea sits at roughly 66.5°N at 41°E, and the Kanin Peninsula's southern coast is around 67°N at 43°E. The Gorlo is about 50 km wide, so at 43°E the strait spans roughly 66.2–67°N, which makes 67.0°N, 43°E borderline. The Kanin Peninsula's southwest coast runs from Cape Kanin Nos (68.6°N, 43.3°E) southeast toward the Mezen Bay. The Voronov Cape area is near 67.9°N, and the Zimny Coast, near 66.5°N, 41°E, runs northeast to about 67.1°N, 41.5°E. At 43°E, the coast near Mezen Bay's north side is around 66.5°N. At -65 longitude, the northern Quebec coast is around 60.3 N (Cape Hopes Advance is at 61.0 N, -69.5). Near -65, the coast of Labrador/Quebec is around 59-60 N. Baffin Island's Cape Dyer region is farther north-east; the Meta Incognita Peninsula's southern coast near -65 is around 62.5 N. So 61.0 N is in the middle of Hudson Strait, which is water.

**Water**

2578.text:
Latitude 61.0 N, longitude -63.0 W. This is near Ungava Bay / Hudson Strait area. Ungava Bay lies roughly 58-61N, 65-68W. Hudson Strait is about 62N. At 63W, 61N: the Quebec coast at Ungava Peninsula's northeast tip is near Cape Chidley (60.4N, 64.4W) in Labrador. Baffin Island's Meta Incognita Peninsula is at about 62-63N. So 61N, 63W is in Hudson Strait, south of Resolution Island (61.5N, 65W). Hudson Strait width there: Labrador coast at 60.4N, Resolution Island/Baffin at ~62N+. Point 61N, 63W is water.

Water

2579.text:

The Labrador coast's easternmost point is about 55.5°W at 53°N; at 60°N (Killiniq Island), longitude is about 64.5°W. So 61°N, 61°W is east of the coast, in the Labrador Sea. Baffin Island is further north (Cumberland Peninsula at 65°N). Greenland's southern tip is at 60°N, 44°W. So it's water.

Water

2580.text:

So 57°W is well east of that, in the water.

Water

The west coast near 61°N lies at approximately 48.0°W (the Julianehåb area has fjords extending out to about 48-49°W). Paamiut is at 62.0°N, 49.7°W. At 61°N, the coast is around 48.5°W, I think, with Labrador Sea to the west. So -49.0 is probably just offshore.

**Water**

The west coast near 61 N is around Nanortalik (60.1 N, 45.2 W), and Qaqortoq (60.7 N, 46.0 W). Paamiut is at 62.0 N, 49.7 W. At 61 N the west coast lies around 48-49 W, since the coast runs northwest from Qaqortoq, and Julianehåb Bay sits at about 61 N, 47-48 W. The Qaqortoq area is at 46 W, 60.7 N. Further north, the Sermersooq fjords: Arsuk is at 61.2 N, 48.2 W. So at 61.0 N, 47.0 W, we are east of Arsuk, which puts the point inland. Greenland's ice sheet edge there is land, so it is land.

Land

2587.text:

So 45°W at 61°N falls between them, which is inland, on the ice sheet or mountains of South Greenland.

Checking the fjords: Qaqortoq sits at about 60.7°N, 46°W. Narsarsuaq is at 61.15°N, 45.4°W. So 61.0°N, 45.0°W is just southeast of Narsarsuaq, which is land (the Tunulliarfik fjord is at about 45.5–46°W). Land.

2588.text:

At 43 W and 61 N, the east coast of Greenland is near there. The coast near Cape Farewell goes northeast: Prins Christian Sund is at about 60.0 N, 43.5 W. Farther northeast, Nanortalik is at 60.1 N, 45.2 W. On the east coast, Skjoldungen is at about 63.2 N, 41.5 W, and Ikertivaq at about 61 N, 42 W. Tingmiarmiut is at about 62.5 N, 42 W. So at 61 N the east coast lies near 42.5-43 W. The coast near 60.8 N is at around 43.0 W, so this is borderline. Qiternaq? Looking at the southeast coast, Cape Farewell is at 59.77 N, 43.9 W, and the coast goes northeast to about 61 N, 42.0 W. Point 61, -43 would be inland, since the coast at 61 N is near 42 W, with the land extending west. The point lies west of the coast, so it is land (the ice cap).

Land

**Water**

The Okhotsk coast near 57°N lies around 135-137°E (Okhotsk town is at 59.4N, 143.2E). The Ayan area is at 56.4N, 138.1E. Shantar Islands are at 55N, 137E. At 57N, 137E, the coast runs from Ayan (56.45N, 138.15E) northwest toward Udskaya Bay (~54.5N, 135.5E)... actually Ayan is on the coast, and the coast north of there goes northeast to Okhotsk. Going southwest from Ayan, the coast goes to Udskaya Bay near 54N, 137E. So at 57N, 137E, the point is inland west of Ayan, hence land.

Land

3039.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 139.0°E. This lies in the Okhotsk region of Russia. The coast of the Sea of Okhotsk near Okhotsk town is at about 59.4°N, 143.2°E. At 57°N, the coast near Ayan is about 56.5°N, 138.2°E. Ayan sits on the coast at 56.45°N, 138.15°E. The point 57.0°N, 139.0°E is inland from there, since the coast runs northeast from Ayan. At longitude 139, the coast is around 57.2°N, I think (the Shantar region coast near Cape Select is around 57°N, 137°E, Udskaya Bay is 54°N). The coast between Ayan and Okhotsk runs northeast: Ayan 56.45, 138.15; Nelkan is inland. The coast at 139°E is probably about 57.0–57.3°N, so the point is borderline, though likely land.

Land

3040.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 141.0°E. This is in the Sea of Okhotsk region. The coast of Russia near Okhotsk is at about 59.4°N, 143.2°E. Ayan is at 56.45°N, 138.15°E. At 57°N, the coastline runs from Ayan northeast toward Okhotsk. The Shantar Islands are at about 55°N, 137-138°E. Between Ayan (138°E) and Okhotsk (143°E), the coast at 141°E is roughly 58.5°N. The Okhotsk coast near 141°E: Nelkan is inland at 57.6°N, 136°E. The Ulbansky Bay is around 54°N, 137°E. Coast at 141°E: Cape Nikolay near 59°N, 143°E... the coast along 141°E is probably around 59°N (Okhotsk-Ayan coast, Uda Bay is at 55°N, 135°E). Ayan at 56.5°N, 138°E, then the coast heads northeast to Okhotsk at 59.4°N, 143.2°E. At 141°E, about 58.2°N. So 57°N is south of the coast, i.e., in the sea.

**Water**

3041.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 143.0°E is in the Okhotsk region. The Sea of Okhotsk's northwestern coast lies near 59°N at 143°E (Okhotsk town is at 59.4°N, 143.2°E). Ayan is at 56.4°N, 138.2°E. At longitude 143°E, the coast runs roughly from Okhotsk (59.4°N, 143.3°E) east toward Magadan (59.5°N, 150.8°E) and west to Ayan (56.4°N, 138°E). The Shantar Islands are around 55°N, 137-138°E. At 143°E the coast is about 59°N, so 57°N lies about 2° south of the coast, which would be in the sea.

Checking: the coast between Ayan (138°E, 56.5°N) and Okhotsk (143°E, 59.4°N) runs diagonally, so at 143°E the coast is near 59°N. The point at 57°N, 143°E is therefore south of the coast, in the Sea of Okhotsk.

Water

3042.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 145.0°E. This is in the Sea of Okhotsk region. The coast of Russia near Okhotsk is at about 59.4°N, 143.2°E. At 57°N, the coast runs near 138-140°E (Ayan at 56.4°N, 138.2°E). So 145°E at 57°N is north of Sakhalin and east of the coast, which puts it in the Sea of Okhotsk.

Water

3043.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 147.0°E (assuming east). That falls in the Sea of Okhotsk, with the coast near Okhotsk at about 59.4°N, 143.2°E. At 57°N, the coast near the Ayan area is around 56.5°N, 138°E. Between 138 and 143°E, the coast runs from Ayan up to Okhotsk. At 147°E, 57°N, the point is north of Sakhalin and east of the coast, so it's in the Sea of Okhotsk. Magadan is at 59.5°N, 150.8°E, and the coast there runs south-west, so at 57°N the coast lies around 142°E or further west. The point at 147°E is therefore water.

Water

3044.text:
Latitude 57.0, longitude 149.0 is ambiguous because the longitude has no hemisphere. If it is 149°E, the point lies in the Sea of Okhotsk, with the coast near 59°N at Magadan and Sakhalin farther south, so it is water. If it is 149°W, the point lies in the Gulf of Alaska south of Kodiak, which is also water.

At 149°E, 57°N, the Okhotsk coast sits around 59°N at 150°E, and the area south of that is sea. Both readings give water.

**Water**

3045.text:
Latitude 57.0, longitude 151.0 (assuming east) is in the Sea of Okhotsk. The Siberian coast near Okhotsk is at about 59.4°N, 143°E, and the Kamchatka west coast is at about 160°E. At 57°N, the coast of the Okhotsk region runs from around 138°E at Ayan (56.5°N, 138°E) to Magadan (59.5°N, 151°E). So at 57°N, 151°E, the point lies south of Magadan, in the Sea of Okhotsk. Magadan's coast is at about 59.5°N, and the Koni Peninsula is at about 59°N, 151°E. So 57°N is water.

If the longitude were west, 151°W at 57°N would be in the Gulf of Alaska near Kodiak, where Kodiak Island is at about 153°W. At 151°W, 57°N is water south of the Kenai Peninsula, but the question as given says 151.0, so east.

Water

3046.text:
Latitude 57.0, Longitude 153.0 — assuming East longitude, that's in the Sea of Okhotsk (Sakhalin is at 142-143E, the Okhotsk coast at 143E at 59N). At 57N, 153E, the Kamchatka peninsula lies at about 156-160E, so 153E at 57N is in the Sea of Okhotsk, west of Kamchatka's west coast (~156E at 57N). So water.

If it were West longitude, 57N 153W is in the Gulf of Alaska near Kodiak Island (Kodiak is at 57.5N, 153.5W)... Kodiak spans roughly 152.3-154.5W at 56.8-58.0N. Ambiguous, but the default is positive = East.

**Water**

3047.text:
Latitude 57.0, longitude 155.0 is ambiguous on its own, since the sign of the longitude isn't given. Taken as 155°E, the point is in the Sea of Okhotsk, west of Kamchatka. The Okhotsk coast near 59°N is around 143-155°E, and at 57°N, 155°E the Kamchatka west coast sits around 156°E. Kamchatka's west coast at 57°N is roughly 156.0°E, so 155°E is just offshore, which is water.

If the longitude were 155°W, the point would be in the Gulf of Alaska south of the Alaska Peninsula, which is also water. Both readings give water.

Water

3048.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 157.0°E lies on the Kamchatka Peninsula, whose west coast on the Sea of Okhotsk is at about 156°E near 57°N. At 57°N, the west coast of Kamchatka runs around 156°E. Longitude 157°E at 57°N would therefore be inland, a bit east of the coast. The peninsula at that latitude spans from about 156°E to 162°E, so 157°E is land.

Land

3049.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 159.0°E falls on the Kamchatka Peninsula. The peninsula runs from about 51°N to 62°N, and at 57°N its western coast is near 156°E, with the eastern coast near 162°E. So 159°E is inland, on land.

Land

3050.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 161.0°E falls on the Kamchatka Peninsula, which runs roughly from 51°N to 62°N between about 156°E and 163°E. At 57°N the peninsula's west coast is near 156°E and its east coast near 162°E, so 161°E is inland, though close to the east coast. The east coast near 57°N is around 162.5°E (near Ust-Kamchatsk at 56.2°N, 162.5°E), so the point is on land.

Land

3051.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 163.0°E. Kamchatka Peninsula spans roughly 156°E–164°E, with latitudes 51–61°N. At 57°N, the east coast lies around 163°E? Kamchatka's east coast at 57°N: Karaginsky Gulf is further north (58-59°N). At 57°N, the east coast is around 162.5°E (near Ust-Kamchatsk at 56.2°N, 162.5°E). Ust-Kamchatsk is at 56.2°N, 162.5°E on the Kamchatka River mouth. The coast near 57°N: the Kronotsky Peninsula is at 54°N, 161°E. North of Ust-Kamchatsk, the coast heads northeast toward Cape Kamchatsky (56.2°N, 163.3°E). Cape Kamchatsky is at about 56.1°N, 163.2°E. North of that, the coast goes northwest into Kamchatsky Gulf and the Karaginsky area: at 57°N the coast is around 162.0°E (Kamchatsky Bay's western shore). So 163°E at 57°N is in the water.

**Water**

3052.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 165.0°E is in the Bering Sea / western Pacific area. Kamchatka's east coast sits around 160°E at 57°N, and the peninsula extends to about 163°E at its widest near 56°N. At 165°E the position is east of Kamchatka, in the Bering Sea, since Karaginsky Island lies near 20°E of 164°E at about 58.5°N, which is farther north. So this point is water.

Water

3053.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 167.0°E lies in the Bering Sea / northwestern Pacific, east of Kamchatka. Kamchatka's east coast is around 160-163°E at that latitude, and the Commander Islands are at about 55°N, 166°E. At 57°N, 167°E the point is in open water.

Water

3054.text:
Latitude 57.0, longitude 169.0 (assumed East) is in the Bering Sea area? Longitude 169°E at 57°N: Kamchatka's east coast lies around 160-163°E at that latitude, and the Commander Islands are at about 166°E, 55°N. So 169°E, 57°N is open water in the Bering Sea.

If it were 169°W, it would be in the Bering Sea too, north of the Aleutians. Either way, water.

Water

3055.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 171.0°E is in the Bering Sea, east of Kamchatka. Kamchatka's east coast is at about 163°E at this latitude, and the Commander Islands lie near 166°E. At 171°E there is open water.

Water

3056.text:
Latitude 57.0, longitude 173.0 (east, presumably). That's in the Bering Sea region? Longitude 173°E at 57°N: Kamchatka's east coast is around 160-163°E at that latitude. Commander Islands are at ~166°E, 55°N. So 173°E, 57°N is in the Bering Sea, which is water.

If it were 173°W, it would be in the Bering Sea too, south of the Aleutians? Aleutians are at 52°N, so 57°N is the Bering Sea, also water.

**Water**

3057.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 175.0°E. This is in the Bering Sea, east of Kamchatka (Kamchatka's east coast is around 163°E at 57°N). Further east, the Aleutian chain is at about 52°N, and the Commander Islands are at about 55°N, 166°E. So 57°N, 175°E is open water.

Water

3058.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 177.0°E is in the Bering Sea, east of Kamchatka, which lies at about 160°E. The Commander Islands are near 55°N, 166°E, which is far to the west. The Aleutians sit at about 52°N, and the point at 177°E is nowhere near them. So this is open water.

Water

3059.text:
Latitude 57.0°N, longitude 179.0°E is in the Bering Sea, east of Kamchatka. Kamchatka's east coast is around 163°E at that latitude. The Koryak coast near 60°N reaches about 170°E. At 57°N, 179°E is far out in the Bering Sea, so it is water.

Water

3060.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -179.0 (179°W) is in the Bering Sea, south of the Aleutian chain's western portion. The Aleutians at 179°W lie near Semisopochnoi/Amchitka at about 51-52°N, so 55°N is well north of them in the open Bering Sea. The Bering Sea's deep basin lies there, and the Pribilof Islands are at 57°N, 170°W, which is far east.

Water

3061.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 177.0°W is in the Bering Sea / North Pacific, south of the Aleutian Islands. The Aleutians sit at about 52-55°N, but that longitude (177°W) is near Amchitka/Adak (Adak is at 176.6°W, 51.9°N). At 55°N the point is well north of the Aleutian chain at that longitude, which sits around 51-52°N, so it lies in the open Bering Sea.

Water

3062.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 175.0°W is in the North Pacific. The Aleutian Islands lie around 51-55°N, stretching from about 172°E to 165°W. At 175°W the islands are near 51-52°N (Amchitka is at 179°E, Adak at 176.6°W, 51.9°N). At 55°N and 175°W, that's about 3° north of the Aleutians, in the Bering Sea, so it's water.

Water

3063.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 173.0°W lies in the Bering Sea / North Pacific, south of the Aleutian Islands. The Aleutians at around 52–55°N stretch from about 165°W to 170°W near Unimak and Unalaska (166°W). Further west, Attu is at 173°E. Between 170°W and 180°, there are the Islands of Four Mountains (170°W, 52.8°N) and Andreanof Islands (176°W–180°, ~52°N). At 55°N, 173°W, this is north of the Aleutian chain, in the Bering Sea, so it is water.

Water

3064.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -171.0° (171°W) is in the Bering Sea, south of the Pribilof Islands and north of the Aleutians. The Aleutian Islands are at about 52-54°N, and at 171°W the nearest land would be well to the south. So this point is water.

Water

3065.text:
The point 55.0°N, 169.0°W lies in the Bering Sea, south of the Pribilof Islands and north of the Aleutians. The Aleutian chain near Umnak and Unalaska sits around 53–54°N and 166–168°W, which is further east and south. At 55°N and 169°W, it is north of Samalga Pass, which is around 169°W at 52.8°N. So this point is open water.

Water

3066.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 167.0°W is in the Bering Sea / North Pacific, near the Aleutian Islands. Unimak Island lies at about 54.8°N, 164°W, and Unalaska at 53.9°N, 166.5°W. At 55.0°N, 167.0°W, the point is north of Unalaska (53.9°N), west of Unimak, and south of the Pribilofs (57°N). The Aleutians near 167°W include Umnak (53.0°N, 168°W) and Unalaska, both south of 55°N. So this point is open water.

Water

3067.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 165.0°W is in the North Pacific, south of the Alaska Peninsula and the Aleutian Islands. Unimak Island and the nearby Aleutians sit around 54.5°N, 164°W to 165°W. Unimak Island spans roughly 54.4°N to 54.9°N and 163°W to 164.8°W, and its northwestern tip is near 54.8°N, 164.9°W. Akutan is at 54.1°N, 165.9°W. Unalaska is at 53.9°N, 166.5°W. At 55.0°N, 165.0°W, the point is just north of Unimak's western end, which is in the Bering Sea. The Bering Sea coast of Unimak reaches about 54.9°N near 164.5°W, and Cape Sarichef is at 54.6°N, 164.9°W. So 55.0°N is slightly north of the island's coast, which makes it water.

Water

3068.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -163.0° (163°W) falls south of the Alaska Peninsula. The Shumagin Islands sit near 55.2°N, 160°W, and Unimak Island is near 54.8°N, 164°W. At 163°W, the peninsula's coast near Cold Bay and Sanak is around 55°N. Sanak Island is at 54.4°N, 162.7°W, and the Alaska Peninsula's southern coast near Port Moller is at 55.9°N, 160.5°W.

At 163°W the peninsula runs from about 55.0°N (Cold Bay is at 55.2°N, 162.7°W). Cold Bay is on the north side of the peninsula, with the Pacific coast to the south around 54.9°N. Izembek Lagoon is at 55.3°N, 162.8°W. Pavlof Bay is at 55.4°N, 161.9°W. Morzhovoi Bay is at 54.9°N, 163.3°W, so the point 55.0, -163.0 lies on the land just north of the head of Morzhovoi Bay, which reaches up to roughly 55.0°N. It is likely land, near the isthmus.

**Land**

3069.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -161.0° (161°W) falls near the Alaska Peninsula. Nearby points: Sand Point on Popof Island is at about 55.3°N, 160.5°W. Shumagin Islands are at about 55.0°N, 159.5°W. The Alaska Peninsula's south coast near Port Moller (55.9°N, 160.5°W) and Cold Bay (55.2°N, 162.7°W). Unimak Island is at about 54.8°N, 164°W.

At 161°W, the peninsula coast runs from Cold Bay (162.7°W, 55.2°N) to Port Moller (160.5°W, 56.0°N). At 161°W the coast would be around 55.7°N. So 55.0°N is south of the coast, in the Pacific Ocean. The Shumagins' western islands, such as Unga (160.5°W, 55.2°N) and Nagai (160.0°W, 54.9°N), lie to the east. West of 160.7°W at 55.0°N seems to be water.

Water

3070.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -159.0° (159°W). The Alaska Peninsula lies along roughly 55°N at about 160°W. Near 159°W, 55°N: the Alaska Peninsula's southern coast near Port Moller sits at about 55.9°N, 160.5°W. Further northeast, the coast runs toward Chignik (56.3°N, 158.4°W). The Shumagin Islands are around 55.0°N, 159.5°W (Nagai Island ~54.9°N, 160.0°W; Unga Island ~55.2°N, 160.5°W). At 159.0°W, 55°N, that's south of the peninsula (the coast there is about 56.0°N), east of the Shumagins' eastern edge (Chernabura, Simeonof ~54.9°N, 159.3°W). Simeonof Island is at roughly 54.92°N, 159.28°W. Point 55.0, -159.0 is about 20 km northeast of it. Islands there: Bird Island, Spitz Island... likely open water.

Water

3071.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 157.0°W lies south of the Alaska Peninsula. The peninsula's southern coast at longitude 157°W is around 56°N (near Chignik at 158°W, 56.3°N). The Shumagin Islands are near 160°W, 55°N. At 157°W, 55°N, that is about 120 km south of the coast, in the Pacific Ocean.

Water

3072.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -155.0° (155°W) lies south of the Alaska Peninsula. The peninsula near 155°W sits at about 57-58°N, and Kodiak Island is at about 57°N, 153-154°W. At 55°N, 155°W the point is in the Gulf of Alaska/North Pacific, south of the Shumagin Islands, which are near 55°N, 160°W. So this is water.

Water

3073.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 153.0°W is in the Gulf of Alaska. Kodiak Island sits at about 57°N, 153°W, and its southern tip is near 56.5°N. The Alaska Peninsula lies further northwest, around 55°N, 160°W. At 55°N, 153°W there is no land nearby, so this point is open ocean south of Kodiak.

Water

3074.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 151.0°W is in the Gulf of Alaska, south of the Alaska Peninsula and south of Kodiak Island. Kodiak sits around 57°N, 153°W, and the Trinity Islands are near 56°N, 154°W. At 55°N, 151°W the point is well southeast of those, so it is open ocean.

Water

3075.text:
55°N, 149°W is in the Gulf of Alaska, south of the Alaska Peninsula/Kodiak. Kodiak Island is at about 57.5°N, 153°W. The coast near 60°N is at 149°W, so 55°N is about 500 km offshore.

Water

3076.text:
55°N, 147°W is in the Gulf of Alaska, south of Kodiak Island (which is around 57°N, 153°W). The Alaska coast near Yakutat is at about 59.5°N, 139.7°W. At 55°N, 147°W, the position is well offshore in the open Gulf of Alaska.

Water

3077.text:
55°N, 145°W is in the Gulf of Alaska, southeast of Kodiak and south of Yakutat. The Alaskan coast near Yakutat is at about 59.5°N, 139.7°W, and the Alaska panhandle's outer coast around 55°N sits near 133°W. So 145°W at 55°N is well offshore in the Pacific.

Water

3078.text:
Latitude 55.0 N, longitude -143.0 W is in the Gulf of Alaska, southeast of Kodiak and well offshore from the Alaska panhandle coast, which lies around -135 to -130 at that latitude. The nearest land is far away.

Water

3079.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -141.0° (141°W) is in the Gulf of Alaska. The Alaska panhandle coast near 141°W lies at around 60°N, and at 55°N the panhandle's islands sit east of about 133°W. So 141°W at 55°N is open ocean.

Water

3080.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, Longitude 139.0°W is in the Gulf of Alaska. The Alaska panhandle coast lies around 135°W at that latitude, and Haida Gwaii is near 132°W. At 139°W and 55°N, that is well offshore in the Pacific.

Water

3081.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 137.0°W is in the northeastern Pacific Ocean, west of the Alaska Panhandle and Haida Gwaii. The coast of the Alaska Panhandle near Baranof Island lies around 135°W at 57°N, and at 55°N the coast is near 131°W. Haida Gwaii is at about 132°W. So 137°W is roughly 400 km offshore, which is open ocean.

Water

3082.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude 135.0°W is in southeast Alaska, near the Alexander Archipelago. Prince of Wales Island sits at about 55.5°N, 133°W. Baranof Island is at about 57°N, 135°W. At 55°N, 135°W, the point is west of Prince of Wales Island, which extends west to about 133.6°W. Dall Island is at about 133.0°W, 54.9°N. So 135°W lies in open water, in the Pacific. The coast of the outer archipelago at 55°N is around 133.5°W, which puts the point about 1.5° west, in the ocean.

Water

3083.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -133.0°W lies in southeast Alaska, near Prince of Wales Island. Prince of Wales Island spans roughly 55.0–56.3°N and 133.9–132.5°W, so the point could fall on the island. The island's northeast area near Craig is at about 55.48°N, 133.15°W. Its southern portion near Hydaburg is at 55.2°N, 132.8°W. The southern tip at Cape Chacon is around 54.7°N, 132.0°W.

At 55.0°N, 133.0°W, the island's west coast near Hydaburg is about 55.2°N, 132.83°W. The west coast at 55.0°N is probably around 132.9–133.0°W, since the coast runs southeast from Cape Felix toward Cape Chacon. Dixon Entrance lies south. Moving south along the west side: Klawock is at 55.55°N, 133.1°W, Craig at 55.48°N, 133.15°W, and Hydaburg at 55.2°N, 132.83°W. Prince of Wales Island's southwest side includes Cordova Bay to the west and Kasaan to the east. Near 55.0°N, the island spans roughly 132.2–132.9°W, with Cordova Bay to the west at about 133.0°W. Dall Island is at about 133.0°W, with latitudes 54.9–55.2°N, so the point could fall on Dall Island or in the water of Cordova Bay. Dall Island's longitude range is about 133.1–132.95°W... The point is close to the boundary, and I can't settle it.

Water

3084.text:
Latitude 55.0 N, longitude -131.0 W is in southeast Alaska, near the Alaska panhandle. Prince of Wales Island lies around 55.5 N, 133 W. The mainland coast near Hyder is at about 55.9 N, 130 W. At 55.0 N, 131.0 W, this is near Revillagigedo Island (Ketchikan at 55.34 N, 131.64 W). Annette Island is at 55.1 N, 131.5 W. Point 131.0 W is east of that, which is Behm Canal and the mainland. Behm Canal's eastern side lies around 130.9 W at 55.5 N. At 55.0 N, 131.0 W, that's near Portland Canal's southern area. Portland Canal runs from 55.9 N down to about 54.8 N at 130.0 W. Dixon Entrance is at 54.7 N. The mainland between Revillagigedo and Portland Canal at 55.0 N is the Cleveland Peninsula/Misty Fiords area, which is land. Revillagigedo Island's eastern part is at about 131.0 W near 55.0 N, with Behm Canal on its west. Tongass Narrows is at 131.7 W. Revillagigedo's southeast has George Inlet and Carroll Inlet. Behm Canal's southern part, Behm Narrows, is at about 55.7 N. The area at 55.0 N, 131.0 W is the south end of Revillagigedo Island, near Nichols Passage and Cape Fox to the east at about 130.9 W, 55.0 N. Cape Fox is on the mainland at about 55.03 N, 130.9 W. So 131.0 W is just west of Cape Fox, likely around Foggy Bay, which is water, or Revillagigedo's south coast. Foggy Bay is about 55.0 N, 130.95 W. So probably water.

Water

3085.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -129.0°W is in British Columbia, Canada, near the northwest coast. Prince Rupert sits at about 54.3°N, 130.3°W. At 55.0°N, 129.0°W, we're east of the Portland Canal area... Portland Canal runs along about 130.0°W at 55.9°N. Kitimat is at 54.05°N, 128.65°W. Terrace is at 54.5°N, 128.6°W. Point 55.0, -129.0 is north of Terrace by about 0.5°, and slightly west, in the Coast Mountains near the Nass River region. The Nass River valley is at about 55.0°N, 129.0°W (Nass valley near Gitwinksihlkw is at 55.1°N, 129.0°W). Either way, it's land.

Land

3086.text:
Latitude 55.0°N, longitude -127.0° is in British Columbia, Canada, near Hazelton/Smithers. Smithers is at 54.78, -127.17. So 55.0, -127.0 is inland, north of Smithers, in the Bulkley Valley or Babine Mountains area. That's land.

Land

3087.text:
Latitude 55.0 N, Longitude -125.0 W is in British Columbia, Canada. The coast near Prince Rupert is at about -130, and Hecate Strait lies around -130 to -131. At 55°N, -125 is inland, in the interior near Williston Lake and Germansen Landing, so it's land.

**Land**

**Water**

Water

**Water**

Mawlamyine is at 16.5°N, 97.6°E. At 17°N, 97°E, we're north of the Gulf of Martaban coast. The Gulf's head is near Sittaung/Bago at about 17°N, 96.5°E. Bago is at 17.3°N, 96.5°E. Yangon is at 16.8°N, 96.2°E. The Sittaung river mouth is around 17.0°N, 96.9°E. The point at 97.0°E is east of the Sittaung mouth, so it is likely land (Kyaikto is at 17.3°N, 97.0°E). The coast near Thaton is at about 16.9°N, 97.4°E. The Gulf's northern coast lies around 17°N, so the point is borderline, but Kyaikto at 17.3 is inland by a few km, and the coast near Belin is about 17.0°N... Kyaikkami is at 16.08°N. Coast near Bilin river mouth is about 16.9°N, 97.2°E. So 17.0 is just north of this, likely land.

**Land**

6619.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 99.0°E is in northern Thailand, near Sukhothai and Tak province. That is inland, so it is land.

Land

6620.text:
Latitude 17.0 N, longitude 101.0 E is in Thailand, in the northeast near Loei province. That is land.

Land

6621.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 103.0°E is in northeastern Thailand, near the Laos border around Udon Thani and Nong Khai, which is land.

Land

6622.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, Longitude 105.0°E is in Laos/Thailand area. Around 17N 105E: Nakhon Phanom is at 17.4N, 104.8E, on the Mekong. Khammouane, Laos is at 17.4N 104.8E. So 17.0, 105.0 is land, in Laos near Savannakhet's north area.

Land

6623.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 107.0°E is in central Vietnam/Laos. The Vietnam–Laos border at that latitude lies around 106.5–107°E. The coast of Vietnam at 17°N is around 107.2°E (Quang Tri, near Dong Ha at 16.8N, 107.1E). Either way, the point is inland of the coast, in Quang Tri province or Laos. Land.

**Land**

6624.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 109.0°E. Vietnam's coast near Da Nang is at about 16°N, 108.2°E. At latitude 17°N the coast sits around 107°E (Quang Tri area, roughly 107.1°E). So 109°E is east of the coast, in the South China Sea. The Paracel Islands lie around 16.5°N, 112°E, which is further east. So this point is water.

Water

6625.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 111.0°E is in the South China Sea, east of Vietnam and southeast of Hainan. It is near the Paracel Islands, which lie at about 16.5°N, 112°E. Since 111°E is west of the main Paracels, the point is open water.

Water

6626.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 113.0°E is in the South China Sea, near the Paracel Islands (about 16.5°N, 112°E). The Paracels are small islands, and this point is east of them, so it falls in open water.

Water

6627.text:
17°N, 115°E is in the South China Sea, east of Vietnam and southeast of Hainan, west of the Philippines. It lies between the Paracel Islands (about 16.5°N, 112°E) and Macclesfield Bank (about 16°N, 114°E). So it is water.

Water

6628.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, Longitude 117.0°E is in the South China Sea, west of Luzon (Philippines) and east of Vietnam/Hainan. Luzon's west coast is around 120°E, so 117°E is in open water.

Water

6629.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 119.0°E lies in northern Luzon, Philippines. The west coast of Luzon at 17°N is around 120.3°E (Ilocos Sur coast near Vigan is ~120.4°E). So 119.0°E is roughly 1.3° west of the coast, which is in the South China Sea.

Water

6630.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 121.0°E is in northern Luzon, Philippines. That area is in the Cordillera region, near Ifugao and Mountain Province, so it is on land.

**Land**

6631.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 123.0°E is in the Philippine area. Luzon's east coast lies around 122°E at 17°N, and northern Luzon's coast at 17°N runs about 120.3°E on the west and about 122.2°E on the east. At 123°E the point is east of Luzon, in the Philippine Sea.

Water

6632.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 125.0°E is in the Philippine Sea, east of Luzon. Luzon's eastern coast is at about 122°E, so 125°E is well offshore.

Water

6633.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 127.0°E is in the Philippine Sea, east of Luzon (which spans roughly 120–122°E). That is open ocean.

Water

6634.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 129.0°E is in the Philippine Sea, east of Luzon, which lies around 121-122°E, so this point is open ocean.

Water

6635.text:
Latitude 17°N, longitude 131°E is in the Philippine Sea, east of the Philippines (which lies around 120-126°E). So it's water.

Water

6636.text:
Latitude 17.0 is 17°N, and longitude 133.0 is 133°E, which falls in the Philippine Sea, east of the Philippines and well south of Japan. That point is open ocean.

Water

6637.text:
Latitude 17°N, longitude 135°E is in the Philippine Sea, west of the Mariana Islands and south of Japan. No land is there.

Water

6638.text:
Latitude 17°N, longitude 137°E is in the Philippine Sea, far east of the Philippines and south of Japan. That is open ocean.

Water

6639.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 139.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, in the Philippine Sea, east of the Philippines and south of Japan. The nearest land is the Mariana Islands to the southeast, the Bonin and Volcano Islands to the north, and Okinotorishima to the southwest, and the point is not near any of them.

Water

6640.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 141.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean. It lies west of the Mariana Islands and east of the Philippines, and no land is nearby. The Mariana chain sits near 145°E, and the Bonin and Volcano Islands are at about 25°N, so neither reaches this point.

Water

6641.text:
Latitude 17°N, longitude 143°E is in the western Pacific, east of the Mariana Islands. The Marianas run roughly from 13°N to 20°N at about 145°E, so 143°E is west of the main chain. The Mariana Trench lies near 142–147°E at those latitudes, which puts this point in open ocean.

Water

6642.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 145.0°E is in the western Pacific, near the Mariana Islands. Pagan is at about 18.1°N, 145.8°E, Agrihan at 18.8°N, 145.7°E, and Alamagan at 17.6°N, 145.8°E. Guguan is at 17.3°N, 145.8°E. The point 17.0°N, 145.0°E lies west of these islands, in the Philippine Sea, and no island is there.

Water

6643.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 147.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Mariana Islands (which sit around 145°E). Water.

Water

6644.text:
17°N, 149°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Mariana Islands (which lie around 145°E). Tinian is at about 15°N, 145.6°E, and Pagan is at about 18°N, 145.8°E. At 149°E there is no land, so it is water.

Water

6645.text:
Latitude 17°N, longitude 151°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Mariana Islands (which are around 145°E). There is no land at that point.

Water

6646.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 153.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Mariana Islands (which sit near 145°E) and well away from any land.

Water

6647.text:
Latitude 17.0 N, longitude 155.0 W (presumably, since 155 E would be the western Pacific near the Marshall Islands/Mariana region). Either way: 17N 155W is south of the Big Island of Hawaii, which lies at about 19-20N, so it's ocean. If it's 155E, 17N is east of the Marianas (145E) and west of the Marshall Islands (165E+), so it's also ocean.

Water

6648.text:
Latitude 17.0, longitude 157.0 is ambiguous: positive longitude means 157°E, which is in the western Pacific, while 157°W is south of Hawaii. Either way it falls in open ocean. At 17°N 157°W, that is south of Hawaii's main islands (which start around 19°N at the Big Island's southern tip, with the southernmost point near 18.9°N), so it is water. At 157°E, 17°N is also open Pacific.

Water

6649.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 159.0°E (positive longitude is east) lies in the western Pacific, southwest of the Marshall Islands and north of Pohnpei. That area is open ocean. If the longitude were meant as west, 159°W at 17°N would be south of Hawaii's Big Island, which is also open ocean.

Water

6650.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 161.0°E is in the northwest Pacific Ocean, southwest of the Hawaiian Islands and east of the Marianas. There is no land at that point.

Water

6651.text:
Latitude 17°N, longitude 163°E lies in the northwestern Pacific Ocean. It is south of Wake Island (19.3°N, 166.6°E) and west of the Marshall Islands, and there is no known land at that spot.

Water

6652.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 165.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean. It lies northeast of the Marshall Islands, which are at roughly 5–15°N, 165–172°E, and the nearest land is probably Wake Island at 19.3°N, 166.6°E. Johnston Atoll is at 16.7°N, 169.5°W, which is far away. The point is open ocean.

Water

6653.text:
Latitude 17°N, longitude 167°E is in the north Pacific Ocean, in the area of the Marshall Islands (which lie roughly 5–15°N, 160–173°E) and Wake Island (19.3°N, 166.6°E). The point is about 2.3° south of Wake, which puts it in open ocean, so it is water.

Water

6654.text:
Latitude 17.0 N, longitude 169.0 E (assuming positive east) is in the central Pacific, northwest of the Marshall Islands and near Wake Island at about 19.3 N, 166.6 E. Nothing is at 17 N, 169 E, so it is open ocean.

Water

6655.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 171.0°E is in the central Pacific Ocean, west of Hawaii and northeast of the Marshall Islands. The nearest land is Wake Island, at about 19.3°N, 166.6°E, which is too far away to matter. No island sits at this point.

Water

6656.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 173.0°E lies in the north Pacific Ocean, west of Hawaii and southeast of Wake Island. The Marshall Islands are around 5-15°N, and Wake Island is at 19.3°N, 166.6°E. The point at 17°N, 173°E has no islands nearby, so it is open ocean.

Water

6658.text:
Latitude 17.0°N, longitude 177.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean. It lies northeast of the Marshall Islands and west of Hawaii, with no land nearby.

Water

6659.text:
Latitude 17.0°, longitude 179.0° (east) is in the South Pacific if the latitude is south, but here it's positive, so north. 17°N, 179°E is in the North Pacific, far north of Fiji and well southeast of Japan. It is west of Midway and Wake. There is no land there.

Water

6664.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 171°W is in the Pacific Ocean, north of Samoa and American Samoa (which are around 14°S). The point is far from any islands, and the Hawaiian Islands lie much farther north at about 20°N, 155–160°W. So this is open ocean.

Water

6665.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 169°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, southwest of Hawaii and east of the Marshall Islands. There is no land nearby, since Johnston Atoll is at about 16.7°N, 169.5°W, which is roughly 1.7° away.

Water

6667.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 165°W is in the central North Pacific, southwest of Hawaii and north of the Line Islands. Palmyra Atoll is at about 5.9°N, 162°W, and Johnston Atoll is at 16.7°N, 169.5°W. Nothing is at 15°N, 165°W.

Water

6672.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 155°W is in the Pacific Ocean, southeast of Hawaii. The Big Island of Hawaii sits at about 19-20°N, so this point is well south of it and is open ocean.

Water

6673.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, Longitude -153.0 is in the central Pacific Ocean, southeast of Hawaii (Hawaii is around 19-22 N, 155-160 W). At 15 N, 153 W, it's open ocean.

Water

6674.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -151.0 (151° W) is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and north of French Polynesia. There is no land at that point.

Water

6675.text:
The point 15°N, 149°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and north of French Polynesia, where there is no land.

Water

6678.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 143°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, southeast of Hawaii, which lies at around 20°N, 155°W. The French Polynesian islands are all south of the equator, so nothing is near this point.

Water

6693.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -113.0 W lies in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico (Revillagigedo Islands are around 18-19N, 111-112W). At 15N, 113W, it is open ocean.

Water

6694.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, Longitude -111.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico (Revillagigedo Islands are around 18-19 N, 111 W). At 15 N it is open ocean.

Water

6696.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -107.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico. The Mexican coast near Acapulco is around 17N, 100W, and at 107W the coast sits near 21-23N. So 15N, 107W is well offshore.

Water

6697.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude -105°W is in the Pacific Ocean, south of Mexico's coast (Acapulco is about 16.8N, 99.9W). At 105W, the Mexican coast sits around 19-20N, so 15N is well offshore.

Water

6698.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, Longitude -103.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, off the southwestern coast of Mexico. The Mexican coast near Acapulco is at about 16.8 N, 99.9 W, and at longitude -103 the coast is near 18 N (Michoacán/Colima coast around 18.0 N). So 15 N is about 300 km offshore, which means water.

Water

6699.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -101.0 is in the Pacific Ocean, south of Mexico. The Mexican coast near Acapulco is at about 16.8°N, 99.9°W. At 101°W the coast is around 17.5°N, so 15°N is about 250 km offshore.

Water

6700.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -99.0 is off the southern coast of Mexico. Acapulco is at about 16.86°N, 99.88°W. The coast near 99°W lies around 16.7°N, so 15.0°N is about 190 km south of it, in the Pacific Ocean.

Water

6701.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, Longitude -97.0 W. The coast of Oaxaca, Mexico: Puerto Angel is at about 15.67 N, 96.49 W. Huatulco is at about 15.75 N, 96.13 W. The coast runs southwest-to-northeast there, so at longitude -97.0 the coast is at about 15.9 N (Puerto Escondido is 15.86 N, 97.07 W). The point at 15.0 N is about 90 km south of the coast, so it is in the Pacific.

Water

6702.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -95.0 W. That's off the southern coast of Mexico, in the Pacific Ocean. The Gulf of Tehuantepec lies around 15-16°N, 95°W. The coast of Oaxaca at longitude -95 is about 16.0°N. So 15.0 is south of the coast, in the water.

Water

6703.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -93.0 is off the southern coast of Mexico/Guatemala. The Chiapas coast lies around 15.5°N at 93°W, and the coast runs northwest to southeast there. At longitude -93, the coastline is near 15.2°N (near Puerto Madero at 14.7°N, -92.4; Tonalá/Boca del Cielo at about 15.9°N, -93.9). Interpolating, at -93.0 the coast is around 15.2°N. So 15.0°N is just south of it, in the water.

Checking again: Puerto Arista is at 15.94°N, -93.8°. Mapastepec coast is near 15.4°N, -93.1°. Pijijiapan coast is near 15.6°N, -93.2°. Puerto Madero is at 14.7°N, -92.4°. The coast at -93.0 is therefore around 15.2°N, which puts 15.0 in the water.

**Water**

6704.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -91.0 W is in Guatemala, in the highlands, in the Quiché department. Land.

Land

6705.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -89.0 is in Honduras, near the border with El Salvador and Guatemala. Honduras spans roughly 13-16°N and 83-89.5°W. At 15°N, 89°W the point is in western Honduras (Copán/Ocotepeque area), which is land.

Land

6706.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -87.0 is in Honduras. Honduras's northern coast lies around 15.8°N at that longitude, and the Gulf of Fonseca is at about 13°N. At 15°N, 87°W, the point is in the interior, near Comayagua and Siguatepeque, though slightly northwest. That is land.

Land

6707.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -85.0 W. Honduras' northern coast sits around 15.8 N at -85, and the Honduran coast near Trujillo is at about -86 W, 15.9 N. At -85.0, the coast is at about 15.9 N, so 15.0 N is inland. Honduras at longitude -85 spans from the Caribbean coast down to the Nicaraguan border (about 14.9-15.0 N near the Río Patuca region?). The Honduras-Nicaragua border at -85 W is around 13.5 N, with the Olancho department in between. So 15.0 N is land.

Land

6708.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -83.0 W lies in the Caribbean Sea, east of Honduras. The coast of Honduras/Nicaragua is around -83.2 to -83.5 at 15°N (Cabo Gracias a Dios is at 15.0N, -83.13W). So -83.0 is just east of the cape, which puts it in the water. The Nicaraguan coast just south of the cape trends southwest, so at 15.0N the coast sits at about -83.13. A point at -83.0 is east of that and therefore offshore.

Water

6709.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -81.0 W is in the western Caribbean Sea, southeast of Honduras and east of Nicaragua's coast. The Nicaraguan coast is around -83.5 at this latitude, and the Honduras/Nicaragua offshore area has the Rosario and Providencia islands further south (13°N, -81.4°W). At 15°N, -81°W, there is no known island, so it is water.

Water

6710.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude 79.0 W is in the Caribbean Sea, south of Jamaica and northeast of Nicaragua/Honduras, so it is water.

**Water**

6711.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -77.0 W is in the Caribbean Sea, south of Jamaica and north of Colombia. Jamaica lies at about 18 N, and Honduras's Gracias a Dios coast is at about 15 N, 83 W. At 77 W and 15 N, this is open water.

Water

6712.text:
Latitude 15.0°N, longitude 75.0°W puts this point in the Caribbean Sea. It lies south of Jamaica and Haiti, northwest of Colombia, and east of Nicaragua, so it is open water.

Water

6713.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -73.0 W lies in the Caribbean Sea, south of Haiti (which is around 18-19 N) and north of Colombia (the coast is around 11-12 N). So it is in the Caribbean Sea.

Water

6714.text:
Latitude 15.0°S or N? Given as 15.0 (north), longitude -71.0. At 15°N, 71°W is in the Caribbean Sea, south of Hispaniola (Haiti is ~18-20°N) and north of Venezuela's coast (~12°N). Therefore it's water.

Water

6715.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -69.0 W is in the Caribbean Sea, south of Hispaniola and north of Venezuela's coast (which is around 12 N), so it falls in open sea.

Water

6716.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude 67.0 W is in the Caribbean Sea, south of Puerto Rico and north of Venezuela. It is well away from any land, so it is water.

Water

6717.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude 65.0 W falls in the Caribbean Sea, south of the Virgin Islands and north of Venezuela. The nearest land is far from that point, so it is water.

Water

6718.text:
Latitude 15.0°N, longitude 63.0°W is in the eastern Caribbean Sea, west of the Lesser Antilles. Guadeloupe is at about 16.2°N, 61.5°W, and Dominica at 15.4°N, 61.4°W. Martinique is at 14.6°N, 61°W. The point sits further west, at 63°W, which is over open water. Aves Island is at 15.67°N, 63.6°W, so it is not at this point either.

Water

6719.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, Longitude -61.0 W. Dominica is located at about 15.4 N, 61.35 W. Its east coast is around -61.25 at 15.4. At 15.0 N, -61.0 is south of Dominica, between Dominica and Martinique (Martinique is at 14.6 N, 61.0 W, with its northern tip at about 14.88 N). So 15.0, -61.0 is just north of Martinique's northern tip (14.88) — the Atlantic side/channel. Water.

**Water**

6720.text:
Latitude 15.0°N, longitude 59.0°W lies east of the Lesser Antilles. Barbados is at about 13.1°N, 59.6°W, and Martinique at about 14.6°N, 61°W. A point at 15°N, 59°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, east of Martinique and Dominica, so it is water.

Water

6721.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 57°W lies in the Atlantic Ocean, east of the Lesser Antilles (Barbados is at 13°N, 59.5°W). So it is water.

Water

6722.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 55°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, east of the Lesser Antilles (Barbados is at about 59.5°W).

Water

6723.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -53.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, east of the Lesser Antilles and northeast of South America (French Guiana is at about -53 but around 4-5 N).

Water

6724.text:
Latitude 15.0°N, longitude 51.0°W is in the central Atlantic Ocean, well east of the Lesser Antilles and far from any land.

Water

6725.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -49.0 W is in the central Atlantic Ocean, east of the Lesser Antilles (which sit near -61 W). The point is open ocean.

Water

6726.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 47°W is in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean.

Water

6729.text:
Latitude 15.0 N and longitude -41.0 W is in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean, well west of Africa and east of the Caribbean.

Water

6730.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -39.0 W is in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean, well away from any coast.

Water

6731.text:
Latitude 15.0 and longitude -37.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, well east of the Caribbean and west of Africa.

Water

6732.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 35°W is in the central Atlantic Ocean, west of Cape Verde and well east of the Caribbean.

Water

6733.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 33°W is in the central Atlantic Ocean, west of Cape Verde (which sits near 25°W).

Water

6734.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 31°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, west of Cape Verde (which is around 23-25°W).

Water

6735.text:
Latitude 15.0 N and longitude 29.0 W falls in the Atlantic Ocean, west of Cape Verde. Cape Verde's islands span roughly 22.7°W to 25.4°W, so 29°W is well to the west of them and in open ocean.

Water

6736.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -27.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, west of Cape Verde. Cape Verde's westernmost islands, such as Santo Antão, lie around -25.3, so -27 is farther west and clear of them.

Water

6737.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -25.0 W is in the Atlantic Ocean, near Cape Verde. Cape Verde islands span roughly 22.7°W to 25.4°W longitude and 14.8°N to 17.2°N latitude. Santo Antão is at about 17°N, 25°W. São Vicente is at 16.9°N, 25°W. Sal is at 16.7°N, 22.9°W. São Nicolau is at 16.6°N, 24.3°W. Santiago is at 15.0–15.3°N, 23.5–23.8°W. Fogo is at 14.9°N, 24.4°W. Maio is at 15.2°N, 23.2°W. The point at 25.0°W, 15.0°N is west of Santiago (westmost about 23.78°W), so it is in open water.

Water

6738.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -23.0 is near Cape Verde. Santiago island lies around 15.1°N, 23.6°W, and Praia is at 14.93°N, 23.51°W. Santiago spans roughly 23.8°W to 23.4°W. The east coast is around 23.4°W at latitude 15.0, so -23.0 lies about 0.4° east of the coast, roughly 40 km into the ocean. Maio island is at about 15.2°N, 23.2°W and spans roughly 23.28°W to 23.14°W. So -23.0 is east of Maio as well, which makes it water.

Water

6739.text:
Latitude 15.0 and longitude -21.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, west of Cape Verde. Cape Verde's islands lie around longitude -22.9 to -25.4, and Santo Antão is at about -25. Longitude -21 is east of none of them, so the point is open ocean, well west of Senegal's coast (about -17.5).

Water

6740.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -19.0 is in Senegal, which is on the west coast of Africa. Dakar sits at about 14.7°N, 17.5°W. At 19°W the point is about 1.5° west of Dakar, which puts it in the Atlantic Ocean, since Cap-Vert at 17.5°W is the westernmost point of the mainland.

Water

6741.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -17.0 is near Senegal's coast. Dakar is at about 14.7 N, 17.45 W, and the Senegal coast near Mbour is at about 14.4 N, 17.0 W. At 15.0 N, the coast sits around 17.1–17.4 W: Kayar is at 14.92 N, 17.12 W, and Mekhé is inland at 15.1 N, 16.6 W. The coastline near 15.0 N is around 17.15 W, so 17.0 W is just inland.

Land

6742.text:
Latitude 15°N, longitude 15°W. Dakar, Senegal, sits at about 14.7°N, 17.5°W, so 15°W is inland from the coast. Senegal's coast near 15°N is at about 16.5°W, which puts 15°W on land (Senegal/Mauritania region).

Land

6743.text:
Latitude 15, longitude -13 is in Mauritania/Senegal/Mali region. Mauritania's southern part: around 15N, 13W is near Kiffa (16.6N, 11.4W)... Selibaby is 15.16N, 12.18W. 13W at 15N is just west of that, in Mauritania/Senegal border area (Senegal River at about 16N at that longitude; Mali border at ~12W). Anyway, it's land.

Land

6744.text:
Latitude 15.0, longitude -11.0 is in West Africa, in Mali near the Mauritania border. That is land.

Land

6745.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -9.0 (9°W) falls in Mali, in West Africa, so it is on land.

Land

6746.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude 7.0 W is in Mali, which is land.

Land

6747.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, Longitude -5.0 (5° W) falls in Mali, West Africa, so it is on land.

Land

6748.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, longitude -3.0 (3° W) falls in Mali, in West Africa, near Mopti and the Niger River region. That is land.

Land

6749.text:
Latitude 15.0°N, longitude 1.0°W falls in Mali, near the border with Burkina Faso. That region is in the Sahel, and the point is on land.

Land

6750.text:
Latitude 15.0 N, Longitude 1.0 E is in Mali/Niger area. Mali's eastern part near Gao is around 16N, 0E. At 15N, 1E, that's in Mali (Menaka region) or near the Niger border. Land.

Land

6751.text:
Latitude 15.0°N, longitude 3.0°E falls in Niger/Mali. It is in the Sahel, near the Niger–Mali border, so it is on land.

Land
