7166.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 113.0°E is in the South China Sea, east of Vietnam and west of Palawan. It is near the Spratly Islands, but that exact point is open water.

Water

7167.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 115.0°E is in the South China Sea, east of Vietnam and west of the Palawan area. The Spratly Islands lie around 8-11°N and 111-116°E, but this point is mostly open water.

Water

7168.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 117.0°E lies in the South China Sea, west of Palawan (which is around 118-119°E at 10-11°N). The Spratly Islands sit around 112-116°E and 8-11°N, but this point is open sea.

Water

7169.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 119.0°E is in the South China Sea / Sulu Sea area. Palawan lies from about 8.5°N to 11.5°N, roughly 117°E to 119.5°E. At 11°N, Palawan's northern part sits around 119.0–119.5°E (Coron/Busuanga area is at 12°N, 120°E). Northern Palawan near 11°N is at about 119.4°E (Taytay is at 10.8°N, 119.5°E), and El Nido is at 11.2°N, 119.4°E. The west coast at 11°N is around 119.2°E. So 119.0°E is probably just offshore, in the water.

Water

7170.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 121.0°E is in the Philippines. Panay Island spans roughly 10.5–11.9°N and 121.9–123.2°E, so 121.0°E is west of Panay. Northern Palawan lies at around 11°N, 119.5–120°E, and Busuanga is at about 12°N, 120°E. Mindoro spans roughly 12–13.5°N, and its southern tip is around 12.2°N. So 11°N, 121°E falls in the Sulu Sea, west of Panay and east of Palawan. Cuyo Islands are at about 11.0°N, 121.0°E, so it could be near them, but Cuyo is at roughly 10.85°N, 121.0°E. The point is near, though probably in the water.

Water

7171.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 123.0°E is in the central Philippines. Panay island spans roughly 10.4–11.9°N and 121.9–123.1°E. At 11.0°N, Panay's eastern coast is around 122.6–123.0°E. Iloilo's coast near Estancia (11.45°N, 123.15°E) is in the northeast. At 11.0°N, the coast is near Batad/San Dionisio, around 123.0–123.1°E, so the point is borderline.

Panay's east coast at 11.0°N: Concepcion is at 11.22°N, 123.1°E. Barotac Viejo is at 10.9°N, 122.85°E. Ajuy is at 11.17°N, 123.02°E. Sara is at 11.25°N, 122.99°E. San Dionisio is at 11.25°N, 123.08°E. Between Barotac Viejo (10.9°N, 122.85°E) and Ajuy (11.17°N, 123.02°E), the coast at 11.0°N runs about 122.9°E. Then 123.0°E would be water, though Ajuy is on a peninsula and the coast bends. Nearby islands like Gigantes are at 11.6°N, so they don't apply. Guimaras sits at 10.6°N, 122.6°E, also not relevant.

Water

7172.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 125.0°E is near Leyte, Philippines. Leyte spans roughly 124.3–125.3°E and 10–11.6°N. At 11.0°N, 125.0°E, that is in Leyte's eastern part, near Leyte Gulf and Samar Sea. Samar island sits at about 11.0–12.5°N, 124.3–125.8°E, and the Samar Sea lies between Leyte and Samar on the northwest side.

Details: Leyte's northeast coast near Tacloban is at about 11.25°N, 125.0°E. San Juanico Strait separates Leyte from Samar there. At 11.0°N, 125.0°E, we're south of Tacloban (11.24°N). Leyte's east coast at 11.0°N is around 125.0–125.03°E (Palo is at 11.16°N, 125.0°E; Tanauan 11.1°N, 125.01°E; Tolosa 10.96°N, 125.03°E; Dulag 10.95°N, 125.03°E). So 125.0, 11.0 is just west of the coast, which is land (Leyte, around Tanauan/Tolosa).

**Land**

7173.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 127.0°E lies in the Philippine Sea, east of the Philippines. Samar's eastern coast is around 125.5°E, so 127°E is well offshore in the open ocean.

Water

7174.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 129.0°E is in the Philippine Sea, east of the Philippines (which spans about 120–127°E). Mindanao's eastern edge is around 126.5°E, so 129°E is open ocean.

Water

7175.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 131.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Philippines and southeast of Palau's northern area. Palau is at about 7.5°N, 134.5°E, and the Philippines' eastern coast is near 126°E. The point is open ocean.

Water

7176.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 133.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Philippines and southeast of Palau's northern region. Palau lies around 7.5°N, 134°E, and the Philippines are west of 126°E. The point is open water.

Water

7177.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, Longitude 135.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Philippines and south of Guam. It is far from any land mass, so it is water.

Water

7178.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 137.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Philippines and north of Micronesia's Caroline Islands (Yap is at about 138°E, 9.5°N). This point is open ocean.

Water

7179.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 139.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. It is east of the Philippines and south of Guam, and Yap is at about 138°E, 9.5°N. That puts the point in open ocean, north-northeast of Yap and well away from any island.

Water

7180.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 141.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. It is east of the Philippines and south of Guam, near the Caroline Islands and the Mariana Trench area. The nearest land is the Federated States of Micronesia, with Yap farther west at about 138°E, 9.5°N, and Ulithi at about 139.8°E, 10°N. Fais is at about 140.5°E, 9.8°N. The point is at 11°N, 141°E, which is roughly 100 km from those islands, so it is open water.

Water

7181.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 143.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Mariana Islands and south of Guam. The Mariana Trench (Challenger Deep) lies around 11.3°N, 142.2°E, so this point is in the ocean nearby.

Water

7182.text:
Latitude 11°N, longitude 145°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Marianas. Guam is at 13.4°N, 144.8°E, and the Mariana Trench is south and west of there. At 11°N, 145°E, the point is south of Guam, and the Challenger Deep is at about 11.37°N, 142.59°E. So 145°E is in the ocean.

Water

7183.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 147.0°E is in the western Pacific, east of the Philippines and south of Guam. The Caroline Islands lie around there, but this point is in open ocean, north of Chuuk (about 7.4°N, 151.8°E) and west of the Marshall Islands. The nearest land is probably the Namonuito Atoll area at about 8.7°N, 150°E, and the point is not near any island.

Water

7184.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 149.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Philippines and north of Papua New Guinea. The nearest land is Chuuk (Truk) in Micronesia, around 7°N, 151.8°E, which is far enough away that this point is open water. The Mariana Islands are at 13–20°N, 145°E, also not at this point.

Water

7185.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, Longitude 151.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of Chuuk (Truk), which sits around 7.4°N, 151.8°E. At 11°N, 151°E there is no known island nearby, since the Caroline Islands lie further south and the Marshall Islands lie further east. This point is open ocean.

Water

7186.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 153.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, east of Chuuk (Truk) and southeast of Guam. Chuuk is around 7.4°N, 151.8°E, and Pohnpei is around 6.9°N, 158°E. The nearby Caroline Islands atolls at 11°N include Nomwin and Namonuito, but Namonuito sits at about 8.7°N, 150°E. Nothing is at 11°N, 153°E, so it is open ocean.

Water

7187.text:
Latitude 11°N, longitude 155°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, east of Micronesia and near the Marshall Islands. The Marshall Islands sit at roughly 5–15°N and 160–172°E, so 155°E is west of them. Pohnpei is at about 158°E, 7°N, and Kosrae at 163°E. The point at 11°N, 155°E is open ocean.

Water

7188.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 157.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean, east of the Marshall Islands' western atolls. The Marshall Islands span roughly 160–172°E, so 157°E lies west of them. It is also east of Pohnpei (about 158.2°E, 6.9°N) and north of Kosrae, so open water.

Water

7189.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 159.0°E lies in the western Pacific, north of Pohnpei (about 7°N, 158°E) and near the Caroline Islands region. Nearby islands include Oroluk and Minto Reef, around 7.5°N, and Nukuoro at 3.8°N. Kapingamarangi is at 1°N. At 11°N, 159°E there are no known islands, so it is open ocean.

**Water**

7190.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 161.0°E is in the western Pacific, near the Marshall Islands. Ebon Atoll is at about 4.6°N, 168.7°E, and Kwajalein is at about 9°N, 167.5°E. Eniwetok is at 11.5°N, 162.3°E, and Bikini is at 11.6°N, 165.4°E. The point 11.0°N, 161.0°E lies west of Enewetak, and the nearest land is Ujelang at about 9.8°N, 160.9°E, which is more than 100 km away. So this point is open water.

Water

7191.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 163.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands region. Ebon Atoll sits near 4.6°N, 168.7°E, and Kwajalein near 9°N, 167°E. Wotje is at about 9.4°N, 170°E. Eniwetok is at 11.5°N, 162.3°E. So 11.0, 163.0 is about 80 km from Enewetak, which has a small footprint, so this point falls in open water.

Water

7192.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 165.0°E falls in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands region. The Marshall Islands lie between about 5–15°N and 162–173°E. Ailinglaplap is near 7.3°N, 168.7°E. Wotje is at 9.5°N, 170°E. Kwajalein is at 9°N, 167°E. Bikini is at 11.6°N, 165.4°E, and Enewetak is at 11.5°N, 162.3°E. Rongelap is at 11.15°N, 166.8°E. Ailinginae is at 11.2°N, 166.5°E. Bikini Atoll spans roughly 11.5–11.7°N and 165.2–165.6°E, so the point at 11.0°N, 165.0°E lies about 70 km south-southwest of it, which is open ocean.

Water

7193.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 167.0°E is in the Marshall Islands region. Kwajalein is at about 9°N, 167.5°E. Ujelang is at 9.8°N, 161°E. Bikini is at 11.6°N, 165.4°E. Rongelap is at 11.15°N, 166.8°E. Rongelap Atoll spans roughly 11.0–11.5°N and 166.6–167.0°E. The point (11.0, 167.0) is near the southeastern part of Rongelap Atoll, but the atoll's southeast corner is around 11.1°N, 166.9°E. Ailinginae is at 11.15°N, 166.4°E. Lae Atoll is at 8.9°N. Wotho is at 10.1°N, 166.0°E. Ujae is at 8.9°N. Utirik is at 11.2°N, 169.8°E. Taongi is at 14.6°N. So 11.0, 167.0 is most likely open ocean just southeast of Rongelap's reef.

Water

7194.text:
11°N, 169°E is in the Marshall Islands region. Marshall Islands span roughly 4.5–14.5°N, 160.5–172°E. At 11°N, 169°E... Atolls: Ailinglaplap at ~7.4°N 168.7°E; Jaluit 6°N 169.6°E; Kwajalein 9°N 167.5°E; Lae 8.9°N 166.3°E; Namu 8°N 168°E; Ebon 4.6°N; Mili 6°N 171.9°E; Majuro 7°N 171°E; Aur 8.3°N 171°E; Maloelap 8.7°N 171°E; Wotje 9.5°N 170°E; Likiep 10°N 169.2°E; Ailuk 10.3°N 169.9°E; Mejit 10.3°N 170.9°E; Utirik 11.2°N 169.8°E; Taongi 14.6°N; Bikar 12.2°N 170°E; Jemo 10.1°N 169.5°E. Likiep is at 9.9°N 169.3°E. At 11°N 169°E there's no island I recall; Utirik is at 11.2°N, 169.8°E, about 0.8° away. So water.

Water

7195.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 171.0°E is in the Marshall Islands area. Ailinglaplap is around 7.4°N, 168.7°E. Wotje is about 9.4°N, 170.0°E. Utirik is about 11.2°N, 169.8°E. Bikar is about 12.2°N, 170.1°E. Taongi is about 14.6°N, 169°E. At 11.0°N, 171.0°E, I don't recall any atoll there, since Mejit is at 10.3°N, 170.9°E, and Ailuk is at 10.3°N, 169.9°E. Mejit is a small island of about 1.8 km², which is a bit far from the point (0.7° of latitude away), so this is most likely open water.

Water

7196.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 173.0°E lies in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands area. The Marshall Islands span roughly 4.5–14.5°N and 165–173°E. Ujelang atoll is at about 9.8°N, 160.9°E, Wotje at 9.5°N, 170°E, Bikar at 12.2°N, 170.1°E, Utirik at 11.2°N, 169.8°E, and Mili at 6.1°N, 171.7°E. Ebon is at 4.6°N, 168.7°E. The easternmost atolls are Mejit (10.28°N, 170.87°E) and Knox/Mili (about 172°E). Near 173°E, 11°N there is no island, so it is water.

Water

7197.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 175.0°E lies in the Pacific Ocean. The Marshall Islands stretch from about 160°E to 172°E in the west, with Majuro at about 171°E and 7°N, and Wotje at about 170°E. The easternmost islands, such as Mili at 171.9°E, still fall short of 175°E. So the point is in open water, east of the Marshalls.

Water

7198.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, Longitude 177.0°E is in the central Pacific, near the Marshall Islands, whose eastern edge is around 170-172°E. At 177°E, 11°N, it is east of the Marshall Islands, in open ocean.

Water

7199.text:
Latitude 11.0°N, longitude 179.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean, east of the Marshall Islands (which span about 165-172°E) and well west of the date line. There is no land nearby.

Water

7200.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 179.0°W lies in the Pacific Ocean, east of the Marshall Islands and far from the Hawaiian Islands. Nothing there is land.

Water

7202.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude 175.0 W is in the central Pacific. Nearby land: Kingman Reef is at 6.4 N, 162 W, which is too far east. Palmyra is at 5.9 N, 162 W. Johnston Atoll is at 16.7 N, 169.5 W. Howland Island is at 0.8 N, 176.6 W. Baker Island is at 0.2 N, 176.5 W. The Marshall Islands are at about 170 E, which is far west. Nothing lies at 9 N, 175 W, so it is open ocean.

Water

7204.text:
Latitude 9.0°N and longitude 171.0°W lies in the central Pacific. Nearby land: Atafu in Tokelau is at 8.5°S, so that is far away. Johnston Atoll is at 16.7°N, 169.5°W, also far. Palmyra is at 5.9°N, 162°W. Swains Island is at 11°S. Nothing is at 9°N, 171°W, so it is water.

**Water**

7205.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -169.0° (169°W) falls in the central Pacific Ocean. The nearest land is Johnston Atoll at about 16.7°N, 169.5°W, which is far to the north, and the Marshall Islands are to the west. This point is open ocean.

Water

7206.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 167.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean. The nearest land is Johnston Atoll at about 16.7°N, 169.5°W, which is far to the north. The Hawaiian Islands lie farther northeast and the Marshall Islands farther west. The point is open water.

Water

7209.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -161.0° (161°W) is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and north of the Line Islands. Palmyra Atoll is at about 5.9°N, 162°W, and Kingman Reef is at 6.4°N, 162.4°W. Nothing is at 9°N, 161°W, so it is open ocean.

Water

7210.text:
Latitude 9°N, longitude 159°W lies in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii. The nearest land is Palmyra Atoll at about 5.9°N, 162°W, and Kingman Reef at 6.4°N, 162.4°W. Both are far from this point, so it is water.

Water

7212.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -155.0° (155°W) is in the Pacific Ocean, south of the Hawaiian Islands. The Big Island of Hawaii lies around 19-20°N, so this point is far from any land.

Water

7215.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -149.0° (149°W) is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and north of the Line Islands and French Polynesia. No islands are there.

Water

7216.text:
Latitude 9°N, longitude 147°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and well north of the Line Islands. There is no land there.

Water

7219.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 141.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, well south-east of Hawaii and far from any landmass.

Water

7220.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -139.0 (139° W) falls in the Pacific Ocean, well southwest of Mexico and east of Hawaii.

Water

7232.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -115.0° is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico, so it is water.

**Water**

7233.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 113.0°W is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico and well away from any land.

Water

7234.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, Longitude -111.0° is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico and well west of Central America.

Water

7236.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -107.0 W is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico and well west of Central America.

Water

7237.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -105.0° is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico (Mexico's coast at that longitude is around 19-20°N). Nothing is nearby, so it's water.

Water

7238.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -103.0° is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico and well west of Central America. That is open water.

Water

7239.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -101.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico (Acapulco is at about 16.8 N, 99.9 W). At 9 N, the coast of Central America (Costa Rica/Panama) lies at about -83 to -85 W, so -101 is far offshore.

Water

7240.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -99.0°W. This is in the Pacific Ocean, south of Mexico. Mexico's southern coast at longitude -99 is around 16.8°N (Acapulco). So 9°N is about 800 km offshore.

Water

7241.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, Longitude -97.0 W. This is in the Pacific Ocean, south of Mexico (Oaxaca coast is around 16 N). At 9 N, 97 W, it's well offshore in the Pacific.

Water

7242.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -95.0°W is in the Pacific Ocean, south of southern Mexico and off the coast of Central America. The coast of Guatemala and El Salvador is around 13-14°N, and Costa Rica's Pacific coast near 95°W would be far to the west. The point is in the open ocean.

Water

7243.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -93.0 W. That's in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of the Gulf of Tehuantepec, off the coast of Mexico/Guatemala. The coast at -93 is around 15.5 N. So 9 N is far out in the ocean.

Water

7244.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -91.0 is in the Pacific Ocean, south of Guatemala/Mexico, well offshore.

Water

7245.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -89.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, south of El Salvador (which lies around 13-14 N). Land at 9 N, 89 W? Central America at that longitude is around 13 N for the coast, so 9 N is far out in the Pacific.

Water

7246.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, Longitude -87.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Costa Rica's Nicoya Peninsula (about 85.5 W at 10 N). At 87 W it is roughly 150 km offshore, so it is water.

Water

7247.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -85.0 W. Costa Rica's Nicoya Peninsula spans roughly 9.6-10.9 N, 85-86 W. At 9.0 N, 85.0 W, that's south of the peninsula's tip (Cabo Blanco at ~9.6 N, 85.1 W). The Costa Rican Pacific coast near Quepos is at 9.4 N, 84.15 W. At 85.0 W, the coast would be around 9.6 N, so 9.0 N is in the ocean.

Water

7248.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -83.0 W is in Costa Rica, near the southern part. Costa Rica's Pacific coast near the Osa Peninsula is around 8.5 N, 83.5 W. At 9.0 N, 83.0 W, this is in the Talamanca mountains, near the Chirripó area (9.48 N, 83.49 W). The Panama border is around 82.9 W at the Caribbean side (Sixaola at 9.5 N, 82.6 W). At 9.0 N, 83.0 W, the location is inland, in the Talamanca range, near the Costa Rica–Panama border region. So it is land.

Land

7249.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -81.0°W. Panama's southern coast: the Azuero Peninsula extends to about 80.0°W–80.9°W at around 7.2–8.4°N. Coiba Island is at about 7.4°N, 81.7°W. At 9.0°N, -81.0°W, the Panamanian mainland's Caribbean coast lies near 9.0°N at around -81.0°W (Bocas del Toro region, with the coast at about 9.1–9.2°N near Chiriquí Lagoon at -82°W). Near -81°W, the north coast is around 8.8–9.0°N (Veraguas coast near Calovébora at -81.2°W, ~8.8°N). Calovébora is at 8.35°N? The Veraguas north coast: Santa Catalina area near 8.6°N, -81.2°W... The Caribbean coast at -81°W is around 8.9°N. So 9.0°N is just north of it, in the sea.

**Water**

7250.text:
Latitude 9.0, longitude -79.0 is in Panama. Panama City is at about 8.98°N, 79.52°W, and the Panama Canal's Atlantic end at Colón is around 9.36°N, 79.9°W. At 79.0°W, 9.0°N, that is east of Panama City, near the Pacific side. The Gulf of Panama's coast runs east from the city, with Pacific coast near Chepo (9.17°N, 79.1°W). Chepo is inland slightly. The coast near Punta Chame is farther west. At 9.0°N, 79.0°W, the Gulf of Panama coast at that longitude lies around 8.4°N–8.6°N, since Punta Chepillo is about 8.6°N and 79.0°W is near the Pearl Islands' north side. So 9.0°N is north of that coast, which makes it land.

Land

7251.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -77.0°W. That's near the Panama/Colombia border area. The Gulf of Urabá is around 8.5°N, 76.8°W. Darién region of Panama: the Caribbean coast near Puerto Obaldía is at 8.67°N, 77.4°W. The Pacific coast Gulf of San Miguel is around 8.2°N, 78°W. At 9.0°N, 77.0°W, the Caribbean coast there is around 8.9°N at 77.5°W... The Gulf of Urabá's western coast at 77.0°W is around 8.6°N. Coastline between Gulf of Urabá and Puerto Obaldía runs northwest: Cape Tiburón at 8.67°N, 77.35°W. At 77.0°W, the coast near Acandí is at 8.5°N, 77.3°W. So 9.0°N, 77.0°W is further north, in the Caribbean sea.

Water

7252.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -75.0 W is in northern Colombia. It lies near the Magdalena River region, in the department of Bolívar or Sucre. The Caribbean coast is at about 10 N, so 9 N is inland. This is land.

Land

7253.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -73.0 W is in northern Colombia, near the border with Venezuela. The Magdalena River region and the Cesar department lie around there, and 9°N 73°W is near Curumaní, Cesar, which is land.

Land

7254.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, Longitude -71.0° is in Venezuela. Lake Maracaibo spans roughly 9.8–11°N, 71–72°W, so this point is south of the lake. The area near 9°N, 71°W is in Mérida/Zulia/Trujillo state, which is land.

Land

7255.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -69.0° is in Venezuela. The state of Cojedes or Portuguesa lies around 9°N, 68-69°W. Barinas is at about 8.6°N, 70°W. Guárico is around 9°N, 67°W. So this point is on land in the Venezuelan llanos.

Land

7256.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -67.0 W is in Venezuela, in the llanos region, in Guárico state. San Juan de los Morros is at about 9.9 N, 67.4 W. At 9.0 N, 67.0 W the location is south of there, in the llanos. That is land.

Land

7257.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, longitude -65.0 W is in Venezuela. The Caribbean coast sits around 10°N at that longitude, and 9°N is inland, in the state of Anzoátegui or Guárico. The Orinoco river is further south at about 8°N near Ciudad Bolívar (longitude -63.5). At -65, 9°N is the Llanos region, which is land.

Land

7258.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude -63.0° is in Venezuela. Venezuela's coast is around 10.5°N at that longitude, and the Orinoco delta lies near 8-9°N, 61-62°W. At latitude 9°N, the northern Somalia coast on the Gulf of Aden is around 11°N at 51°E, and Cape Guardafui is at about 11.8°N, 51.3°E. The east coast of Somalia (Puntland) at 9°N is at roughly 50.9°E, near Eyl, which is at 8°N, 49.8°E. The coast at 9°N is around 50.9°E (near Hafun at 10.4°N, 51.4°E). The coast then runs southwest. At 9°N the coast sits near 50.5°E (Garacad is at 6.9°N, 49.1°E; Eyl is at 7.98°N, 49.8°E; Bargaal is at 11.2°N, 51.1°E; Hafun is at 10.4°N, 51.4°E). The coast between Hafun at 10.4°N, 51.4°E and Eyl at 8°N, 49.8°E at 9°N interpolates to about 50.5°E. So 51.0°E at 9°N is east of the coast, which is water.

7351.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 123.0°E is in the Philippines. Bohol is at about 9.8°N, 124.2°E, and Negros Oriental/Siquijor are near 9.2°N, 123.5°E. Negros's southern part at 9.0°N spans roughly 122.8–123.2°E. Dumaguete is at 9.3°N, 123.3°E. Southern Negros near Bayawan is about 9.37°N, 122.8°E, and Zamboanguita is at 9.1°N, 123.2°E. At 9.0°N, 123.0°E, that is south of Negros's tip (the southern tip is around 9.05°N near Siaton, 123.0°E). Siaton point is around 9.06°N, 123.03°E, so 9.0°N is just south of it, likely in the Sulu Sea/Bohol Sea waters.

**Water**

7352.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 125.0°E is in the Philippines, near northeastern Mindanao. Butuan is at about 8.95°N, 125.54°E, and Surigao is at about 9.78°N, 125.5°E. At 125.0°E and 9.0°N, that is west of Butuan, inland in Agusan del Norte/Misamis Oriental. Butuan Bay is at around 9.0°N, 125.3°E. Longitude 125.0 is west of the bay, so this should be land, around Gingoog or Bukidnon. Gingoog is at 8.8°N, 125.1°E. Camiguin lies at 9.17°N, 124.7°E. The point at 9.0, 125.0 sits between Gingoog and Butuan, which is inland, so land.

Land

7353.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 127.0°E is east of Mindanao, Philippines. Mindanao's east coast is around 126.3°E at about 9°N (Surigao del Sur coast near Lianga is ~126.1°E). So 127.0°E is in the Philippine Sea, roughly 80 km offshore. The Philippine Trench lies there.

Water

7354.text:

Water

7355.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 131.0°E is in the western Pacific. Palau is at about 7.5°N, 134.5°E, and the Philippines' easternmost islands (Mindanao) reach about 126.5°E. The point at 131°E is east of the Philippines and west of Palau, in the Philippine Sea, so it's open water.

Water

7356.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, Longitude 133.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean. Palau lies at about 7.5°N, 134.5°E, so this point is northwest of Palau, in open water in the Philippine Sea.

Water

7357.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 135.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean. Palau lies around 7.5°N, 134.5°E, so 9°N, 135°E is slightly north-northeast of Palau. Kayangel Atoll in Palau is at about 8.07°N, 134.7°E, which is still well south of this point. Nothing else is nearby, so the point is open water.

Water

7358.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 137.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, east of Palau and north of Papua. It is not near any land (the Caroline Islands lie further east, and Yap is at about 138°E, 9.5°N). Yap is roughly 1° east and 0.5° north of this point, so the point sits in open water.

7359.text:

Water

7360.text:

7361.text:

Nearby atolls: Eauripik at 6.7°N, 143°E; Ifalik at 7.2°N, 144.5°E; Faraulep at 8.6°N, 144.6°E; Gaferut at 9.2°N, 145.4°E; West Fayu at 8.0°N, 146.7°E. Nothing sits at 9°N, 143°E.

Water

7362.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 145.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. Chuuk (Truk) is at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E, and Pohnpei is at about 6.9°N, 158°E. Ulithi and Yap are around 9.5°N, 138°E. The Marianas are north of 13°N, so nothing in that group is near 9°N, 145°E. The nearest land is probably the western Chuuk atolls, such as Namonuito at about 8.7°N, 150°E, and Pulap, Pulusuk, and Puluwat at about 149°E. Nothing is at 145°E, so this point is open water.

Water

7363.text:
Latitude 9.0°, longitude 147.0° is in the western Pacific, east of Papua New Guinea. Papua New Guinea's mainland sits around 6°S, so 9°N is far north of it. Nearby island groups are the Chuuk (Truk) Lagoon at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E and Pohnpei at about 6.9°N, 158°E. Neither is close to 147°E. The point is open ocean.

Water

7364.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 149.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. Chuuk (Truk) is at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E, and Pohnpei is at about 6.9°N, 158°E. The Mortlock Islands are around 5.5°N, 153°E. Nearby atolls to the northwest include Namonuito at about 8.7°N, 150°E, and Pulusuk at 6.7°N, 149.2°E. Ulul is at 8.5°N, 149.7°E, and Satawan is farther south. Puluwat is at 7.35°N, 149.2°E. Namonuito Atoll spans roughly 8.3–9.1°N and 149.5–150.2°E, so 149.0°E is just west of it. The area at 9.0°N, 149.0°E is most likely open ocean.

Water

7365.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 151.0°E is in the western Pacific, east of Chuuk (Truk) at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E and south of Pohnpei (6.9°N, 158°E). Nothing sits at 9°N, 151°E. Nearby atolls such as Nomwin and Hall Islands are around 8.6°N, 152°E, and Namonuito Atoll is around 8.7°N, 150°E. The point lies between them, so it is probably open water, though Namonuito's lagoon spans roughly 149.5–150.3°E, which is still west of 151.0°E.

Water

7366.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 153.0°E is in the western Pacific, north of Papua New Guinea and east of Chuuk (Truk) at about 7.5°N, 151.8°E. The nearest atolls would be Nomoi/Mortlock Islands (around 5.5°N, 153°E) and Nama, with Pohnpei further east at 158°E. Around 9°N, 153°E there are no known islands, so it is open ocean.

Water

7367.text:
Latitude 9°N, longitude 155°E. This is in the western Pacific, near the Caroline Islands/Marshall Islands. Pohnpei is at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E. Kosrae is at 5.3°N, 163°E. Chuuk is at 7.4°N, 151.8°E. Nearby atolls: Nukuoro at 3.8°N, 154.9°E; Kapingamarangi at 1°N. Pingelap at 6.2°N, 160.7°E. Mokil at 6.7°N, 159.8°E. At 9°N, 155°E, there's nothing I know of; the area is open ocean.

Water

7368.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 157.0°E lies in the western Pacific. The nearby island groups are the Marshall Islands, which are east of 160°E, and Pohnpei at about 158.2°E, 6.9°N. Kosrae is at 163°E. Nearby atolls such as Pingelap at 160.7°E, 6.2°N and Nukuoro at 154.9°E, 3.8°N are well south. Oroluk is at about 7.5°N, 155.2°E and Minto Reef at 9.9°N, 148°E. Ngatik is at 5.8°N, 157.2°E. At 9°N, 157°E there is no known land, so this is open ocean.

Water

7369.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 159.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean. The nearest land is the Caroline Islands: Pohnpei sits near 6.9°N, 158.2°E, and Pingelap and Mokil are around 6.2°N and 6.7°N. Kosrae is at 5.3°N, 163°E. Atolls near 9°N, 159°E include Oroluk, at about 7.5°N, 155°E, and Ngatik, at about 5.8°N, 157°E. None of these is at 9°N, 159°E, so the point is open ocean.

Water

7370.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 161.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands/Micronesia region. Pohnpei sits at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E, and Kosrae at 5.3°N, 163°E. Atolls near 9°N, 161°E would be close to Ujelang (9.8°N, 160.9°E), but 9.0°N is not near it. The point is most likely open ocean.

Water

7371.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 163.0°E lies in the western Pacific, in the Marshall Islands region. Ebon Atoll is at about 4.6°N, 168.7°E, Kwajalein is at 9°N, 167.5°E, and Pohnpei is at 6.9°N, 158.2°E. Kosrae is at 5.3°N, 163°E. At 9°N, 163°E, the nearest land is probably Pingelap or Mokil, which are around 6.2°N, 160.7°E and 6.7°N, 159.8°E. Nothing is near 9°N, 163°E, so it is open ocean.

Water

7372.text:
The point 9°N, 165°E lies in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands region. The Marshall Islands span roughly 160–173°E and 5–15°N. Atolls near 9°N, 165°E: Ailinglaplap is at 7.3°N, 168.7°E; Kwajalein is at 9°N, 167.3°E. Ujae is at 8.9°N, 165.7°E. Lae is at 8.9°N, 166.3°E. Namu is at 8.1°N, 168°E. West of Ujae there are no islands, so 165.0°E is about 0.7° (~75 km) west of Ujae, which means open water.

Water

7373.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 167.0°E is in the Marshall Islands area. Kwajalein Atoll is at about 8.7°N, 167.7°E, and Ebeye is at about 8.78°N, 167.73°E. The point 9.0°N, 167.0°E lies west of Kwajalein, in open ocean. Nearby Lib Island is at 8.3°N, 167.4°E, and Ujae is at 8.9°N, 165.7°E. Namu Atoll is at 8.1°N, 168.1°E. Nothing lies at 9.0°N, 167.0°E, so it is water.

Water

7374.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 169.0°E lies in the Marshall Islands region. The Marshall Islands span roughly 4.5–14.5°N and 160.8–172.2°E. At 9°N, 169°E, the nearest atolls are Kwajalein (about 9.2°N, 167.4°E), Lae and Ujae (about 8.9°N, 165.7°E), and Namu (about 8.1°N, 168°E). Jabwot, Ailinglaplap (about 7.4°N, 168.7°E), Jaluit (about 6°N, 169.5°E), and Namorik (5.6°N, 168°E) are all too far south. Majuro is at about 7.1°N, 171°E. Likiep is at about 9.9°N, 169.2°E, and Wotje is at about 9.4°N, 170°E. Aur is at about 8.3°N, 171.1°E. Ailuk is at about 10.3°N, 169.9°E. Likiep's islets extend to about 9.8°N, so 9.0°N is about 0.8° south of it. Nothing sits at exactly 9.0°N, 169.0°E, so it is open ocean.

Water

7375.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 171.0°E is in the Marshall Islands area. Kwajalein is at about 8.7°N, 167.7°E. Ailinglaplap is at about 7.4°N, 168.7°E. Wotje is at 9.4°N, 170.0°E. Likiep is at 9.9°N, 169.3°E. Ujae is at 8.9°N, 165.7°E. Maloelap is at 8.7°N, 171.0°E, with Taroa at 8.73°N, 171.23°E. Maloelap atoll spans approximately 8.5–8.9°N and 170.7–171.2°E. The point at 9.0°N is just north of the atoll's northern edge, so it is probably in open water. Erikub atoll is at 9.1°N, 170.0°E, so that's not it either. Aur atoll is at 8.3°N, 171.1°E. Maloelap's northern tip is around 8.85°N. So 9.0°N, 171.0°E is likely water.

Water

7376.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 173.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands region. Kwajalein is at about 9.2°N, 167.4°E, and Wotje is at about 9.45°N, 170.0°E. Majuro is at about 7.1°N, 171.4°E. Mili is at about 6.1°N, 171.9°E. Further east, Mejit is at about 10.3°N, 170.9°E, and Ailuk is at about 10.3°N, 169.9°E. The longitude of 173°E lies east of Majuro, and the Marshall Islands extend only to about 172.2°E. So nothing is near 9°N, 173°E.

Water

Ebon Atoll sits near 4.6°N, 168.7°E, and Kwajalein near 9.2°N, 167.4°E. Majuro is at 7.1°N, 171°E, and Mili at 6.1°N, 171.9°E. Nothing in the Marshall Islands reaches 175°E, since the easternmost atolls, such as Knox and Mili, are at about 172°E. That leaves this point in open water.

Water

7378.text:
Latitude 9.0°N, longitude 177.0°E is in the central Pacific. The Marshall Islands extend to about 172°E, so 177°E lies east of them. Wake Island is at about 19°N, 166°E, and Kiribati's Gilbert Islands begin near 173°E but sit near the equator. There is no land at 9°N, 177°E, so it is open ocean.

Water

7379.text:
Latitude 9.0 N, Longitude 179.0 E is in the Pacific Ocean, near the Marshall Islands, which lie around 160-172°E. At 179°E and 9°N the point is well east of them and west of the date line, so it is open ocean.

Water

7381.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 177.0°W is in the central Pacific. The nearest land is probably the Marshall Islands, which lie around 170°E, and Kiribati is farther south. Baker Island is at 0°N, 176°W, and Howland is at 0°N, 177°W, so both are far from 7°N. Johnston Atoll is at 17°N, 169°W, also far away. Nothing is near 7°N, 177°W.

Water

7382.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 175.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean. The nearest land is probably Kingman Reef and Palmyra, around 6.4°N, 162.4°W, and Johnston Atoll, at 16.7°N, 169.5°W. The Marshall Islands lie to the west of the antimeridian, and Baker and Howland Islands are near 0.2°N, 176°W, which is far south of this point. Nothing is close, so it is water.

Water

Kiribati's Line Islands are around 160°W, farther east. Palmyra is at 5.9°N, 162°W. Johnston Atoll is at 16.7°N, 169.5°W. Nothing sits at 7°N, 171°W.

Water

7390.text:
Latitude 7°N, longitude 159°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and north of the equator near the Line Islands. Palmyra Atoll is at about 5.9°N, 162°W, and Kingman Reef is at 6.4°N, 162.4°W. Nothing is at 7°N, 159°W.

Water

Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 153.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and well away from any island.

Water

7399.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 141.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, far south of Hawaii and well away from any island.

Water

Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -95.0° is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Central America (Costa Rica is at about -84, and Mexico's coast at 15°N, -95). So it's water.

7423.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -93.0° is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico's Chiapas coast. The coast near Chiapas at -93° is around 15°N, so 7°N is far out in the ocean.

Water

7424.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 91.0°W is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, well southwest of Costa Rica and Panama and southeast of the Galápagos, which sit at around 0 to 1°S and 90 to 91°W. That puts it in open water.

Water

7425.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude -89.0 is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Costa Rica and well west of Panama. Costa Rica's coast sits near -85 to -83 at those latitudes, so this point is open ocean.

Water

7426.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 87.0°W is in the Pacific Ocean, well southwest of Costa Rica (the Cocos Island area sits near 5.5°N, 87°W). That puts the point in open ocean.

Water

7427.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -85.0° lies in the Pacific Ocean, south of Costa Rica's Nicoya Peninsula. Costa Rica's southern coast near the Osa Peninsula is at about 8.5°N, 83.5°W, so 7°N, 85°W is well offshore to the southwest, in open water.

Water

7428.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -83.0° is in the Pacific Ocean, south of Panama and southwest of Costa Rica. Panama's southern coast is around 7-8°N at longitudes -80 to -82. Longitude -83 at 7°N is west of the Burica Peninsula (-83.0, 8.4°N). So 7°N is about 1.4° south of the coast, which is ocean.

Water

7429.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -81.0°W is in the Pacific Ocean, south of Panama. Panama's southern coast (Azuero Peninsula) is around 7.2°N at about -80.4°W, and Coiba Island lies near 7.4°N, -81.7°W. At -81.0, the Panama coast near 7.5-8.0°N is farther north, so 7.0°N is south of the coast and in open water.

Water

7430.text:
The point (7.0°N, 79.0°W) lies in the Pacific Ocean, south of Panama's Azuero Peninsula. Panama's southern coast sits at about 7.2–8°N between roughly 77.5°W and 80.5°W, and the Azuero Peninsula's southern tip is near 7.2°N, 80.4°W. At 79°W, the coast near the Gulf of Panama, including the Pearl Islands, is around 8.3°N, and the Darién coast at 78°W is around 7.5°N. At 7.0°N, 79.0°W, there is no land nearby, so this is water.

Water

7431.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -77.0°W. This is near the Colombia–Panama border. The Gulf of Urabá is at about 8.0°N, 76.8°W. Colombia's Pacific coast at 7°N is around 77.7°W (Cabo Marzo at 6.8°N, 77.7°W). So at 7.0°N, 77.0°W, we are inland in Chocó/Antioquia, on land. The Atrato River region lies at about 77°W near 7°N, and the coast near Turbo is at 8°N, so this is land.

Land

7432.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -75.0° is in Colombia, near the Magdalena River region (Antioquia/Bolívar/Santander area). It is land.

Land

7433.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude -73.0 is in Colombia, near Bucaramanga (7.1, -73.1) in Santander department. This is land.

Land

7434.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -71.0° is in the Llanos region of western Venezuela/eastern Colombia. The Colombia-Venezuela border runs along the Arauca River near 7°N, around -71°. Either way, it is land.

Land

7435.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -69.0° is in the Llanos region of Venezuela/Colombia border area. Longitude -69 at latitude 7 is near the Orinoco River, which forms the border between Colombia and Venezuela around there. The Orinoco near Puerto Ayacucho is at about 5.66°N, -67.5°W. At 7°N, the Orinoco flows near -66.2° (Caicara is 7.6°N, -66.2°W). So -69 at 7°N is in Apure state, Venezuela, which is land (the Meta River meets the Orinoco at 6.2°N, -67.4°W). The Capanaparo River is around 7°N, -68 to -69, but a point is likely land.

Land

7436.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -67.0° is in Venezuela, near the Orinoco River. Puerto Ayacucho is at about 5.66°N, 67.5°W. Cedeño in Bolívar state sits near 7.6°N, 66.17°W. The point 7.0°N, 67.0°W is on the Venezuela side of the border, or possibly on the Orinoco itself. The Orinoco runs along the Colombia-Venezuela border from about 5.6°N to 6.2°N, near 67.8°W, then turns north to Caicara del Orinoco at 7.63°N, 66.15°W. So at 7.0°N the river lies at about 66.5°W, and 67.0°W is west of it, in Venezuela's Amazonas/Bolívar interior, which is land.

Land

7437.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -65.0° is in Venezuela, in the Bolívar state, near the Orinoco River area. At 7°N, the Orinoco runs along roughly 8.0°N at Ciudad Bolívar (longitude -63.5). At -65, 7°N, that is southwest of Ciudad Guayana, in the Guayana Shield region, which is land.

Land

7438.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude -63.0 is in Venezuela (Bolívar state), near the Orinoco and the Guiana Shield region. The Orinoco at about 8.1°N is north of this point. At 7°N, 63°W it's in Bolívar state, near El Callao/Upata area. This is land.

Land

7439.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -61.0° is in Venezuela/Guyana. Near Ciudad Guayana, which is at about 8.35°N, 62.65°W. At 7.0, -61.0, this is in Bolívar state, Venezuela, near Guyana's border and the Gran Sabana region, roughly around El Dorado/Santa Elena (Santa Elena is at 4.6°N, 61.1°W). So 7°N, 61°W is land, in Bolívar state near the Cuyuní area.

Land

7440.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -59.0° is in Guyana. Guyana spans roughly 1°N to 8.5°N and 56.5°W to 61.4°W. At 7°N, 59°W, that is in the interior, near the Essequibo region, west of the Demerara River. The coast is around 6.8–7.0°N at about 58.3°W (Essequibo coast near 7°N, 58.5°W). At 59°W the coast lies at roughly 7.3°N or so, since the coast runs northwest toward Venezuela. So 7.0, -59.0 is inland, near the Cuyuni-Mazaruni area.

Land

7441.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -57.0° is in Guyana/Suriname area. Suriname's western border with Guyana is the Corantijn River at about -57.1°. At latitude 7°N, the coast of Guyana is around... Guyana's coast at -58°, 7°N; Suriname's coast near Nickerie is at about 5.95°N, -57°. The coast at -57° is approximately 5.9°N. So 7.0°N is about 1° north of the coast, which is in the Atlantic Ocean.

Water

7442.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -55.0° is in Suriname. Suriname spans roughly 2°N to 6°N, so 7°N is just north of the coast. The Suriname coast is around 6°N at 55°W, and the ocean lies north of it. At 55°W, the coastline is near 5.9°N, so 7°N is about 1° offshore, which is water.

Water

7443.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -53.0° puts the point near the border of French Guiana and Suriname. The coast of Guiana is around 5-6°N at that longitude, so 7°N lies about 1-2° offshore, in the Atlantic Ocean.

The coastline of French Guiana at -53° is roughly 5.5°N, and Suriname's coast at -55° is about 5.9°N. At 7°N and -53°, the point is therefore in the ocean.

Water

Suriname's coast is at about 55°W, and the coast near the Amazon mouth at around 50°W, 1°N. At 7°N, the coast is around 58°W (Guyana). So -49° at 7°N is well out in the ocean.

Water

Water

7461.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude -17.0° is in the Atlantic Ocean, west of Guinea-Bissau and Guinea (coast around -14 to -15°W at that latitude). So it's water.

Land

7465.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, Longitude -9.0° is in Liberia (the central part, near Gbarnga/Nimba area). Liberia spans roughly 4.3–8.5°N and -11.5 to -7.4°W, so this point is inland.

Land

7466.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 7.0°W is in Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), near the Liberian border. Roughly, Man is at 7.4°N, 7.55°W, so this point is in the west of the country and is on land.

Land

7467.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude -5.0 falls in Côte d'Ivoire, in the central region near Bouaké. That is inland, so it is land.

Land

7468.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 3.0°W is in Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), north of the coast. The coast is at about 5°N, so 7°N is inland. That makes it land.

Land

Land

Land

Land

Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 9.0°E is in Nigeria, near Enugu and the Benue region, so it is on land.

Land

Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 11.0°E is in Cameroon, in the Adamawa region, so it is on land.

Land

Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 13.0°E is in Cameroon, in the Adamawa region near Tibati/Ngaoundéré. That is land.

Land

Land

7486.text:

Land

7488.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 37.0°E is in southern Ethiopia, which is on land.

Land

7489.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 39.0°E is in Ethiopia, in the region around Shashamane and Lake Awassa. That is land.

Land

7490.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 41.0°E is in Ethiopia, in the Oromia region near Bale, so it is on land.

Land

7491.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, Longitude 43.0°E is in Ethiopia, in the Somali region (the Ogaden area). Ethiopia's southeastern lowlands span roughly 40–48°E, and at 7°N this is land.

Land

7492.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 45.0°E. That is in Somalia/Ethiopia area... Somalia's northern region spans roughly 8-11°N; at 7°N, 45°E is in central Somalia (Galgadud/Mudug region) or Ethiopia's Somali region. Ethiopia's border with Somalia near 45°E is around 7-8°N. Either way, it's land.

Land

7493.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude 47.0 is in Somalia/Ethiopia region. Latitude 7°N, longitude 47°E: Somalia's northern coast is around 11°N, and Ethiopia's Ogaden extends to about 8°N at 47°E. Somalia at 47°E extends from about 2°N (near Mogadishu is 45.3°E, 2°N) up to 8-9°N. The Somalia-Ethiopia border runs diagonally from around 8°N 47.5°E to 4°N 42°E. At 7°N, 47°E, that is in Somalia's interior, east of the border, near Galkayo (6.8°N, 47.4°E). So it's land.

**Land**

7494.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 49.0°E. That falls in Somalia's northeast, where the Horn of Africa extends to about 51°E. At 7°N the coast is around 47-49°E, so I need to check whether 49°E is land or ocean.

Somalia's east coast runs from Cape Guardafui (11.8°N, 51.3°E) southwest. At 9°N the coast is about 50.8°E. At 8°N, around 49.9°E. At 7°N, around 49.4°E (near Hobyo, which is at 5.35°N, 48.5°E). Eloa/Garacad is at 6.9°N, 49.1°E. Garacad is roughly 6.88°N, 49.08°E, so the point at 7.0°N, 49.0°E is slightly northwest of Garacad, which would be inland, just next to the coast.

Land

7495.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude 51.0 is in the Indian Ocean region east of Somalia's horn? Somalia's eastern coast at 7°N is around 49-50°E (Hafun at 10.4°N, 51.4°E). At 7°N, the coast is around 47-49°E (near Eyl at 8°N, 49.8°E; Hobyo at 5.3°N, 48.5°E). So at 7°N, the coast is about 49.3°E. 51°E is further east, so it's water.

Water

7496.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude 53.0 places the point in the western Indian Ocean, east of Somalia and far from any landmass. Somalia's coast at that latitude is around 49-50°E, so 53°E is well offshore.

Water

7497.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 55.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, far east of the Horn of Africa (Somalia's tip is about 51°E at 12°N). At 7°N, Somalia's coast is around 49°E, so 55°E is in the ocean.

Water

Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 57.0°E is in the Arabian Sea / northwestern Indian Ocean, east of Somalia and well southeast of Socotra. That is open ocean.

Water

7499.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 59.0°E is in the Arabian Sea / Indian Ocean, well southeast of Oman and Yemen and east of Socotra, so it is open water.

Water

7500.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, Longitude 61.0°E is in the Arabian Sea / Indian Ocean, southwest of India and far from any land.

Water

7501.text:
Latitude 7°N, longitude 63°E is in the Arabian Sea / Indian Ocean, well west of India and south of Pakistan. It is open ocean.

Water

7502.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 65.0°E is in the Arabian Sea / Indian Ocean, southwest of India and well away from any land.

Water

7503.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 67.0°E is in the Arabian Sea / Indian Ocean, southwest of India and well west of the Maldives and Sri Lanka. No land is there.

Water

7504.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 69.0°E falls in the Arabian Sea / Indian Ocean, southwest of India and well west of Sri Lanka. That area is open ocean.

Water

7505.text:
Latitude 7°N, longitude 71°E is in the Arabian Sea / Indian Ocean, west of the Maldives and southwest of India's tip. India's southern tip is at about 8°N, 77°E, and the Maldives lie at about 73°E. So 71°E at 7°N is open ocean.

Water

7506.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 73.0°E is in the Arabian Sea / Indian Ocean, west of the southern tip of India and the Maldives. The Maldives span about 72.5–73.7°E, but at 7°N the northern atolls (Thiladhunmathi is ~6.5–7°N, ~73°E) are present. Haa Alif atoll sits at about 6.8–7.1°N, 72.9–73.1°E, so it is possible that this point falls on an island, but islands are tiny and the point is most likely in open water.

Water

7507.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 75.0°E is in the Arabian Sea/Indian Ocean, southwest of India's southern tip (Kerala is around 76°E at 10°N). At 7°N, the southern tip of India is at about 8°N, 77°E. Sri Lanka lies at 80°E+. So 75°E, 7°N is in the ocean.

Water

7508.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, Longitude 77.0°E. India's southern tip (Kanyakumari) is at about 8.08°N, 77.55°E. At 7°N, 77°E, that's south of India, in the Indian Ocean/Laccadive Sea area, and Sri Lanka is further east (at 80°E). So it is water.

Water

7509.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 79.0°E. Sri Lanka's west coast is at about 79.85°E at Colombo (6.93°N). At 7.0°N, the coast is around 79.83°E, so 79.0°E lies about 80 km offshore, in the Gulf of Mannar and Arabian Sea region.

Water

7510.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 81.0°E is in Sri Lanka's central highlands, around Nuwara Eliya and Badulla. Sri Lanka spans roughly 79.7–81.9°E and 5.9–9.8°N, so this point is on land.

Land

7511.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 83.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, southeast of Sri Lanka. Sri Lanka spans roughly 79.7–81.9°E, so 83°E lies east of the island's coast, in the Bay of Bengal.

Water

7512.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 85.0°E lies south of Sri Lanka and east of the Maldives, in the Indian Ocean. Sri Lanka extends to about 81.9°E, so 85°E is well offshore.

Water

7513.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, Longitude 87.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, southwest of Sri Lanka's southeastern side, in the Bay of Bengal region, with no land nearby.

Water

7514.text:
Latitude 7.0 N, longitude 89.0 E is in the Bay of Bengal, southeast of Sri Lanka and well away from any land.

Water

7515.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 91.0°E is in the Bay of Bengal/Andaman Sea region, west of the Nicobar Islands (which sit around 92.7°E at 7–9°N). So this is open water.

Water

7516.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 93.0°E is in the Andaman Sea/Bay of Bengal region. The Nicobar Islands lie around 6–10°N, 92.5–94°E. Car Nicobar is at 9.2°N, 92.8°E. Great Nicobar is at about 7.0°N, 93.8°E, spanning roughly 6.8–7.3°N and 93.6–93.95°E. Point 93.0°E is west of Great Nicobar by about 70 km, so it is open water.

Water

7517.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 95.0°E is in the Andaman Sea/Bay of Bengal region, west of southern Thailand and northwest of Sumatra. The Andaman Islands lie at about 92-93°E and 10-13°N, and Nicobar Islands are at 93°E and 7-9°N, so 95°E is east of them. Phuket is at 98.3°E. So 95°E, 7°N is open water.

Water

7518.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 97.0°E is in the Andaman Sea, west of Phuket, Thailand. Phuket is at about 98.3°E, and the coast of southern Thailand near Phang Nga is at about 98.2°E. So 97.0°E is well offshore.

Water

7519.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 99.0°E is in southern Thailand, near Trang and Phatthalung. Trang is at about 7.5°N, 99.6°E. Satun is at about 6.6°N, 100.07°E. The point at 7.0°N, 99.0°E lies west of Trang's coast. The coast near Trang runs about 99.3°E at 7.3°N, and the Trang islands such as Ko Libong are at 7.25°N, 99.4°E. Ko Muk is at about 7.4°N, 99.3°E. Ko Sukorn is at 7.1°N, 99.6°E.

The Malay Peninsula's west coast at 7°N is around 99.6–99.7°E, so 99.0°E is in the Andaman Sea. Ko Tarutao is at 6.6°N, 99.65°E, and Ko Lanta is at 7.5°N, 99.05°E. At 7.0°N, 99.0°E, that is south of Ko Lanta and west of the coast, so it is water.

**Water**

7520.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 101.0°E is in southern Thailand, near Yala and Songkhla province. The Gulf of Thailand coast is at about 101°E near Pattani at roughly 6.9°N, and the point sits inland of that coast.

Pattani city is at about 6.87°N, 101.25°E, and the coastline near 7.0°N runs around 100.4–101.0°E. Songkhla city is at 7.2°N, 100.6°E. Songkhla's coast runs southeast toward Pattani, and at 7.0°N the coast is around 100.9–101.0°E. Thepha and Na Thawi are at about 6.9–7.0°N, 100.5–100.7°E. Nong Chik is at about 6.9°N, 101.2°E. Khok Pho is at about 6.8°N, 101.1°E. Mayo and Sai Buri are on the coast at about 6.7°N, 101.6°E. Pattani Bay is at about 6.9°N, 101.3°E. The coast between Songkhla (100.6°E) and Pattani (101.3°E) runs from 7.2°N to 6.9°N, so at 101.0°E the coast is at about 7.0°N, which makes the point ambiguous. Bang Pu and Nathawi are at 6.8–7.0°N. Overall, the coast at 101.0°E is probably around 6.95–7.05°N. Since the point is right at the boundary, I'll pick Land, given that the coastline near Thung Yang Daeng (6.9°N, 101.2°E) and Khlong Maelai is inland.

**Land**

7521.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 103.0°E. The Malay Peninsula at 7°N: the east coast of southern Thailand lies near 100.5°E at that latitude (Songkhla is at 7.2°N, 100.6°E). The Gulf of Thailand extends east from there. At 103°E and 7°N, we're east of Narathiwat (6.4°N, 101.8°E) and Kelantan's coast (about 102.2°E at 6°N). So 103°E, 7°N is in the Gulf of Thailand, which is water.

Water

7522.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 105.0°E. This is near the southern tip of Vietnam (Ca Mau peninsula is around 8.6°N–9.2°N, 104.7–105.3°E). At 7.0°N, that's about 200 km south of the Ca Mau coast, in the Gulf of Thailand/South China Sea. So it's water.

Water

7523.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 107.0°E is in the South China Sea, off the southern tip of Vietnam. The Ca Mau Peninsula's southern tip is at about 8.6°N, 104.7°E, and the Mekong Delta coast near 9.5°N, 106.5°E. At 7°N, 107°E, the position is well offshore, southeast of the delta.

Water

7524.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 109.0°E lies in the South China Sea, east of the southern tip of Vietnam and northeast of the Malay Peninsula. Vietnam's southern coast is at about 105-109°E, but at 7°N the nearest land is far to the west, since the Ca Mau peninsula sits near 8.6°N, 105°E. The Natuna Islands are at about 4°N, 108°E. Nothing at 7°N, 109°E is land.

Water

7525.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude 111.0: that's in the South China Sea, north of Borneo/Java... Java lies at about 7°S, but this is 7°N. At 7°N, 111°E, the point is in the South China Sea, well east of Vietnam (which is around 109°E at that latitude) and west of the Philippines (Palawan is at 118°E). It's open water.

Water

7526.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 113.0°E falls in the South China Sea, in the Spratly Islands region. It is open water, west of Palawan and north of Borneo.

Water

7527.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 115.0°E is in the South China Sea, near the Spratly Islands area. The Spratlys span roughly 6-12°N and 111-117°E, but they are mostly small reefs. The point 7°N, 115°E is west of Borneo's northern tip (Borneo's coast at about 115°E is near 5°N), so it is open sea.

Water

7528.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude 117.0 is in the Sulu Sea/near Balabac Strait region. Palawan lies around 9-10°N, 118-119°E. Balabac is at about 7.9°N, 117.0°E. Sabah's northern tip (Banggi) is around 7.2°N, 117.0°E. Kudat peninsula is at about 6.9°N, 116.8°E. Banggi Island sits at about 7.2°N, 117.0°E, and the point 7.0, 117.0 is just south of Banggi, in the waters between Banggi and the Malawali area, but the Kudat peninsula spans 116.7–117.0 at roughly 6.8–7.0°N. The mainland coast east of Kudat at 117.0 is around 6.8°N (Marudu Bay's west side). So 7.0 is likely north of the coast, in water.

**Water**

7529.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude 119.0 is near the Sulu Archipelago in the Philippines. Tawi-Tawi is around 5.0-5.3°N, 119.9–120°E. Sulu (Jolo) is about 6.0°N, 121°E. Basilan is about 6.5°N, 122°E. At 7.0°N, 119.0°E, the point lies in the Sulu Sea, southwest of Palawan (Balabac is at 7.98°N, 117°E). The Cagayan de Sulu island is at 7.0°N, 118.5°E. That's close, but 119.0 is about 50 km east, so the point is likely water.

Water

7530.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 121.0°E falls in the southern Philippines. Zamboanga Peninsula spans roughly 6.9–8.5°N and 121.9–123.5°E, so 121.0°E is west of it. Basilan Island is around 6.5°N, 122°E. Jolo (Sulu) is around 6.0°N, 121.0°E, and the Sulu Archipelago stretches from about 5.5° to 6.5°N. At 7.0°N, 121.0°E, that is north of Jolo (which reaches about 6.1°N), in the Sulu Sea. Nothing lies there, so it is water.

Water

7531.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 123.0°E is near the southern Philippines. Mindanao spans roughly 6°–9.5°N and 121.5°–126.5°E. The Zamboanga Peninsula extends southwest to about 122°E. At 7°N, 123°E, the land is in Zamboanga del Sur or the Moro Gulf area. Moro Gulf's coast lies around 7°N near Pagadian (7.8°N, 123.4°E). Cotabato is at 7.2°N, 124.2°E. The Moro Gulf runs from about 6.9°N to 7.8°N at 123°E. The Zamboanga peninsula's southern coast near Zamboanga City is at about 6.9°N, 122.07°E. At 123°E, the coast of the Moro Gulf's north side is near 7.7°N, and the south side near Cotabato is 7.2°N, 124°E. Land at 123°E and 7.0°N would be in the water of the gulf, since the Cotabato coast at 123.5°E lies near 7.5°N and the southern coast curves down toward 6.3°N at 124°E.

**Water**

7532.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 125.0°E is in Mindanao, Philippines, near Davao City (about 7.07°N, 125.6°E). Davao City sits on Davao Gulf, and the gulf's western shore is around 125.3°E at this latitude. So 125.0°E is west of the coast and inland, which makes it land. The area is near Mount Apo, which is around 6.99°N, 125.27°E, so it is within the Davao del Sur region.

Land

7533.text:
Latitude 7.0, longitude 127.0 is east of Mindanao, Philippines. Mindanao's east coast is around 126.3°E at 7°N. Davao Gulf lies around 125.5-126°E. The Davao Oriental peninsula reaches about 126.5°E at around 7°N. So 127.0 is in the Philippine Sea, which is water.

Water

7534.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 129.0°E lies in the Philippine Sea, east of Mindanao (Mindanao's east coast is around 126°E). The Philippine Sea there is open ocean, and Palau is at about 134°E, so no land is near.

Water

7535.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 131.0°E is in the western Pacific, near Palau. Palau lies at about 7.5°N, 134.5°E, so 131°E is roughly 400 km west of it. The nearest land is Tobi, at about 3°N, 131°E, which is too far south, and Helen Reef is at about 2.9°N, 131.8°E. At 7°N, 131°E there is only open ocean.

Water

7536.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 133.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean. Palau is around 7.5°N, 134.5°E, so this point lies west of Palau in the Philippine Sea, in open water.

Water

7537.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 135.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean. Palau is around 7.5°N, 134.5°E, and 135°E at 7°N lies just east of Palau's main islands, in open water. Palau's easternmost extent is about 134.7°E, so this point is in the ocean.

Water

7538.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 137.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, east of Palau and south of the Caroline Islands, so it is open water.

**Water**

7539.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 139.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. Yap is at about 9.5°N, 138°E, and Palau is at about 134°E. Ulithi is at 10°N, 139.8°E, and Fais is at 9.8°N, 140.5°E. Sorol is at 8.1°N, 140.4°E, and Ngulu is at 8.3°N, 137.5°E. Nothing is known at 7°N, 139°E, so this is open ocean.

Water

7540.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 141.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. It is south of Guam and east of Palau, near the Caroline Islands. The closest islands are Sorol and Ulithi to the northwest, and Woleai at about 7.35°N, 143.9°E. Nothing is at 141°E, so this point is open water.

Water

7541.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 143.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean. Chuuk (Truk) lagoon is around 7.4°N, 151.8°E, and Woleai is near 7.35°N, 143.9°E. Ulithi is at about 10°N, 139.8°E. Satawan is farther east, near 5.3°N, 153.7°E. Nearby atolls are Namonuito (about 8.7°N, 150°E) and Pulap (about 7.6°N, 149.4°E). Puluwat is around 7.35°N, 149.2°E, and Eauripik is about 6.7°N, 143.0°E. That puts Eauripik at about 6.7°N, which is 0.3° (about 33 km) away from the point, so the point is likely open water. Ifalik is around 7.25°N, 144.5°E, and Woleai is at 7.35°N, 143.9°E. The point at 7.0°N, 143.0°E is therefore not on land.

Water

7542.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 145.0°E lies in the western Pacific. Chuuk (Truk) Lagoon is around 7.4°N, 151.8°E. Pohnpei is at 6.9°N, 158.2°E. Longitude 145°E at 7°N is south of Guam, west of Chuuk, and near the Namonuito area (around 8.7°N, 150°E). The Satawan atoll sits at 5.3°N, 153°E, and Woleai at 7.4°N, 143.9°E. Ulithi is at 10°N, 139.8°E. Fais is at 9.8°N, 140.5°E. Eauripik is at 6.7°N, 143.0°E. Ifalik is at 7.2°N, 144.5°E. Ifalik is a small atoll, and 145.0 is about 0.5° east of it, which is roughly 55 km, so it's open water. Nearby, Satawal is at 7.4°N, 147.0°E, and Lamotrek is at 7.5°N, 146.4°E, so 145.0°E, 7.0°N has no island.

Water

7543.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 147.0°E lies in the western Pacific. That is near the Chuuk (Truk) area of Micronesia, which sits at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E. At 147°E, 7°N, the nearest islands would be the Namonuito Atoll area (about 8.7°N, 150°E) or the Nomoi/Mortlocks (5.5°N, 153°E). Pulap and Satawan are farther east, and Woleai is at 7.4°N, 143.9°E. So 147°E, 7°N falls in open ocean.

Water

7544.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 149.0°E lies in the western Pacific, near Chuuk (Truk) in Micronesia. Chuuk Lagoon is at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E. At 149°E, 7°N, the nearest land would be small atolls such as the Namonuito or Nomoi (Mortlocks) areas. The Mortlocks are around 5.5°N, 153°E, and Pulusuk is at about 6.7°N, 149.2°E. Pulusuk Island is therefore near but a little off from the point. Puluwat is at 7.35°N, 149.2°E. The point 7.0°N, 149.0°E is between Puluwat and Pulusuk, which puts it in open water.

Water

7545.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 151.0°E is in the Caroline Islands region, near Chuuk (Truk) Lagoon at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E. Chuuk's islands lie roughly between 7.2–7.5°N and 151.5–152°E, so 7.0, 151.0 is west-southwest of the lagoon. The Namonuito atoll is further north, around 8.7°N, 150°E. The Nomoi (Mortlock) Islands are around 5.5°N, 153°E. Pulusuk is at 6.7°N, 149.4°E and Puluwat at 7.35°N, 149.2°E. Nothing is known at 7.0, 151.0, so this is open ocean.

Water

7546.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 153.0°E is in the western Pacific, near Chuuk (Truk) in Micronesia. Chuuk Lagoon sits at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E. At 153.0°E, 7°N, that is east of Chuuk, near the Nomoi (Mortlock) Islands, which are at about 5.5°N, 153.5°E. So 7°N, 153°E is probably open ocean. The nearest islands are Namonuito Atoll at about 8.7°N, 150°E, and Pulap at 7.5°N, 149°E. Nothing lies at 7°N, 153°E.

Water

7547.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 155.0°E lies in the western Pacific, near Pohnpei (about 6.9°N, 158.2°E) and Chuuk (about 7.4°N, 151.8°E). At 155°E it is between the two, in open ocean, so there is probably no land there. Nukuoro atoll sits at about 3.8°N, 154.9°E, and Kapingamarangi is farther south. The Mortlock Islands are at about 5.5°N, 153.7°E. Oroluk atoll is at about 7.5°N, 155.2°E, which is close, but 7.0°N is about 55 km south of it, and the atoll is small. So this point is most likely water.

Water

7548.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 157.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean near Pohnpei, which is at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E. Pohnpei is roughly 1.2° east of this point. Other nearby islands: Mokil (Mwoakilloa) is at 6.68°N, 159.75°E, Pingelap is at 6.2°N, 160.7°E, and Nukuoro is at 3.8°N, 154.9°E. Kosrae is at 5.3°N, 163°E. Oroluk Atoll is at 7.5°N, 155.3°E, and Minto Reef is at 7.6°N, 149°E. Nothing sits exactly at 7.0°N, 157.0°E, so it is open ocean.

Water

7549.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 159.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean. Pohnpei, in the Federated States of Micronesia, is at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E. Its island extends roughly 158.1–158.35°E, so 159.0°E lies east of it. Nearby, Pingelap is at about 6.2°N, 160.7°E, and Mokil (Mwoakilloa) is at about 6.68°N, 159.75°E. Kosrae is at 5.3°N, 163°E. Nothing sits at 7.0°N, 159.0°E, so it is open water.

Water

7550.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 161.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean near Pohnpei, which sits at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E. Kosrae is at about 5.3°N, 163°E. At 7°N, 161°E there is no island that I know of, though Pingelap is at about 6.2°N, 160.7°E and Mokil at about 6.7°N, 159.8°E. Neither is at this point, so it is most likely open water.

Water

7551.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 163.0°E is in the western Pacific, near the Marshall Islands and Micronesia. Pohnpei is at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E, and Kosrae at 5.3°N, 163°E. Kwajalein is at about 9°N, 167°E. Ebon Atoll is at 4.6°N, 168.7°E. Nearby at 7°N, 163°E, I don't recall any island. Namdrik is at 5.6°N, 168°E. The Mortlock Islands are at about 5.5°N, 153°E. Ngatik (Nukuoro area) is at about 5.5°N, 157°E. Pingelap is at 6.2°N, 160.7°E. Mokil is at 6.7°N, 159.8°E. Kosrae is at 5.3°N, 163.0°E, which is 1.7° away, so 7.0°N is open ocean.

Water

7552.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 165.0°E is in the western Pacific, in the Marshall Islands region. Ebon Atoll is at about 4.6°N, 168.7°E, and Kwajalein is at about 9°N, 167.5°E. Ujelang is at about 9.8°N, 161°E, and Pingelap and Kosrae are around 5–7°N, 163°E. Kosrae sits at about 5.3°N, 163°E. The point at 7°N, 165°E lies between Pohnpei, at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E, and the Marshall Islands. Nothing known sits at that spot, so it is open ocean.

Water

7553.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 167.0°E lies in the Marshall Islands area. Kwajalein Atoll is at about 8.7°N, 167.7°E. Ebeye is at 8.8°N. Point 7.0°N, 167.0°E would be south of Kwajalein, and Lib Island is at 8.3°N, 167.4°E. Namu is at 8.1°N, 168.1°E. Ujae is at 8.9°N, 165.7°E. South of that there's little: Jaluit is at 6.0°N, 169.5°E, and Kili at 5.6°N, 169.1°E. Ebon is at 4.6°N, 168.7°E. So 7.0°N, 167.0°E is open ocean.

Water

7554.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 169.0°E is in the Marshall Islands area. Ebon Atoll is near 4.6°N, 168.7°E, Kwajalein is at 9°N, 167.4°E, Namu is near 8.0°N, 168.1°E, and Jabwot/Ailinglaplap is near 7.4°N, 168.7°E. Jaluit is at 5.9°N, 169.6°E. The point 7.0, 169.0 lies between Ailinglaplap (7.3N, 168.7E) and Jaluit, and is about 40 km from Ailinglaplap's southeastern edge. Ailinglaplap spans roughly 7.0–7.5°N and 168.6–169.0°E, but its land is mostly on the rim, and the point sits at the southeastern corner of the atoll, where the lagoon rim is mostly reef. It is most likely open water.

Water

7555.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 171.0°E is in the Marshall Islands area. Ailinglaplap is around 7.3°N, 168.7°E, Jaluit is around 5.9°N, 169.6°E, Kwajalein is around 9°N, 167.5°E, and Mili is around 6.1°N, 171.9°E. Knox Atoll (Mili) lies near 6.1°N, 171.9°E, so 7.0°N, 171.0°E sits between Mili and Namdrik. Namdrik is at 5.6°N, 168.1°E. Majuro is at 7.1°N, 171.4°E. Majuro Atoll spans roughly 7.0–7.2°N and 171.0–171.2°E, so the point is near the western end of Majuro's lagoon, where it is likely open ocean or lagoon, not land. Arrak is on the east side. The western side of Majuro Atoll includes Laura at about 7.0°N, 171.0°E. Laura is a village on the western tip, and its coordinates are about 7.07°N, 171.03°E. The point is close, but the land there is very thin, and 7.0 is slightly south of it, so it's probably water.

Water

7556.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 173.0°E lies in the Marshall Islands region. Ebon Atoll is at about 4.6°N, 168.7°E, Kwajalein is at 9°N, 167.5°E, and Wotje is at 9.5°N, 170°E. Majuro is at 7.1°N, 171.4°E. Mili is at 6.1°N, 171.9°E, and Knox Atoll is at 5.9°N, 171.6°E. Aur Atoll is at 8.3°N, 171.1°E. Further east, Maloelap is at 8.7°N, 171°E and Arno is at 7.1°N, 171.6°E. Nothing is near 7°N, 173°E, since the Marshall Islands' eastern edge is about 171.9°E. That point is open ocean.

Water

7557.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, Longitude 175.0°E lies in the Pacific Ocean. The Marshall Islands span roughly 160–173°E longitude, with the easternmost atolls (Wotje, Majuro, Mili, Arno) at about 171–172°E. Longitude 175°E is east of that, so no land is there.

Water

7558.text:
Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 177.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands region. The Marshall Islands span roughly 4.5–14.5°N and 160.5–172.5°E. Since 177°E is east of that range, the point falls in open ocean. Kwajalein is at about 167°E and Wake Island is at 19°N, 166.6°E. Nothing else is near 7°N, 177°E.

Water

Latitude 7.0°N, longitude 179.0°E lies in the central Pacific Ocean, east of the Marshall Islands (which reach about 172°E) and well west of Howland Island. No land is near that point.

Water

7562.text:
Latitude 5°N, longitude 175°W lies in the central Pacific. Nearby land is Kiribati's Line Islands, such as Kanton in the Phoenix Islands (about 2.8°S, 171.7°W) and Palmyra (5.9°N, 162°W). There is no land at 5°N, 175°W, so it is open ocean.

Water

7563.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 173.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean. The nearest land is Kingman Reef at about 6.4°N, 162.4°W and Palmyra at about 5.9°N, 162.1°W, and both are far to the east. Johnston Atoll is at about 16.7°N, 169.5°W, far to the north. The Phoenix Islands are near 3–4°S, 171–174°W, which is south of this point. Baker Island is at 0.2°N, 176.5°W, also well south. Nothing lies at 5°N, 173°W.

Water

7564.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 171.0°W lies in the central Pacific. Palmyra Atoll is at about 5.9°N, 162°W, and Kingman Reef is at 6.4°N, 162.4°W. The Phoenix Islands are near 3–4°S, 171–174°W. Nearby, Howland Island is at 0.8°N, 176.6°W, and Baker Island is at 0.2°N, 176.5°W. Johnston Atoll is at 16.7°N, 169.5°W. Nothing is known at 5°N, 171°W, so it is open ocean.

Water

7568.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 163.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean. The nearest land is Palmyra Atoll at about 5.9°N, 162.1°W, and Kingman Reef at about 6.4°N, 162.4°W. Both are around 100 km away, so this point is open water.

Water

7570.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 159.0°W is in the central Pacific. Palmyra Atoll sits at about 5.88°N, 162.08°W, and Kingman Reef at 6.4°N, 162.4°W. Kiritimati (Christmas Island) is at about 1.9°N, 157.4°W, and Fanning Island (Tabuaeran) at 3.9°N, 159.4°W. Washington Island (Teraina) is at 4.7°N, 160.4°W. The point 5.0°N, 159.0°W is about 1° from Teraina and roughly 1° from Tabuaeran, so it is not on either island. It is open ocean.

Water

7571.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -157.0 (157° W) is in the central Pacific. Kiribati's Line Islands are nearby: Teraina (Washington Island) is at about 4.7N, 160.4W, Tabuaeran (Fanning) at 3.9N, 159.3W, and Kiritimati at 1.9N, 157.4W. Palmyra Atoll is at 5.88N, 162.1W. So there is nothing at 5N, 157W.

Water

7593.text:
Latitude 5°N, longitude -113° is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico and far from any land.

Water

7594.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 111.0°W is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico and far from any land.

Water

7599.text:
Latitude 5°N, longitude -101° is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico and well west of Colombia/Panama.

Water

7600.text:
Latitude 5°N, longitude -99°W is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico (Acapulco is at about 16.8°N). At 5°N, the coast of Central America lies far to the east, so this point is open ocean.

Water

7601.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -97.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Mexico (Oaxaca coast is around 16 N). At 5 N, it is far from any land.

Water

7603.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -93.0 is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Costa Rica and far from any land.

Water

7604.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude 91.0 W is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, southwest of Central America and well west of Colombia and Ecuador. The Galápagos Islands are near 0°, 90°W, which is about 5 degrees south of this point, so they don't reach it.

Water

7605.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -89.0 is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Central America, well off the coast of Costa Rica and Panama.

Water

7607.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 85.0°W is in the Pacific Ocean, south of Costa Rica and Panama. Cocos Island is at about 5.5°N, 87°W, which is farther west, so this point is open water.

Water

7608.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -83.0 is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Costa Rica and Panama. Cocos Island sits at about 5.5 N, 87 W, which is much farther west, so it is not close. Costa Rica's coast near the Osa Peninsula is around 8.5 N, 83.5 W, so this point is well south of it.

Water

7609.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -81.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Panama (Panama's southern coast is around 7-8°N, and Coiba is near -81.7). At 5°N, -81°W, that is well offshore, in open water.

Water

7610.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -79.0 W. This is in the Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia. Colombia's Pacific coast is around -77 to -77.5 at 5°N. The Gulf of Panama and Malpelo island is at 4.0N, -81.6. So -79 at 5N is ocean.

Water

7611.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -77.0 W. This is off the Pacific coast of Colombia. Colombia's Pacific coast near Chocó: Cabo Corrientes is at about 5.5°N, 77.5°W. Bahía Solano is at 6.2°N, 77.4°W. At 5.0°N, the coast is around 77.35°W (near Juradó/Nuquí is 5.7°N, 77.27°W). Near 4.95°N, the coast is around 77.4°W (the mouth of the San Juan River is at 4.25°N, 77.4°W). So at -77.0, we are inland, about 40 km from the coast. That is land in Chocó, near Risaralda/Valle del Cauca.

Land

7612.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, Longitude -75.0 W is in Colombia, in the Caldas/Antioquia area near the Magdalena River valley. This is land.

Land

7613.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, Longitude -73.0 W is in Colombia, in the Boyacá/Santander region, so it is on land.

Land

7614.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -71.0 W is in Colombia/Venezuela border area. Colombia's eastern plains (Llanos), near Vichada/Arauca/Casanare. At 5°N, 71°W, that's in Casanare/Vichada, which is land.

Land

7615.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude -69.0° is in southeastern Colombia/Venezuela border area. The Orinoco River forms the border around there; at 5°N, 69°W, this is near Puerto Carreño (6.19°N, 67.48°W), so the point is southwest of it, in Vichada, Colombia. That is land.

Land

7616.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude -67.0° is in Venezuela, near the Orinoco River area. Puerto Ayacucho is at 5.66°N, 67.6°W. The Orinoco forms the Colombia–Venezuela border near there. At 5.0°N, 67.0°W, the point is just inside Colombia's Vichada department, near the Orinoco. The river is at about 67.8°W at this latitude, so the point is on land, in Venezuela's Amazonas state or Colombia's Vichada.

Land

7617.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, Longitude -65.0 W is in Venezuela, in Bolívar state, south of the Orinoco River. The Orinoco at longitude -65 sits around 7-8°N, so 5°N is well south of it, in the Guiana Highlands area. That is land.

Land

7618.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude -63.0° is in southeastern Venezuela, in Bolívar state, which is land.

Land

7619.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude -61.0° is in Guyana/Venezuela border region. Guyana spans roughly 1° to 8.5°N, and -56.5 to -61.4 W. At 5°N, 61°W: this is near the Guyana–Brazil–Venezuela area (Pakaraima mountains, Mount Roraima is at 5.14N, 60.76W). So 5.0, -61.0 is in Venezuela's Gran Sabana or Brazil's Roraima state. Land.

Land

7620.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, Longitude -59.0° falls in Guyana. Guyana spans roughly 1°N to 8.5°N and 56.5°W to 61.4°W. At 5°N, 59°W, that is in the interior, in the area near the Pakaraima/Rupununi region, so it is land.

Land

7621.text:
Latitude 5.0, longitude -57.0 falls in Suriname, near the border with Guyana. Suriname's coast is at about 6°N, and at 57°W the coast sits around 5.9°N. So 5.0°N is inland, which makes it land.

Land

7622.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 55.0°W is off the coast of Suriname/French Guiana. The Suriname coast sits at about 6°N at 55°W, so 5°N is inland, which makes it land. Suriname's interior at 5°N, 55°W is rainforest, so it is land.

Land

7623.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -53.0 W is just off the coast of French Guiana. French Guiana's coast runs from about -51.6 (Cape Orange) to -54.0 (Maroni River). At longitude -53, the coast is around 5.5 N (near Sinnamary/Iracoubo, about 5.4 N). So 5.0 N is inland, which makes it land.

The coast near Kourou is at 5.15 N, -52.65, and near Sinnamary at 5.38 N, -52.95. At -53.0 the coast is therefore around 5.4 N, and 5.0 N lies about 40 km inland.

**Land**

7624.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -51.0 W. That is off the coast of French Guiana/Brazil (Amapá). The coast of French Guiana lies around 5.5°N at -53°W, and at -51°W the coast of Amapá is near 4°N, around Cabo Orange (4.5°N, -51.5°W). At 5°N, -51°W, that is in the Atlantic Ocean, north of Cabo Orange.

Water

7625.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, Longitude -49.0 W. This is off the coast of French Guiana/Suriname. The coast of French Guiana is around 5.0-5.7°N between longitudes -52 and -54. At -49 W, the coast is far to the east, so this point is in the Atlantic Ocean. Brazil's Amapá coast lies near 4.5°N at -51. At -49, the point is at sea.

Water

7626.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -47.0 W is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the northern coast of Brazil. The Amazon mouth lies near 0°, -50°. The coast at -47° is around 0.7°S, so 5°N is well offshore.

Water

7627.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, Longitude -45.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, well off the coast of Brazil, which at that latitude lies near -50 and beyond.

Water

7628.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -43.0 W is in the Atlantic Ocean, well off the northern coast of Brazil. The Brazilian coast near the Amazon mouth is around 50°W at the equator, and the coast at 43°W lies near 2.5°S. So 5°N, 43°W is in the open ocean.

Water

7629.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -41.0 W is in the Atlantic Ocean. The northeast coast of Brazil lies around -35 to -50 W, but at 5°N the coast runs near the Guianas (about -52 W). At -41 W, 5°N, this is well out in the Atlantic.

Water

7630.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -39.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the northeast coast of Brazil. Brazil's coast near the equator is at about -50 longitude (Amapá), and the northeast bulge reaches about -35 at 5°S. At 5°N, -39 is far out in the Atlantic.

Water

7631.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -37.0 (37 W) is in the Atlantic Ocean, well off the coast of Brazil (the nearest coast at the mouth of the Amazon is around 50 W).

Water

7632.text:
Latitude 5.0 (north), longitude -35.0 (west) is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the northeast coast of Brazil. Brazil's easternmost point is around -34.8 longitude at about -7 latitude, and at 5°N the coast is near -51, so this point is far out in open ocean.

Water

7634.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 31.0°W is in the central Atlantic Ocean, far from any coast.

Water

7639.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -21.0 W is in the Atlantic Ocean, well off the coast of West Africa.

Water

7640.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude 19.0 W falls in the Atlantic Ocean, well off the coast of West Africa.

Water

7641.text:

Water

7642.text:
Latitude 5°N, longitude 15°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the coast of Sierra Leone/Guinea. The coast of Sierra Leone is at about 8°N, and at 5°N the coastline is around 8-10°W. So 15°W is well offshore.

Water

7643.text:
Latitude 5.0 N, longitude -13.0 W. Liberia's coast runs from about 4.35N, 7.5W to 7.5N, 11.5W, and Sierra Leone's coast reaches roughly 7.5N at 13W. At 5N, the coast of Liberia lies near 9W, so 13W is well out in the Atlantic Ocean.
