7722.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 145.0°E is in the western Pacific, north of Papua New Guinea. Chuuk (Truk) is at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E. Pohnpei is at 6.9°N, 158°E. The Caroline Islands near 145°E include Namonuito Atoll at about 8.7°N, 150°E. Satawan is at 5.3°N, 153.7°E. Nukuoro is at 3.8°N, 154.9°E. Woleai is at 7.4°N, 143.9°E. Eauripik is at 6.7°N, 143.1°E. Ifalik is at 7.2°N, 144.5°E. Sorol is at 8°N, 140.4°E. The coast of New Guinea at 145°E is around 5°S. At 5°N, 145°E there is no known island, so it's open ocean.

Water

7723.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 147.0°E is in the western Pacific, north of Papua New Guinea. It lies south of Chuuk (Truk) in Micronesia, which is around 7.4°N, 151.8°E, and near the Caroline Islands. The nearest land is probably Nukuoro or Kapingamarangi. Nukuoro is at about 3.8°N, 154.9°E and Kapingamarangi at about 1.1°N, 154.8°E, both far to the east. The Hermit Islands and Manus are at about 2°S, 147°E, which is 7° south. Nothing lies at 5°N, 147°E, so it is open ocean.

Water

7724.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 149.0°E lies in the western Pacific, north of Papua New Guinea's New Ireland and Bougainville, and south of Chuuk (Truk) in Micronesia. Chuuk Lagoon is around 7.4°N, 151.8°E. The point at 5°N, 149°E is in open ocean, and nothing nearby is land. The Nomoi/Mortlocks are near 5.5°N, 153°E, and Nukuoro is at 3.8°N, 154.9°E. So the point is open water.

Water

7725.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, Longitude 151.0°E is in the western Pacific, north of Papua New Guinea's New Ireland and near Chuuk (Truk) in Micronesia, which lies around 7.4°N, 151.8°E. At 5°N, 151°E, there is open ocean south of Chuuk. Nearby atolls, such as Nukuoro (3.8°N, 154.9°E) and Kapingamarangi (1.1°N, 154.8°E), are farther away, so this point is open water.

Water

7726.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 153.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. Pohnpei is at about 158°E and Chuuk at about 151.8°E, 7.4°N. Nearby atolls are the Nomoi Islands at about 153°E, 5.5°N, which includes Satawan (5.35°N, 153.0°E) and Lukunor (5.5°N, 153.8°E). The point at 5.0°N, 153.0°E is about 0.35° south of Satawan, roughly 40 km away, so it should be open water.

Water

7727.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 155.0°E lies in the western Pacific, northeast of Papua New Guinea's Bougainville and north of the Solomon Islands. Nearby land includes the Nuguria and Carteret atolls to the south, and Pohnpei, Micronesia, to the northeast at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E. The point itself is open ocean, near the Caroline Islands region. The Mortlock Islands are around 5.5°N, 153.7°E, and Nukuoro is at 3.8°N, 154.9°E. This point is about 1.2° north of Nukuoro, so it is open water.

Water

7728.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 157.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. Pohnpei is at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E, and Kosrae is at 5.3°N, 163°E. Nearby atolls include Pingelap at 6.2°N, 160.7°E, and Nukuoro at 3.8°N, 154.9°E. Kapingamarangi is at 1.1°N, 154.8°E. Oroluk is at 7.5°N, 155.3°E, and Minto Reef is farther north. Nothing is at exactly 5°N, 157°E.

Water

7729.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 159.0°E is in the western Pacific, near Pohnpei (about 6.9°N, 158.2°E). Pohnpei lies farther north than this point. Nearby is Pingelap at about 6.2°N, 160.7°E, and Nukuoro at about 3.8°N, 154.9°E. Kapingamarangi is at about 1.1°N, 154.8°E. Sapwuahfik (Ngatik) is at about 5.8°N, 157.2°E. The point 5.0°N, 159.0°E is not near any of these islands, so it is open ocean.

Water

7730.text:
Latitude 5°N, longitude 161°E is in the western Pacific, near Pohnpei (about 6.9°N, 158.2°E) and Kosrae (5.3°N, 163°E). The point at 5°N, 161°E lies between them, so it is open ocean. Nearby small atolls such as Nukuoro (3.8°N, 154.9°E) and Kapingamarangi (1.1°N, 154.8°E) are too far west and south to matter.

Water

7731.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 163.0°E is in the western Pacific, near the Marshall Islands and the Caroline Islands. Pohnpei sits at about 6.9°N, 158.2°E, and Kosrae at about 5.3°N, 163.0°E, so this point is close to Kosrae. Kosrae is a small island about 16 km across, spanning roughly 162.9–163.05°E and 5.25–5.38°N. The point at 5.0°N is about 30 km south of the island's southern edge, so it falls in open ocean.

Water

7732.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 165.0°E lies in the Pacific Ocean, north of the Marshall Islands (which sit roughly 5–15°N, 165–172°E). Ebon Atoll is at about 4.6°N, 168.7°E, and Kwajalein is at 9°N, 167°E. The point at 5°N, 165°E is west of the Marshalls and east of Pohnpei (about 158°E), and Kosrae is at 163°E, 5.3°N. That puts it about 2° east of Kosrae, which is roughly 220 km away, so it is open ocean.

Water

7733.text:
Location 5°N, 167°E is in the Pacific Ocean near the Marshall Islands. Marshall Islands: Kwajalein ~9°N 167°E; Ujelang ~9.8°N 160.9°E; Wake Island 19°N 167°E. At 5°N 167°E, there's nothing nearby, as the Marshall Islands' southernmost point is around 4.6°N (Mili Atoll is at 6.1°N, 171.9°E). Nauru is at 0.5°S, 166.9°E. So 5°N 167°E is water.

Water

7734.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, Longitude 169.0°E is in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands region. The Marshall Islands lie between about 4.5°N and 14.5°N and between 160.8°E and 172°E. The southernmost atolls are Ebon (4.6°N, 168.7°E) and Namorik (5.6°N, 168.1°E). A point at 5.0°N, 169.0°E is about 40 km from Ebon, which is a small atoll, so the point falls in open water.

Water

7735.text:
Latitude 5°N, longitude 171°E is in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands region. The Marshall Islands lie roughly between 4°–14°N and 160°–173°E. At 5°N, 171°E, the nearest atoll is Ebon (4.6°N, 168.7°E), and Namorik is at 5.6°N, 168.1°E. Jaluit is at 5.9°N, 169.6°E. Further east, Mili Atoll is at 6.1°N, 171.9°E, and Knox Atoll is at 5.9°N, 171.1°E. Since 5.0°N, 171.0°E is about 0.9° south of Knox, it is not on land.

Water

7736.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 173.0°E lies in the Pacific Ocean, in the Marshall Islands region. The Marshall Islands span roughly 4.5–14.5°N and 160.8–172.2°E. Ebon Atoll, the southernmost, sits near 4.6°N, 168.7°E, and Mili is around 6.1°N, 171.9°E. The point at 5°N, 173°E is east of these and south of the main chain. Nearby Knox Atoll is at about 5.6°N, 171.1°E. Nothing lies at 5°N, 173°E, and Kiribati's Gilbert Islands begin further south (Butaritari at about 3°N, 172.8°E), so the point is open ocean.

Water

7737.text:
Latitude 5°N, longitude 175°E is in the central Pacific, north of the Marshall Islands (which lie roughly 5-15°N, 165-172°E). The nearest land is probably Mili Atoll at about 6.1°N, 171.9°E, and Knox Atoll at about 5.9°N, 171.9°E, both well to the west. Land near 175°E at 5°N? Not that I know of. The Gilbert Islands begin around 3°N, 173°E (Butaritari at 3.0°N, 172.8°E), and Tarawa is at 1.4°N, 173°E. So nothing at 5°N, 175°E.

Water

7738.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 177.0°E is in the central Pacific. The nearest land is the Marshall Islands, which lie to the west and north around 170-172°E, and Kiribati's Gilbert Islands, which lie around 173°E at about 1°N. Wake Island is at 19°N, so it is far to the north. Nothing is at 5°N, 177°E, so it is open ocean.

Water

7739.text:
Latitude 5.0°N, longitude 179.0°E is in the central Pacific Ocean. Nearby land is far away: the Marshall Islands are around 170°E, and Kiribati's Gilbert Islands are near 173°E at about 1°N. Howland and Baker Islands are near 176°W at 0°N. The point is at 5°N, 179°E, which is open ocean.

Water

7740.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 179.0°W is in the central Pacific. It lies east of the Gilbert Islands and the Phoenix Islands. Kiribati's Line Islands are further east, starting around 160°W, and Kanton in the Phoenix group is at about 171.7°W, 2.8°S. Nothing is at 3°N, 179°W, so it is open ocean.

Water

7741.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 177.0°W is in the central Pacific. Kiribati's Line Islands are around 160°W, and the Phoenix Islands are around 170–175°W, at about 3–4°S. Near 3°N, 177°W there is no island, so this is open ocean.

Water

7742.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 175.0°W lies in the central Pacific. Kiribati's Line Islands are nearby, but the Phoenix Islands sit around 3–4°S and 171°W, and Kanton is at 2.8°S, 171.7°W. Palmyra is at 5.9°N, 162°W, and Kiritimati is at 1.9°N, 157°W. Nothing is known at 3°N, 175°W, so it is open ocean.

Water

7743.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 173.0°W is in the central Pacific. Nearby land: Kiribati's Line Islands lie to the east, with Kanton in the Phoenix Islands at about 2.8°S, 171.7°W. Palmyra Atoll is at 5.9°N, 162°W. Baker Island is at 0.2°N, 176.5°W. Howland Island is at 0.8°N, 176.6°W. Nothing is at 3°N, 173°W, so it is open ocean.

Water

7744.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 171.0°W is in the central Pacific. Nearby land includes Kiribati's Line Islands to the east (Kiritimati is at 1.9°N, 157°W) and the Phoenix Islands to the south (Kanton is at 2.8°S, 171.7°W). Palmyra is at 5.9°N, 162°W. Nothing sits at 3°N, 171°W, so it is open ocean.

Water

7745.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 169.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean. The nearest land is Kingman Reef and Palmyra Atoll, at about 6°N, 162°W, and Howland/Baker at 0°N, 176°W. The point has no land close by.

Water

7748.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 163.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and north of the equator. The nearest land is Palmyra Atoll at about 5.9°N, 162.1°W, and Kingman Reef at about 6.4°N, so this point is well away from both. Kiritimati lies at about 1.9°N, 157.4°W, which is also far from it.

Water

7750.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -159.0° (159°W) is in the central Pacific. Palmyra Atoll sits at about 5.9°N, 162°W, and Kingman Reef is at 6.4°N, 162.4°W. Kiritimati (Christmas Island) is at 1.9°N, 157.4°W. The point 3°N, 159°W is roughly 150 km from Kiritimati, and nothing else is nearby, so it is open ocean.

Water

7751.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, Longitude -157.0° is in the central Pacific. Kiritimati (Christmas Island) lies at about 1.9°N, 157.4°W. Teraina (Washington Island) is at 4.7°N, 160.4°W. Tabuaeran (Fanning) is at 3.9°N, 159.3°W. The point 3.0°N, 157.0°W is between Kiritimati and Fanning, in open ocean.

Water

7753.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 153.0°W lies in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and near the Line Islands. The nearest land, such as Kiritimati at about 1.9°N, 157.4°W and Palmyra at about 5.9°N, 162°W, is far from this point, so it falls in open ocean.

Water

7756.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 147.0°W is in the central Pacific Ocean, south of Hawaii and north of the equator. It is far from any land.

Water

7758.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -143.0° (143°W) is in the central Pacific Ocean, southeast of Hawaii and north of the Marquesas Islands. There is no land there.

Water

7777.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -105.0° is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, well west of Colombia and Ecuador and south of Mexico.

7778.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -103.0° is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia/Ecuador and well south of Mexico.

Water

7779.text:
Latitude 3.0, Longitude -101.0 is in the Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia/Ecuador and far south of Mexico. That is well offshore.

Water

7780.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -99.0 is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia and south of Mexico. That area is far from any land.

Water

7781.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, longitude -97.0 is in the Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia and Costa Rica, roughly 1,000 km southwest of Costa Rica's Cocos Island. That is open ocean.

Water

7782.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -95.0° is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia and Ecuador and south of Panama, so it is water.

Water

7783.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -93.0 is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia and Ecuador and south of Costa Rica and Cocos Island (about 5.5°N, 87°W). The Galápagos Islands are at about 0°N, 90°W, so this point is roughly 3° north of them and not on land.

Water

7784.text:
Latitude 3.0 (north), longitude -91.0 is in the eastern Pacific Ocean, west of Ecuador and the Galápagos (which sit at about -0.5 to -91). The Galápagos lie between about 1.7°N and 1.4°S. The northernmost island, Darwin at 1.68°N, 92°W, is still well south of 3°N, so this point is open ocean.

Water

7785.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, Longitude -89.0 is in the Pacific Ocean, west of Ecuador and the Galápagos Islands (which sit at about -90 longitude, 0 latitude). At 3°N it is well north of the islands and nowhere near land.

Water

7786.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 87.0°W is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Costa Rica and well north of the Galápagos Islands. Cocos Island sits at about 5.5°N, 87°W, so this point is roughly 2.5° south of it, which is open ocean.

Water

7787.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -85.0° is in the Pacific Ocean, southwest of Costa Rica and Panama, so it is water.

**Water**

7788.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -83.0° is in the Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia and southwest of Costa Rica (Cocos Island is at about 5.5°N, 87°W). Colombia's western coast is around -77°. So -83 is ocean.

Water

7789.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, longitude -81.0 W is in the Pacific Ocean, west of Colombia and Ecuador. Colombia's coast is at about -77.5 at that latitude, so -81 is roughly 400 km offshore. Malpelo Island is at 4.0 N, -81.6 W, which is close but not at the point.

Water

7790.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, Longitude -79.0 W. This is off the coast of Colombia/Ecuador. The Colombian Pacific coast at latitude 3°N is around longitude -77.3 (Buenaventura at 3.9N, -77.0). At 3°N, the coast is about -77.5. So -79.0 is in the Pacific Ocean.

Water

7791.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, Longitude -77.0 W is in Colombia, near Buenaventura, which sits at about 3.88 N, -77.03 W. At 3.0 N, -77.0 W, the Pacific coast is around -77.4 W at that latitude (near the Naya River mouth, about 3.2 N, -77.5). So -77.0 is inland, in Valle del Cauca, which is land.

Land

7792.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, longitude -75.0 W is in Colombia. It falls near the Huila/Caquetá border region, which is land.

Land

7793.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -73.0° is in Colombia, in the Llanos region, in or near the Meta/Guaviare area. That is land.

Land

7794.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, Longitude -71.0 is in Colombia (Vichada/Meta region, eastern Colombia near the Orinoco). Colombia's eastern plains span about -67 to -75 longitude at 3°N, so this point is on land.

Land

7795.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, longitude -69.0 W falls in Colombia/Venezuela border region. Around 3°N, 69°W: the Orinoco River forms the border near Puerto Carreño (6.2°N, 67.5°W). At 3°N, 69°W, this is in Guainía/Vichada, Colombia, near the Inírida area (3.87°N, 67.9°W). So it's land.

Land

7796.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -67.0° falls in the Amazon/Orinoco region, in southeastern Colombia/Venezuela near the Orinoco River, which is land.

Land

7797.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, longitude -65.0 is in southern Venezuela, in the Amazonas state near the Brazilian border. Longitude -65 at latitude 3 is inland, on the Guiana Shield, so it is land.

Land

7798.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -63.0 is in northern Brazil, in Roraima state, near the Venezuelan border. That area is land.

Land

7799.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -61.0° is in northern Brazil, in Roraima state, near Boa Vista (2.8°N, 60.7°W). It is on land.

Land

7800.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -59.0° lies in Guyana, near the border with Brazil, in the Rupununi savanna and Kanuku region. Guyana spans roughly 1°N to 8.5°N, and at 59°W the land is within Guyana's southern part, so this is land.

Land

7801.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -57.0°W is in northern Brazil/Suriname/Guyana area. Suriname's southern border with Brazil is around 2°N, and at longitude -57 that's inside southern Suriname (the Kutari/Sipaliwini area), which is land.

Land

7802.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -55.0° is in northern Brazil/Suriname region. Suriname spans roughly 2°N to 6°N, and longitude -54 to -58. At 3°N, -55°, that's southern Suriname, which is land (rainforest).

Land

7803.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -53.0° is in French Guiana/Suriname area. French Guiana spans roughly 2.1°N to 5.7°N and -54.6° to -51.6°W. At 3°N, -53°W, that is in the interior of French Guiana, near the Suriname border region (the border is at about -54°). So it is land.

Land

7804.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -51.0° is near the coast of Amapá, Brazil. The Amazon mouth is around 0°, -50°. At 3°N, -51°W, that's in Amapá state, inland of the coast (the coast at that latitude is around -51.0 to -50.0). Cape Orange is at about 4.5°N, -51.5°W. The coast at 3°N is around -51.0°W (near Calçoene, 2.5°N, -50.95°W). So 3.0°N, -51.0°W is just inland, since the coast trends northwest. Calçoene is at 2.50°N, 50.95°W, inland slightly. The coast at 3°N is about -50.8°W. So -51.0 is land.

Land

7805.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, Longitude -49.0 is near the mouth of the Amazon, off the coast of Amapá, Brazil. The Amapá coast is around 50°W at latitude 2-3°N. At 3°N, the coast sits around -51°W, so -49 is in the Atlantic Ocean.

Water

7806.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -47.0 is near the mouth of the Amazon, off the coast of Brazil. The Amazon mouth region: Marajó island sits around 0°S, 50°W. At 3°N, 47°W, the coast of Amapá is around 2°N at 50°W. The coast runs northwest from there toward French Guiana at about 5°N, 52°W. So at 47°W, 3°N, the point is well east of the coast, in the Atlantic Ocean.

Water

7807.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 45.0°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the northeast coast of Brazil, roughly 700 km or more from land, so it is water.

Water

7808.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -43.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the northeast coast of Brazil. The Brazilian coast near the equator sits around -44 to -50 longitude at latitude 0 to 3, so -43 is east of the coast. The coast at latitude 3°N is near the Amapá region, around -51, and the coast at about 2.9°S is near -41 (Ceará). At 3°N, -43 is well offshore.

Water

7809.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -41.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, but let me check: Brazil's northeast coast bulges to about -35° at 5°S. At 3°N, the coast near the Amazon mouth is around -50°. At 3°N, -41° is far east of the coast... the coast at the equator runs from about -50° (Amazon mouth) to Fortaleza (-38.5°, 3.7°S). At 3°N, land lies west of about -51° (Guianas). So -41° is ocean.

Water

7810.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 39.0°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the northeast coast of Brazil. Brazil's northern coast near the equator is around 40-50°W, and at 3°N the land is the Guianas and northern Brazil, which sit further west (around 50°W). So this point is far out at sea.

Water

7811.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 37.0°W is in the equatorial Atlantic Ocean, far from the coast of Brazil, which is around 35°W at its easternmost point and lies farther south.

Water

7812.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 35.0°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the northeast coast of Brazil. Brazil's easternmost point is near 34.8°W at about 7°S, and at 3°N the coast lies near 50°W, so this point is well out at sea.

Water

7815.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 29.0°W is in the equatorial Atlantic Ocean, far from any coastline.

Water

7816.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -27.0° is in the central Atlantic Ocean, far from any landmass.

Water

7819.text:

Water

7820.text:

**Water**

7821.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude -17.0° lies in the Atlantic Ocean, west of Africa and well off the coast.

Water

7822.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 15.0°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, west of Africa (Liberia/Sierra Leone coast is around 10°W at 6-8°N). At 3°N, the African coast (Gulf of Guinea) is far to the east, so this point is in open ocean.

Water

7823.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 13.0°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, west of Sierra Leone and Liberia, which are around 7-8°N. At 3°N the African coast sits at about 9°E (Gulf of Guinea), so this point is well out in the ocean.

Water

7824.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 11.0°W is in the Atlantic Ocean, off the coast of Liberia (which lies around 6°N, 10°W). Going south to 3°N places the point well out in the ocean.

Water

7825.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -9.0 is in the Atlantic Ocean, in the Gulf of Guinea, south of Liberia and west of Gabon. Liberia's coast runs from about 4.3°N at 7.5°W to 6.5°N at 11°W, so at 3°N, 9°W the point is well offshore.

Water

7826.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, Longitude -7.0 (7°W). This is in the Gulf of Guinea region... Côte d'Ivoire's coast is at about 5°N, so 3°N at 7°W is south of the coast, in the Atlantic Ocean.

Water

7827.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -5.0 is in the Gulf of Guinea. The Ivory Coast coast sits at about 5°N, so 3°N, 5°W is south of it, in the ocean.

Water

7828.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, Longitude -3.0 (3° W). This is in the Gulf of Guinea, south of Ghana/Ivory Coast. Ivory Coast's coast is at about 5°N, so 3°N is ocean.

Water

7829.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude -1.0 is in the Gulf of Guinea, south of Ghana (coast at about 5°N). Ghana's coast lies near 4.7-5°N at longitude -2 to -1, so 3°N is about 200 km offshore in the ocean.

Water

7830.text:
Latitude 3.0, Longitude 1.0 is in the Gulf of Guinea, south of Ghana (the coast is around 5°N). At 3°N, 1°E, that is open ocean.

Water

7831.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 3.0°E is in the Gulf of Guinea, south of Nigeria and Benin. The coast there is at about 6°N, so 3°N is in the ocean.

Water

7832.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 5.0°E is in the Gulf of Guinea, south of Nigeria's coast (the Niger Delta is around 4.3–5°N). At 3°N, 5°E, that's open ocean.

Water

7833.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, Longitude 7.0°E is in the Gulf of Guinea, south of the Nigerian coast (the coast is around 4.3-6°N at this longitude). The Niger Delta lies at about 4.5-6°N, so 3°N is offshore.

Water

7834.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 9.0°E is in the Gulf of Guinea, off the coast of Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea. The coast of Cameroon near Kribi is at about 2.9°N, 9.9°E, and Bioko Island is at about 3.5°N, 8.7°E. The point at 3.0°N, 9.0°E lies west of the Cameroon coast and southeast of Bioko, so it is in the water.

**Water**

7835.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 11.0°E is in southern Cameroon, near the border with Gabon and Equatorial Guinea. That is inland, so it is land.

Land

7836.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude 13.0 falls in Cameroon, in Central Africa. That is south of the Sanaga River, in the forested region near Ebolowa, so it's land.

Land

7837.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 15.0°E falls in Central Africa, in southern Cameroon, which is land.

Land

7838.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 17.0°E falls in Central Africa, in the northern Republic of the Congo or the southern Central African Republic. The Congo/CAR border near there is around 3-4°N, and Cameroon is to the west at about 15-16°E. Either way, the point is inland.

Land

7839.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 19.0°E falls in central Africa, in the Central African Republic or the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ubangi River forms the border near 4°N, so 3°N, 19°E is just south of it, in the DRC, which is land.

Land

7840.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 21.0°E falls in Central Africa. That is in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, near the northern part of the country (Equateur/Mongala/Nord-Ubangi area), and it is land.

Land

7841.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 23.0°E is in Central Africa, in the northern Democratic Republic of the Congo near the border with the Central African Republic. That is land.

Land

7842.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 25.0°E falls in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, in the northern part of the country near the Congo River basin. That is land.

Land

7843.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude 27.0 is in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, in the northern part of the country near the Congo River basin. That is land.

Land

7844.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 29.0°E is in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, in the Ituri/Haut-Uélé region, which is land.

Land

7845.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 31.0°E falls in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, close to the border with South Sudan and Uganda, so it is on land.

Land

7846.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 33.0°E is in Uganda, near Lake Kyoga. Lake Kyoga spans roughly 1–2.5°N and 32–34°E, so 3.0°N is north of it. Northern Uganda around Lira and Kitgum sits at about 2.2–3.3°N, and the point is near the Aswa River region, at about 3°N, 33°E, which is land.

Land

7847.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, Longitude 35.0°E is in northern Kenya or southern Ethiopia/South Sudan border area. Lake Turkana spans roughly 2.5°N to 4.6°N and 35.8°E to 36.6°E. At 35.0°E, that's west of the lake, so it is land (Kenya's Turkana region, near the Ilemi Triangle).

Land

7848.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 37.0°E is in northern Kenya, east of Lake Turkana, which lies near 36°E. This point is in the Marsabit area, so it is on land.

Land

7849.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, Longitude 39.0°E is in northern Kenya, near Marsabit, which is on land.

Land

7850.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude 41.0 is in Africa, in southern Somalia/Kenya border region. Somalia's coast is around 41-48°E at that latitude. At 3°N, the coast of Somalia is near 47°E, and Kenya's northeast lies around 41°E. So 3°N, 41°E is in Ethiopia/Kenya/Somalia border land, which is land.

Land

7851.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, longitude 43.0 E is in Somalia, which lies on land. The Somali coast at that latitude is around 47-48°E, so 43°E is well inland (near the Ethiopia/Somalia/Kenya region, in southern Somalia's Gedo/Bay area).

Land

7852.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 45.0°E is in Somalia, near the central region (around Galguduud/Hiraan area). The Somali coast at 45°E is around 2°N to 3°N... Mogadishu is at 2.05°N, 45.34°E, which is on the coast. At 45.0°E, the coast is slightly northwest of Mogadishu; the coast runs northeast from Mogadishu. At 45.0°E, the coastline lies roughly at 2.3°N or so, to the southwest of Mogadishu the coast runs southwest (Merca at 1.7°N, 44.8°E). So at 45.0°E the coast is about 1.9°N. Thus 3.0°N is inland.

**Land**

7853.text:
Latitude 3.0, Longitude 47.0 is in Somalia (near the Galguduud/Middle Shabelle region), which is on land. Somalia's coast at that latitude lies further east, around 48-49°E at 3°N. At 3°N the coast is roughly at 47.5°E (near Hobyo is 5°N, 48.5°E; Mogadishu is 2°N, 45.3°E; Adale 2.75°N, 46.5°E; Harardhere 4.8°N, 47.8°E). The coast between Adale (46.5°E) and Harardhere (47.8°E) runs northeast, so at 3°N the coast is around 46.7°E. So 47.0°E at 3°N would be just inland of the coast, or possibly in the ocean. The coastline: Adale at 2.75°N, 46.3°E; Warsheikh 2.3°N, 45.8°E; Mareeg 3.8°N, 47.3°E. Linear interpolation from Adale (2.75, 46.3) to Mareeg (3.8, 47.3): at 3.0°N, the longitude is ~46.55°E. So 47.0 is east of the coast, which means water.

Water

7854.text:
Latitude 3.0, Longitude 49.0 is in the Indian Ocean, east of Somalia. Somalia's east coast at 3°N is around 47.5°E (near Hobyo is 5°N, 48.5°E; at 3°N the coast is around 47.4°E). So 49°E at 3°N lies offshore.

Water

7855.text:
Latitude 3.0, Longitude 51.0: this is in Somalia region? Longitude 51°E at latitude 3°N is in the Indian Ocean, east of Somalia. Somalia's coast at 3°N is around 47°E. So 51°E is water.

Water

7856.text:
Latitude 3.0, Longitude 53.0 is in the western Indian Ocean, east of Somalia. Somalia's easternmost point is about 51.3°E, and at 3°N the coast is around 47°E. So 53°E is well into the ocean.

Water

7857.text:
Latitude 3.0, Longitude 55.0 is in the western Indian Ocean, northeast of Madagascar and southwest of the Seychelles. The Seychelles are around 4.6°S, 55.5°E, so 3°N is about 7-8° north of them and well away from any island. That puts it in open ocean.

Water

7858.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 57.0°E is in the western Indian Ocean, northeast of Madagascar and southwest of the Maldives and Chagos region. It lies well away from any land.

Water

7859.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude 59.0 is in northern Brazil, in Roraima state. Roraima spans roughly 5°N to 1°S and 58° to 65°W. At 3°N, 59°W, that is south of Lethem (Guyana border near 3.4°N, 59.8°W). The point is just east of the Brazil-Guyana border area, near the Rupununi region of southern Guyana, and it is land.

Land

7860.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude 61.0 is in the Indian Ocean, southwest of the Maldives (which lie at about 73°E), so it is open water.

Water

7861.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 63.0°E is in the Arabian Sea/Indian Ocean, west of the Maldives and southwest of India, so it is water.

Water

7862.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 65.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, southwest of India and east of Somalia. The Maldives are at about 73°E, so this point is well to their west. There is no land near it.

Water

7863.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 67.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, west of the Maldives and southwest of India, so it is water.

Water

7864.text:
Latitude 3°N, longitude 69°E is in the Indian Ocean, southwest of the southern tip of India and west of the Maldives (which lie around 73°E).

Water

7865.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 71.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, near the Maldives. The Maldives atolls lie roughly between 73°E and 73.7°E, and the Chagos Archipelago is at about 72°E and 5°S. The Laccadive and Maldives chain begins in the north near 8°N, 73°E. At 71°E, 3°N, the point is west of the Maldives and well clear of land.

Water

7866.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 73.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, in the Maldives region. The Maldives atolls span roughly 0.7°S to 7°N and sit at about 72.5–73.7°E. At 3.0°N the atolls are around Kolhumadulu and Haa Alif Dhaalu, roughly 73.0°E. The nearby atolls at that latitude are Felidhu, Vaavu, and Meemu, at about 3.0°N, 73.4°E. Ari Atoll sits at about 3.9°N, 72.8°E, and Kolhumadulu at about 2.4°N, 73.1°E. Near 3.0°N, 73.0°E there is probably open water between Ari Atoll and Kolhumadulu, with the Vaavu and Meemu atolls to the east. Most of the atoll area is water anyway, and the point is most likely in the ocean.

Water

7867.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 75.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, southwest of the southern Maldives. The Maldives atolls run roughly from 7°N down to 0.7°S, at about 73°E. At 75°E there is no land, so this point is open ocean.

Water

7868.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 77.0°E lies in the Indian Ocean, southwest of India's southern tip and west of the Maldives. The Maldives span roughly 73°E, so 77°E is well to their east, in open ocean.

Water

7869.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 79.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, south-southwest of Sri Lanka and India, so it is water.

**Water**

7870.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 81.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, southwest of Sri Lanka and west of the Maldives' southern atolls. Sri Lanka's southern tip is near 5.9°N, so this point is well south of it. The Maldives lie around 73°E, which is well west of this longitude.

Water

7871.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 83.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, south of Sri Lanka and India's southern tip, so it is water.

**Water**

7872.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 85.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, south of Sri Lanka and India and well away from the Maldives.

Water

7873.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 87.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, south of Sri Lanka and India and well west of Sumatra. That is open water.

Water

7874.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 89.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, southwest of Sumatra and southeast of Sri Lanka and India, with no land nearby.

Water

7875.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, Longitude 91.0°E is in the Indian Ocean, west of northern Sumatra (Sumatra's west coast at that latitude is around 96-97°E). So it is water.

Water

7876.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 93.0°E lies in the Indian Ocean, west of northern Sumatra (Sumatra's west coast at that latitude is around 96-98°E). Simeulue island is at about 96°E. So 93°E is open water.

Water

7877.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 95.0°E lies off the northern tip of Sumatra, west of the island. Sumatra's northwest tip (Banda Aceh) is at about 5.5°N, 95.3°E. At 3°N the west coast of Sumatra is around 97.5°E, so 95°E is well out in the Indian Ocean, and Simeulue island sits near 96°E. That makes this point water.

Water

7878.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 97.0°E is in northern Sumatra, Indonesia. Sumatra's northwest coast runs from about 5.5°N, 95.3°E down to about 2°N, 97°E, and the west coast at 3°N is near 96.5°E. The coast near Meulaboh is at 4.1°N, 96.1°E, and Singkil is at 2.3°N, 97.8°E. So at 3°N the coast is around 97.5°E. Barus is at 2.0°N, 98.4°E, and Singkil on the coast is at 97.8°E.

Interpolating between Meulaboh (4.1°N, 96.1°E) and Singkil (2.3°N, 97.8°E) gives a coast at 3°N of about 97.0°E. That is right on the line. The coast there is slightly irregular, but the Simeulue island region lies further west. Tapaktuan is at 3.26°N, 97.18°E, which is on the coast. Since 3.0°N is just south of Tapaktuan and the coast trends southeast, the coast at 3.0°N is around 97.4°E. The point at 97.0°E is therefore west of the coast, in the sea.

Water

7879.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 99.0°E is in northern Sumatra, Indonesia, near Lake Toba (about 2.6°N, 98.9°E). Lake Toba's southern portion spans roughly 2.3–2.9°N, and 3.0°N, 99.0°E is just north of the lake. That puts it east of the lake's northern tip. The lake's northern end is around 2.95°N, so the point is likely on land.

Land

7880.text:
Latitude 3.0, longitude 101.0 is in Malaysia, near Kuala Lumpur (3.14, 101.69). Slightly west of it, at 101.0, is around Selangor's coast. The Strait of Malacca coast near Kuala Selangor is about 101.25 at 3.35. At latitude 3.0, the coast is around 101.3–101.4 (Klang is 101.4 at 3.0 and the coast is near 101.3). So 101.0 would be water, in the Strait of Malacca.

**Water**

7881.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 103.0°E falls in Peninsular Malaysia, in the Pahang area near Temerloh and Bera. That is land.

Land

7882.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 105.0°E. That is in the South China Sea / near the Riau Islands. Peninsular Malaysia's east coast lies at about 103–104°E at latitude 3°, so 105°E is offshore. Borneo starts around 109°E at that latitude. Sumatra's east coast at 3°N is about 100°E. The Natuna Islands sit at about 4°N, 108°E. The Anambas Islands are at about 3°N, 106°E. So 105°E, 3°N is water.

Water

7883.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 107.0°E. This is in the South China Sea, northeast of Sumatra and west of Borneo. Peninsular Malaysia's east coast is at about 103-104°E, and the Natuna Islands are at about 108°E at latitude 3-4°N. At 107°E, 3°N, there is open sea.

Water

7884.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, longitude 109.0 E. This is in the South China Sea, northwest of Borneo (Sarawak coast is around 3-4°N, 113°E). Natuna Islands are around 4°N, 108°E. At 3°N, 109°E, that is between Natuna and Borneo, in open sea.

Water

7885.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 111.0°E is in Borneo's northwest, Sarawak, Malaysia. Borneo spans roughly 109°E to 119°E. At 3°N, the Sarawak coast near Bintulu is around 113°E. At 111°E, 3°N, that is inland of the Rajang basin region (Sibu is at 111.8°E, 2.3°N). The coast at 111°E is around 2.5°N (the Sarawak coastline near Tanjung Sirik is about 111.3°E, 2.8°N). Hmm, so 3.0°N at 111.0°E would lie north of the coast, in the South China Sea.

Check: Tanjung Sirik is at about 2.78°N, 111.35°E. The coast near Igan/Mukah runs northeast from there. West of that, the coast goes southwest toward Sarikei (1.6°N, 111.5°E) and Sematan (1.8°N, 109.8°E). So the coast at 111°E is about 2.5°N or lower, which puts 3.0°N in the sea.

**Water**

7886.text:
Latitude 3.0 N, longitude 113.0 E is in Sarawak, Borneo (near Miri/Bintulu area, inland). Bintulu is at 3.17N, 113.03E. So this is land.

Land

7887.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 115.0°E is in Borneo, in the interior of Sarawak (Malaysia) near the Kalimantan border. Borneo spans roughly 109°E to 119°E and 4°S to 7°N, so this point is on land.

Land

7888.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 117.0°E is in Borneo, in North Kalimantan, Indonesia. Borneo spans roughly 109°E to 119°E, and at 3°N the island extends east to about 117.5°E. That puts this point on land.

Land

7889.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 119.0°E is in Borneo's east side, in North Kalimantan, Indonesia. Borneo spans roughly 109°E to 119°E at its widest, and at 3°N the east coast is around 117.5°E. So 119°E is past the coast, in the Celebes Sea, which lies east of Borneo at this latitude.

The coast near Tarakan (3.3°N) is at about 117.6°E. Tawau, in Sabah at 4.2°N, is at 117.9°E. Sulawesi's northern arm is at about 1°N, and Sulawesi's west coast at 119°E is around 0 to -3°. At 3°N, 119°E there is no land nearby.

**Water**

7890.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 121.0°E. This is east of Borneo (Kalimantan runs to about 118°E at that latitude) and south of the Philippines. It lies in the Celebes Sea, which is north of Sulawesi, whose northern arm sits around 1°N. Sulawesi's northern peninsula at 121°E is around 0.5°N, so 3°N is water.

Water

7891.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 123.0°E. That is north of Sulawesi's northern arm (which sits around 1°N, 120–125°E), and south of Mindanao. The Molucca Sea lies around 2°N, 126°E. At 3°N, 123°E the point is in the Celebes Sea, north of Sulawesi's Minahasa peninsula (which reaches about 1.5°N at 125°E). At 123°E the northern coast of Sulawesi is around 0.5°N, so 3°N is water.

Water

7892.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 125.0°E. This is near the Sangihe Islands and Talaud, north of Sulawesi. Sangihe Island lies around 3.5°N, 125.5°E. The point at 3.0°N, 125.0°E is just southwest of the main island. Sangihe's southern tip is around 3.4°N, 125.5°E, and Tahuna is at 3.6°N, 125.5°E. Other islands nearby are Kawio (4.6°N), Marore (3.0°N, 125.4°E), and Kawaluso. The point at 125.0°E is west of those, so it is in the Celebes Sea or Molucca Sea, which is water.

Water

7893.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 127.0°E. That is east of Halmahera (which spans roughly 127–128.5°E, latitudes -0.5 to 2.5°N). The northern tip of Halmahera is around 2.3°N, and Morotai is at about 2.3–2.5°N, 128.4°E. So 3.0°N, 127.0°E lies in the Molucca Sea/Philippine Sea, north of Halmahera. The Talaud Islands are at about 4°N, 126.8°E, and Sangihe is at about 3.5°N, 125.5°E. Karakelong in the Talauds spans roughly 3.7–4.2°N. So 3.0°N is south of the Talauds, and the point is water.

Water

7894.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 129.0°E. That is east of Halmahera (Halmahera spans about 127–129°E, latitude roughly -0.5 to 2.5°N). The point sits in the Molucca Sea/Philippine Sea area, north of Halmahera's northern tip (about 2.3°N at 128°E). The Talaud Islands are at about 4°N, 126.8°E, so they're not near this point. Morotai is at about 2.3–2.5°N, 128.4°E. The point at 3.0°N, 129.0°E is east of Morotai, so it's in open water.

Water

7895.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 131.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, northeast of Halmahera and Papua. Palau is at about 7.5°N, 134.5°E, so this point is well south and west of it. The nearest land is the Indonesian islands of Halmahera (around 128°E) and Waigeo (about 0°N, 131°E), and both are some distance away. At 3°N the point is about 300 km north of Waigeo, which puts it in open sea.

Water

7896.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 133.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, north of the Papua (Indonesia) region and east of the Philippines' southern area. Palau sits around 7°N, 134°E, so this point is south of Palau. The nearest land is Halmahera at about 128°E and Sonsorol and Tobi (Palau's southwest islands) at roughly 3°N, 131°E. Tobi is at about 3.0°N, 131.2°E, so 133°E is further east and open ocean.

Water

7897.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 135.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, north of Papua and east of the Philippines. Palau is around 7.5°N, 134.5°E, so 3°N is south of Palau. Tobi Island (Sonsorol) is around 3.0°N, 131.1°E, which is farther west. At 135°E, 3°N the nearest land is Papua's north coast, which lies about 1°S, and that is far from this point. So this is open ocean.

Water

7898.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 137.0°E is in the western Pacific, north of New Guinea (which lies south of about 1°S–2°S at that longitude; the coast near Jayapura is around 2.5°S). Palau is at about 134°E, 7°N, so it is well to the west and north. The point is open ocean.

Water

7899.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 139.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, north of New Guinea (which lies at about 0° to -2° at that longitude, with the coast near -1.5°S to -2.5°S). Palau is to the north-west, at about 7°N, 134°E. The point is in open ocean.

Water

7900.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 141.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean, north of New Guinea (which is around 0° to -10°). The Caroline Islands sit around 5-9°N, and this point is south of Palau and Yap, near Sonsorol and Hatohobei, which are at about 3°N, 131°E, much farther west. At 141°E, 3°N, there is open ocean, north of Papua New Guinea's coast (about 3°S) and west of the Hermit and Ninigo islands (around 1.5°S, 144°E).

Water

7901.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 143.0°E lies in the western Pacific Ocean. It is north of Papua New Guinea and south of Guam. The nearby islands are the Caroline Islands, such as Chuuk at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E, and the Hall Islands and Nomwin Atoll at about 8°N, 152°E. Nothing is known at 3°N, 143°E, and the closest land would be the Hermit Islands at about 1.5°S, 145°E, so this point is water.

Water

7902.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 145.0°E is in the western Pacific Ocean, north of Papua New Guinea and south of Guam and the Caroline Islands. Nearby islands include the Hermit Islands (about 1.5°S, 145°E) and the Caroline atolls, such as Satawal at about 7°N and Chuuk at about 7.4°N, which are farther north. Nothing lies at 3°N, 145°E itself.

Water

7903.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 147.0°E is in the western Pacific, north of Papua New Guinea and the Bismarck Sea. The Admiralty Islands lie around 2°S, 147°E, and Manus at about 2°S, so 3°N is open ocean. The nearest land would be the Caroline Islands, such as the Hall Islands at about 8°N and the Nukuoro atoll at 3.8°N, 154.9°E. Neither is close, so this point is water.

Water

7904.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 149.0°E lies in the western Pacific, north of New Ireland and Papua New Guinea, which is around 2-4°S, so the point is north of the equator. The Caroline Islands are around 5-7°N, with Chuuk at 7.4°N, 151.8°E. Nearby are the Hermit Islands (1.5°S, 145°E) and the Nukumanu atolls (4.5°S, 159°E). The Echiquier/Ninigo group is at 1.3°S, 144°E. The Kapingamarangi atoll sits at 1.1°N, 154.8°E. Satawan is at 5.3°N, 153°E, and Nomoi is at 5.5°N, 153.7°E. Pulap and Namonuito are around 8°N, 150°E. Nothing is at 3°N, 149°E, so it is open ocean.

Water

7905.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 151.0°E lies in the western Pacific, north of New Ireland (Papua New Guinea) and near the Caroline Islands. Nearby atolls include Nukuoro at about 3.8°N, 154.9°E, and Kapingamarangi at about 1.1°N, 154.8°E. Chuuk (Truk) lies at about 7.4°N, 151.8°E. Nothing I can recall sits at 3°N, 151°E, so this is open ocean.

Water

7906.text:
3°N, 153°E is in the western Pacific, north of New Ireland (Papua New Guinea). New Ireland lies around 2-4°S, 150-152°E. Latitude +3 is north of the equator, and 153°E is east of Kavieng (2.57°S, 150.8°E). The islands near there are the Tabar and Feni groups at about 3-4°S, 152-153°E, all south of the equator. At 3°N there's only open ocean.

Water

7907.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 155.0°E lies in the western Pacific, north of Papua New Guinea's New Ireland and near the Caroline Islands. Nearby land includes Nukuoro (3.85°N, 154.9°E) and Kapingamarangi (1.1°N, 154.8°E), but this exact point is open ocean.

Water

7908.text:
Latitude 3.0°N, longitude 157.0°E is in the western Pacific, near Pohnpei (about 6.9°N, 158.2°E) and Kosrae (5.3°N, 163°E). Nearby atolls include Nukuoro at 3.85°N, 154.9°E, and Kapingamarangi at 1.1°N, 154.8°E. Neither is at 3.0°N, 157.0°E, so this point is open ocean.

Water

So 1.0°N is north of the lake, in Uganda's land area, near Lake Kyoga's southern region. Lake Kyoga spans about 1.0–2.0°N, 32.5–33.5°E. Lake Kyoga is shallow and irregular, with its southern shore around 1.0°N-1.5°N. At 33.0°E, the lake's southern part... Nile exits Lake Victoria at Jinja, flows north through Lake Kyoga. The Nile enters Kyoga around 1.1°N, 33.0°E (near Namasagali, 1.02°N, 32.95°E). Namasagali is on the shore of Lake Kyoga's southern edge. So the point is right at the shore, ambiguous. Namasagali at 1.02N, 32.97E is a town on land, so the point is likely at the edge; I'll say Land.

The coast runs from Mogadishu (2.04, 45.34) to Merca (1.72, 44.77) to Barawe (1.11, 44.03). At longitude 45, the coast is at about 1.85°N. Land lies northwest of this line. The point (1.0, 45.0) is southeast of the line, so it is in the ocean.

Singkawang's coast faces west, so at 109.0°E, 1.0°N the point is near the coast just north of Singkawang. The coast there runs toward Cape Datu at about 2.05°N, 109.65°E, and Sambas is at 1.36°N, 109.3°E. The coast near 1.0°N is at roughly 108.95°E. Bengkayang and Singkawang are around 109.0°E, so the point is likely just inland or at the coast. Singkawang city is at 0.91°N, 108.98°E, close to the coast, and Pemangkat is at 1.17°N, 108.97°E. The west coast of central Sulawesi near Donggala sits at about 119.7°E, at a latitude of about -0.7°. At 1°N, the west coast is around 120.8°E (near Toli-Toli, which is at 1.05°N, 120.8°E). So 1.0°N, 121.0°E sits between them, inland and south of the northern coast, which is at about 1.1°N there. That makes it land.

**Land**

8071.text:

The northern coast near 123°E is at roughly 0.9°N, and the Gorontalo area is at 123.05°E, 0.54°N. The peninsula there is narrow, with the north coast around 0.85–1.0°N. Bolaang Mongondow lies at about 124°E, 0.7°N. At 123°E the north coast is about 0.85°N, so 1.0°N is probably just offshore in the Celebes Sea.

The north arm of Sulawesi runs east-northeast, and the southern coast of the Minahasa area is on the Maluku Sea side near 0.7°N at 124.5°E. At 125.0°E, the peninsula is around 1.2–1.5°N, with the north coast at about 1.65°N (Likupang). The south coast at 125°E is the Molucca Sea side, maybe near 1.2°N. Bitung is at 1.44°N, 125.19°E. The northwest arm of Halmahera has Jailolo at about 1.05°N, 127.5°E. Tobelo is at 1.7°N, 128.0°E. The east coast of the northern peninsula lies at about 128.7°E near 1.5°N. Eastern Halmahera reaches about 128.9°E at around 0.5°N, near Maba, which is at 128.3°E. So 129.0°E is likely water.

The Wetar/Asia islands (Asia Islands) are at about 1.0°N, 131.3°E, which is close. Asia Islands (Kepulauan Asia) are at roughly 1.03°N, 131.27°E, and Bras at 0.95°N, 131.3°E. At 131.0°E, that's about 30 km west of them, so probably water.

Water

Latitude -9, longitude 29 is in the southeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, near Lake Mweru and the Katanga region. Lake Mweru lies at about -9.0, 28.75, so the point is close to it. Lake Mweru spans roughly 28.4 to 29.1 E and -8.5 to -9.5 S. Its western shore is at around 28.7 E, and the lake sits on the Zambia–DRC border. The eastern shore is in Zambia at about 28.9 to 29.0 E.

The lake is about 130 km long and 50 km wide, running from around -8.6 to -9.5. At -9.0 its western shore is at about 28.65 E and its eastern shore at about 28.95 E. Longitude 29.0 would then fall just east of the lake, on land in Zambia near Nchelenge, which sits at about -9.33, 28.75. The Luapula River flows south of Mweru Wantipa, and Lake Mweru Wantipa is at about -8.8, 29.5. So 29.0 at -9.0 is probably land.

Longitude 31.0 at latitude -9 falls in Zambia, in the Northern Province near Mbala, on the plateau. Lake Tanganyika's southern tip is around 31.2°E, -8.5°S, and at latitude -9 the lake's shore is about 30.8°E. Mpulungu is at -8.77, 31.1. The lake's southeastern shore runs from Mpulungu southwest. Point (-9.0, 31.0) is therefore about 25 km south of Mpulungu, inland, since the lake narrows and the shore trends southwest to roughly 31.0 at -8.8 and 30.5 at -8.5... in fact the lake's southern end lies near -8.8, so -9.0 is south of it. Near 125.0, the north coast is around -8.45 (Liquiçá lies at -8.6, 125.3), and the island extends south to the Timor Sea coast at about -9.4 at that longitude. So -9.0 at 125.0 is inland, in the area near Ainaro or Aileu, which is land.

The northern coast near Dili (-8.55, 125.57) and the eastern tip near Tutuala is about (-8.4, 127.2). At -9.0 and 127.0, the position is south of the eastern tip. The south coast of Timor in the east is around -8.9 to -9.0 at longitude 126.5-127. Timor's eastern end narrows: near Lospalos (-8.5, 127.0), and the south coast near Beaco/Viqueque is at about -8.85 at 126.4. Around 127.0, the south coast is probably around -8.8. So -9.0 is likely sea (Timor Sea / Banda Sea). Also, Leti island is at -8.1, 127.8, and Babar at -7.9, 129.8. So Water.

**Water**

The Tanimbar Islands lie around 131–132°E, and Wetar is at about 126°E, 7.8°S. Leti, Moa and Lakor are around 127.5–128.5°E at about 8.1°S. Babar Island is at about 129.8°E, 7.6°S. Damar is at about 128.6°E, 7.1°S. At 9°S, 129°E there are no islands, so it is open water in the Timor/Banda Sea.

Water

8977.text:

8979.text:

At 141°E, the coast near Indonesia's Merauke region is around -9.0 to -8.3. Kiunga is at 141.3, -6.1. The coast at 141°E: Bensbach is at 141.2, -8.8. Wassi Kussa River mouth around 142.1, -9.1. Land

So 143.0, -9.0 is just west of Daru, in the Gulf of Papua/Torres Strait area. Land

Near Mbamba Bay (-11.3,34.8), Manda (-10.5, 34.6). At -13.0, the eastern shore is near Metangula (-12.7, 34.8), and Cobue (-12.2, 34.8). At -13.0 the lake's eastern shore is about 34.85°E. **Land**

9288.text:

The Comoros are at about 11.5–12.5°S and 43–44.5°E, with Mayotte at 12.8°S, 45.2°E. So -13, 43 is south of Grande Comore (11.9°S) and well west of Mayotte. That puts it in open water.

Mayotte's southwestern tip is around -13.0, 45.08. The coral reef extends to about 45.0. The point is likely water.

At -13, 47, the coast near Analalava (-14.6, 48.0) and Besalampy... Further north is the Sofia region and the Narinda Bay area (-14.9, 47.9). Cape Saint Andre is at -16.2, 44.5. At -13, 47, the coast of northern Madagascar near Ampasindava Peninsula (-13.7, 48.0) and Nosy Be (-13.3, 48.3) lies to the east. Longitude 47 at latitude -13 is west of that, so it is in the sea.

Antalaha is at -14.9, 50.28. Sambava is at -14.27, 50.17.

At -13°S, the east coast sits around 50.1°E (near Vohemar, which is at -13.4°S, 50.0°E). So 51.0°E is about 1° east of the coast, which is water.

9335.text:

At 135°E and 13°S, this is near the Wessel Islands/Arnhem Land coast. The northern coast of Arnhem Land at 135°E is around 12°S (Cape Wessel is at about 11°S, 136°E). Croker Island is at about 11°S, 132°E. At 135°E, the coast is near Arnhem Bay (13°S, 136°E) and the Gulf side... Elcho Island is at 12°S, 135.8°E. Latitude -13 at 135°E is inland, south of the coast, in Arnhem Land near Roper Bar region (Roper River at 14.7°S, 134.5°E). So it's land.

Land

9338.text:
Latitude -13, longitude 137: northern Australia, Northern Territory. Arnhem Land is around 13°S, 134-137°E. The Gulf of Carpentaria lies east of about 136-137°E at around 14-17°S. Cape Arnhem/Gove Peninsula is at 12.3°S, 136.8°E. At -13.0, 137.0, that is just south of the Gove Peninsula, west of the Gulf coast. The coast near Blue Mud Bay is at about 13.5°S, 135.9°E. Groote Eylandt is at 14°S, 136.5°E. The coast along the western Gulf runs from Blue Mud Bay (13.5°S, 135.9°E) north to Cape Arnhem (12.3°S, 136.8°E). So at 13°S the coast sits roughly at 135.9-136.2°E, and 137°E is east of it, in the Gulf of Carpentaria, which makes this water.

**Water**

9339.text:
Latitude -13, longitude 139 is in northern Australia, in the Gulf of Carpentaria region. The gulf spans roughly 10.5°S to 17.5°S and 135.5°E to 142°E. At 13°S, 139°E, the point is in the gulf's western part, east of the Wellesley Islands? No. The Wellesley Islands are at about 17°S, 139.5°E, so that doesn't help.

The Gulf's west coast (Arnhem Land) is at about 136° to 137°E at 13°S. The east coast, the Cape York Peninsula's west coast, is at about 141.5°E at 13°S. So 139°E at 13°S is in the middle of the gulf, which makes it water.

Water

9340.text:

At -13°, the west coast of Cape York (Gulf of Carpentaria) sits around 141.6°E. Near Weipa, at about -12.6°S and 141.9°E, the coast is further east than 141.0.

So at 141.0°E and -13°, the point lies west of the coast, in the Gulf of Carpentaria. Mornington Island is at about -16.5°S, so it does not apply here. The point is in water.

**Water**

9341.text:
Latitude -13.0, longitude 143.0 is in northern Queensland, Australia. Cape York Peninsula spans roughly 142–143.5°E at this latitude. At -13°, the east coast of the peninsula is around 143.5°E (Lockhart River is at -12.8, 143.3). The west coast (Gulf of Carpentaria) is around 141.6°E at that latitude. So 143.0 lies inland on the peninsula, which makes it land.

9342.text:

Water

9343.text:
Latitude -13, longitude 147 is south of Papua New Guinea's eastern tail, in the Coral Sea. Papua New Guinea's southeastern coast near Port Moresby is at about -9.5, 147. At -13, 147 it is well south of that, in the Coral Sea, and the Great Barrier Reef is farther west near 145 to 146. So it is water.

Water

9344.text:
Latitude -13, longitude 149 is in the Coral Sea, southeast of Papua New Guinea's tail. PNG's southeastern tip is around -10.6, 150.8, and the Louisiade Archipelago lies near -11 to -12, 152-154. At -13, 149 the point is well south of the PNG mainland (which is around -10 at that longitude), and Australia's Cape York is at 142-143 E. So this is open ocean.

Water

9345.text:
Latitude -13, longitude 151 lies in the Coral Sea, east of Cape York, Australia, and south of Papua New Guinea's tail. Papua New Guinea's southeastern tip (Milne Bay) is around -10.7, 150.5, and the Louisiade Archipelago lies at about -11 to -11.5, 152-154. At -13, 151 the point is in open sea, south of the Louisiades.

Water

9346.text:

Nearby land includes the Louisiade Archipelago (around -11 to -12, 152-154), but -13, 153 is south of it. Rossel Island is at about -11.4, 154.2, so this point is south of that and in open water.

Water

9347.text:

Water

Water

9349.text:

Water

9350.text:

At 13°S, 161°E, that is south of the Solomons chain (Guadalcanal is at 9.5°S, 160°E; Rennell Island is at 11.6°S, 160.2°E). Latitude -13 is south of Rennell, so it is open water in the Coral Sea/Pacific.

Water

9351.text:
Latitude -13, longitude 163E. This is in the Solomon Islands region... Santa Cruz Islands are around 166E, -10.7. Solomon Islands main chain: Guadalcanal at 160E, -9.5; Makira at 162E, -10.5. Rennell Island at 160.2E, -11.6. At -13, 163E, this is open ocean in the Coral Sea/Pacific, south of Makira. Vanuatu is at 167E. So water.

Water

9352.text:

The point at -13, 165 is west of the Banks Islands and east of the Solomon Islands' Santa Cruz group, which lies north of it. This is open ocean in the Coral Sea/Pacific.

Water

9353.text:
Latitude -13, longitude 167 is in Vanuatu, near the Banks Islands and Santo. Espiritu Santo spans roughly 166.5–167.2°E and 14.6–15.6°S, so it lies further south than this point. Longitude 137 at -15 is near the Wellesley Islands to the east and the Sir Edward Pellew Group to the north. The Sir Edward Pellew Group is at about 15.6°S, 136.8°E, so the point is just north of those islands, in the gulf's water.

The Limmen Bight River mouth is near 15.2°S, 135.4°E, and the coast runs southeast to the Roper River mouth, then toward the McArthur River at about 15.9°S, 136.7°E. At 137°E the coast is around 16°S, so -15 is about 1° north of it, which means water.

Mornington Island sits at -16.5, 139.4E, and Wellesley Islands are further south, so -15 is north of them, in open water.

9524.text:

Water

Water

Latitude -15, longitude 155 is in the Coral Sea, east of Australia and well away from any land, so it is water.

Water

Ambrym is at about -16.2, 168.1. Maewo is at about -15.1, 168.1, and its eastern coast is about 168.2°E. Longitude 169.0 at -15 is east of Maewo, so it's in the sea between Vanuatu and Fiji. Water

9825.text:

9827.text:

9828.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 37 is in Mozambique. The Mozambique coast near Beira is at about -19.8, 34.8. At longitude 37 and latitude -19, that is inland, in Zambezia/Sofala province, near the Zambezi delta area. The coast at latitude -19 is around 36.2°E, so 37 is inland.

Land

9829.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 39 is in Mozambique, near the coast. Mozambique's coast at latitude -19 (near Beira, which is about -19.8, 34.8) lies at around longitude 35. Longitude 39 at that latitude is therefore well offshore in the Mozambique Channel.

Water

9830.text:
Latitude -19, Longitude 41: this is in the South Atlantic? No, longitude 41°E is in Mozambique (Mozambique spans roughly 30°E to 41°E). At latitude -19, the coast near Beira is around 34.8°E at -19.8. So 41°E at -19 is well offshore in the Mozambique Channel, which is water.

**Water**

9831.text:

Madagascar's west coast near -19° is around Maintirano (-18.05, 44.02) and Morondava (-20.3, 44.3). At -19, the coast is roughly 44.2° E, so 43° E lies west of it, in water.

Water

9832.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 45 falls in western Madagascar, near the Mozambique Channel coast. Madagascar's west coast at latitude -19 sits around longitude 44.0–44.3 (Maintirano is at -18.05, 44.03; Morondava at -20.28, 44.28). At -19, the coast is around 44.5 (near Besalampy to Morondava, roughly 44.2–44.5). So 45.0 is inland, which makes it land.

Land

9833.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 47 is in Madagascar, which spans roughly 43–50°E and 12–25°S. At -19°, the island's east coast sits near 49°E and the west coast near 44°E, so 47°E falls well inland, in the central highlands (around Betafo or Antsirabe, which are near -19.8, 47.0).

Land

9834.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 49 is on the east coast of Madagascar. The coast near Toamasina is at about 18.15°S, 49.4°E. At 19°S the coast sits around 48.5°E, near Mahanoro (19.9°S, 48.8°E) and Vatomandry (19.3°S, 48.97°E). So at 19.0°S, 49.0°E the point is just east of the coast, probably in the water.

Checking more closely: Vatomandry is at 19.33°S, 48.98°E, and Andevoranto is at about 18.95°S, 49.1°E. The coast near 19°S therefore lies at roughly 49.08°E, which puts 49.0°E slightly inland.

Land

9835.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 51 is in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar. Madagascar spans roughly longitude 43–50.5 E. At latitude -19, the east coast is around 49.3 E. So 51 E is about 150 km offshore, which is water.

Water

9836.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 53 E is in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar (Madagascar spans roughly 43-50.5 E) and southwest of Mauritius and Réunion (55.5 E). So it is water.

Water

9837.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 55 is in the southwest Indian Ocean. Réunion is at about -21, 55.5 and Mauritius at about -20.3, 57.5, so this point lies northwest of Réunion and west of Mauritius, in open water.

Water

9838.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 57 is in the Indian Ocean. Mauritius is at about -20.2, 57.5, and Réunion is at about -21.1, 55.5. The point at -19, 57 is roughly 130 km north of Mauritius, so it is open ocean, close to Cargados Carajos, which lies at around -16.6, 59.6, and not near it.

Water

9839.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 59 is in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar. Mauritius sits at about -20.2, 57.5, and Réunion at about -21.1, 55.5. Rodrigues is at about -19.7, 63.4. The point (-19, 59) is between Mauritius and Rodrigues, slightly north, and there is no island there. It is water.

Water

9840.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 61 lies in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar. Mauritius is at about -20.2, 57.5, and Rodrigues is at about -19.7, 63.4. The point at -19, 61 is between them, in open water.

Water

9841.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 63 is in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar and southwest of Mauritius. Mauritius is at about 20°S, 57.5°E, and Rodrigues is at about 19.7°S, 63.4°E. The point (-19.0, 63.0) is about 0.7° north and 0.4° west of Rodrigues, roughly 80 km away, so it is open ocean.

Water

9842.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 65 is in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar and southwest of Mauritius and Réunion. Mauritius sits near 57.5°E and Rodrigues near 63.4°E, both north of or near -19.7. The Mascarene Plateau runs further north, around 60°E. At 65°E, -19°, the point is open ocean.

Water

9843.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 67 is in the southern Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar and southeast of the Mascarene Islands (Mauritius is at about -20, 57.5). Longitude 67 is well east of Mauritius and Réunion, in open ocean near the Mascarene Plateau and Central Indian Ridge, so it is water.

Water

9844.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 69 is in the southern Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar and southeast of Mauritius and Réunion. Réunion sits at about -21, 55.5. The Mascarene Plateau runs roughly from 60°E, and nothing at 69°E is land. The Central Indian Ridge lies near 66-69°E, but it is underwater.

Water

9845.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 71 is in the Indian Ocean, southeast of the Mascarene Islands (Mauritius is at about 57.5°E, Réunion at 55.5°E). Near 71°E, 19°S lies the Mascarene Plateau region further west, but at 71°E it is open ocean, close to the Central Indian Ridge.

Water

9846.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 73 is in the Indian Ocean, southeast of the Chagos Archipelago and east of Madagascar (which sits near 47°E). The Mascarene Islands are around 55-60°E, and the Saya de Malha Bank is near 60°E, so none of them reach 73°E. The Chagos Archipelago is at about -6° latitude, which is far to the north. That leaves open ocean.

Water

9847.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 75 is in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar and southeast of the Mascarene Islands. It is south of the Chagos area and well away from any land.

Water

9848.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 77 is in the southern Indian Ocean, well east of Madagascar and southeast of India, so it is water.

**Water**

Water

Water

Water

9852.text:

Water

Water

9879.text:

9880.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 141 is in northern Queensland, Australia, southeast of the Gulf of Carpentaria. The Gulf's southern coast is at about -17.5, so -19 is inland. This is near Julia Creek or Cloncurry, which are both on land.

Land

9881.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 143 is in Queensland, Australia, inland near the Flinders Highway area between Cloncurry and Charters Towers, so it is on land.

Land

9882.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 145 is in Queensland, Australia, inland from Townsville (which is at about -19.26, 146.8). At 145°E and 19°S, this is west of Townsville, in the Great Dividing Range area near Charters Towers (-20.07, 146.26). So it's land.

Land

9883.text:
Latitude -19.0, longitude 147.0 is in Queensland, Australia. Townsville is at about -19.26, 146.8, so this point lies just south-southeast of Townsville. The coast near Townsville runs roughly from Ayr (-19.57, 147.4) up to Townsville. At -19.0, 147.0 the point is north of Ayr and east of Townsville's longitude. Cape Cleveland is around -19.18, 147.02, and Cape Bowling Green is around -19.3, 147.4. Magnetic Island is at about -19.15, 146.85. Because the point is at -19.0, which is north of Cape Cleveland (-19.18), it is in the sea, in Halifax Bay's eastern side, north of Cape Cleveland. The coast near Cape Cleveland sits at about 147.0 longitude, with the land extending to -19.18 at the southernmost part and the cape's northern tip around -19.15. So -19.0 is about 15 km north, in open water.

Water

9884.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 149 is off the coast of Queensland, Australia. The coast near Bowen/Townsville is around -19 to -20 latitude, with the coast at approximately 147-148°E at -19.3 (Townsville is at -19.26, 146.8). At -19, the coast is around 146.3°E. Longitude 149 is about 250 km east of that, which puts it in the Coral Sea, within the Great Barrier Reef region. The outer reef at this latitude is around 148-149°E, but the point is mostly open water.

Water

9885.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 151 is in the Coral Sea, east of Queensland, Australia. The Queensland coast at that latitude is around 147°E, and the Great Barrier Reef lies offshore. Longitude 151 is about 400 km farther east, which is open water in the Coral Sea. The Coral Sea Islands, such as Willis Island at about -16.3, 149.97, are farther north, and the Chesterfield Reefs are farther east. So this point is water.

Water

9886.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 153 is in the Coral Sea, east of Queensland, Australia. The Queensland coast sits around 147-149°E at that latitude, and the Great Barrier Reef extends to about 150-151°E. At 153°E the location is open ocean, beyond the Reef and Coral Sea plateaus such as the Cato and Marion Reefs. Those reefs are further east or south, with Marion Reef near 19°S, 152.3°E, but that is reef and not land.

Water

9887.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 155 is in the Coral Sea, east of Australia (Queensland coast is around 147-149°E at that latitude). The Coral Sea contains the Chesterfield Reefs further east around 158°E, -19.9°. At 155°E it is open water.

Water

9888.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 157 E is in the Coral Sea, east of Australia, west of New Caledonia (which sits around 165E). The Chesterfield Reefs are around -19.9, 158.5, so the point is close to them but still just open water. The Coral Sea Islands include Lihou Reef at about -17.4, 151.7, and Bellona Reefs at -21, 159. The point at -19, 157 is likely open ocean.

Water

9889.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 159 is in the Coral Sea, east of Australia, west of New Caledonia. The Chesterfield Reefs lie around -19.9, 158.4, which is close, but that's still mostly ocean.

Water

9890.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 161 E is in the Coral Sea, east of Australia and west of Vanuatu/New Caledonia. New Caledonia lies around 164-167 E and 20-22 S, so 161 E is west of it. The Coral Sea there has some reefs, such as the Lord Howe Rise and the Chesterfield Islands (around 158 E, 19.9 S), but 161 E, -19 is open water.

Water

9891.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 163 lies in the Coral Sea/South Pacific, west of New Caledonia (which spans roughly 164°E to 168°E at latitudes 20–22°S). The point at 163°E, 19°S is west of New Caledonia's northern tip. The Chesterfield Islands are near 19–20°S, 158–159°E, so they are further west. The Entrecasteaux Reefs sit around 18°S, 163°E, a small set of reefs and sand cays, but the exact point is most likely open water.

Water

9892.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 165 lies east of Australia and west of Vanuatu. Vanuatu's islands run roughly from 166.5E to 170E, and New Caledonia spans about 164E to 168E at latitudes -20 to -22.5. The point at -19, 165 is northwest of New Caledonia. The northern tip of Grande Terre is near -20.1, 164.2. The Belep islands sit at about -19.7, 163.6. Point -19, 165 is north of Grande Terre in the Coral Sea, and the Entrecasteaux reefs are near -18.5, 163. So it's most likely water.

Water

9893.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 167 is in Vanuatu region. Vanuatu's Erromango is at about -18.8, 169.0; Efate at -17.7, 168.3. Malekula at -16.3, 167.5. Longitude 167 at latitude -19 is west of Erromango (169), so it lies in the Coral Sea/New Caledonia basin. New Caledonia's Loyalty Islands: Maré at -21.5, 168; Lifou at -21, 167. Latitude -19 is north of those. Between them, it is water.

Water

9894.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 169 is near Vanuatu. Erromango is at about -18.8, 169.0, and Tanna is at about -19.5, 169.3. Erromango spans roughly -18.5 to -19.0 latitude and 168.8 to 169.3 longitude, so the point sits on its southern part.

Erromango's southern tip is near Cape Cumberland at about -18.95, 169.0... The island runs from about -18.65 down to -19.987? No, that is wrong. Its southeast coast is near Dillon's Bay (west, -18.77, 169.0) and Port Narvin (south, -19.1, 169.2). The south coast is around -18.95 to -19.0 at longitude 169.0, which is uncertain. Erromango is about 50 km long north-south, centered near -18.8, so its extent is roughly -18.6 to -19.1, and the point plausibly falls inland on the island.

Land

9895.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 171 E is in the South Pacific, west of Vanuatu's easternmost islands. Vanuatu spans roughly 166.5–170.2 E, with Anatom (Aneityum) at about -20.2, 169.8. The point at 171 E, -19 is east of Vanuatu's islands, so it is open ocean.

Water

9896.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 173 E lies in the South Pacific, west of Tonga and east of Vanuatu. Vanuatu spans roughly 166-170 E, and Tonga's Vava'u group is around 174 W, which is 186 E. Fiji's Lau group is near 178-179 W. At 173 E there is open ocean.

Water

9897.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 175 is in the South Pacific, near Tonga. Tonga's Vava'u group lies around 18.6°S, 174°W, which is longitude -174, so it is not at +175. Longitude 175°E is west of the date line, in the Fiji/Tonga area. Fiji spans about 177°E to 180°, and Tonga is at 175°W, so 175°E is between Fiji's Lau/Kadavu islands and the Tongan side. Kadavu sits at 178°E, so 175°E, -19 is open ocean in the Koro Sea/Lau basin west of Fiji's main islands. Viti Levu extends west only to about 177.3°E.

Water

9898.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 177 is in the Pacific Ocean, west of Fiji's Lau group and south of Viti Levu (which is around -18, 178). Viti Levu spans roughly 177.3 to 178.5 E and -17.4 to -18.3 S, so -19, 177 lies south-west of it. Fiji's Yasawa islands are further north. Kadavu is around -19.0, 178.2. So 177.0 is west of Kadavu, and the point is in open water.

Water

9899.text:
Latitude -19, longitude 179 E is in the Pacific, east of Fiji's main islands. Fiji's Lau group lies around 17-20°S, 178-180°W. Vanua Levu is at about 16.5°S, 179°E. Taveuni is at 16.8°S, 179.9°W. Kadavu is at 19°S, 178°E. Lau islands begin around 178.5°W (that is 181.5°E). At 19°S, 179°E, it is south of Viti Levu (18°S) and east of Kadavu (178.2°E). Between Kadavu and Lau, the Koro Sea region... Vatoa is at 19.8°S, 178.2°W, and Ono-i-Lau is at 20.7°S, 178.7°W. So 179°E at 19°S looks like open water.

Water

9900.text:
Latitude -21, longitude -179 is in the South Pacific, near Fiji and Tonga. Fiji's easternmost islands (Lau group) lie around 178-179°W at latitudes 17-20°S. Ono-i-Lau is at about 20.65°S, 178.7°W. The point at 21.0°S, 179.0°W is about 30 km southwest of Ono-i-Lau, wait: 179°W is further east than 178.7°W by 0.3° (~31 km), and 0.35° south (~39 km). So it is about 50 km away from Ono-i-Lau, which is a small island group, so the point is in open water.

Water

9901.text:
Latitude -21, longitude -177 is in the South Pacific, near Tonga. Tongatapu is at about 21.2°S, 175.2°W, and the Ha'apai group is around 19.8°S, 174.3°W. Longitude -177 is about 177°W, which is roughly 200 km east of Tongatapu. Eua is at 174.9°W. Further east lie the Niue and Samoa regions, but at 21°S and 177°W there is only open ocean. The nearest land would be the Tongan islands to the west, and Minerva Reefs are at 23.6°S, 179°W. So this point is water.

Water

9902.text:
Latitude -21.0, longitude -175.0 lies in Tonga. Tongatapu is at about -21.14, -175.2, so the point is near it. Tongatapu spans roughly -21.0 to -21.25 latitude and -175.1 to -175.35 longitude. The point at -175.0 is east of the island's eastern tip, which is about -175.05 at Cape Hakau. So the point is probably water. The nearby islands of 'Eua are at -21.4, -174.9, which is farther south. The point -21.0, -175.0 is therefore likely open water north of 'Eua and east of Tongatapu.

Water

9903.text:

The Golfo de Penas lies between 46.5°S and 47.5°S, east of the peninsula, at about 75°W. Cabo Raper is at 46.84°S, 75.63°W, and south of it the coast runs southeast into the Golfo de Penas. At 47°S, the coast lies near 74.4°W, I think, so -75.0 would be to the west of the coast, in water. The Golfo de Penas's southern shore at around 47.2°S is near 74.5°W. The Península de Tres Montes is at 46.9°S–47.2°S, longitude about 75.3°W–74.5°W. Tres Montes peninsula extends to Cabo Tres Montes at 46.98°S, 75.47°W. So the peninsula lies around 47°S between 75.5 and 74.5, which makes land plausible. Tres Montes is a mountainous peninsula about 40 km long running from the isthmus at Ofqui, at approximately 74.3°W, west to the cape at 75.4°W.
